But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS

programme.title: Anne Steward vs. Staci Cobb
programme.desc: Anne says Staci is a bully who controls everything from her finances to how much she eats. Staci refutes Anne is a manipulator who uses the threat of breaking up to get her way.

programme.title: Trishon Jackson vs. Michael Conners
programme.desc: Trishon says her child's father, Michael, is verbally abusive and an unsupportive cheater. Michael says he is the sole provider in the household and demands loyalty in exchange.

programme.title: Charlie Freeman Jr. vs. Janelle Acevedo
programme.desc: Charlie says his high school sweetheart, Janelle, has turned into an insecure, jealous stalker. Janelle says Charlie caught him in very questionable situations, hence the mistrust.

programme.title: Kat Silva vs. Todd Pierce
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Kat says her fiancé, Todd, used to be the perfect partner, but now he refuses to work, drinks too much, and recently brought home some mysterious blonde hairs. She says this is the end of the line for her and Todd. Todd says he loves Kat and claims he's not cheating. He argues he's been working hard to contribute since his hours at work were cut. Can Judge Star Jones help pull this relationship from the muck? Find out on the next Divorce Court with Judge Star Jones.

programme.title: Raymond Jackson vs. Pa'Shae Hawkins
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Raymond says that after three years with Pa'Shae, he realizes she's not ready for a relationship with him. He says she's cancelled their wedding twice and refuses to start a family with him, and he is tired of competing with the memory of her recently deceased ex. Pa'Shae says Raymond is immature, lazy, manipulative, and a liar. Can Star Jones give this hurting couple a burst of new hope or is it time to part ways? Find out on the next Divorce Court with Judge Star Jones.

programme.title: Matthia Kelsey vs. Charles Kelsey
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Matthia says she's finally ready to let go of her 13-year marriage to her husband Charles and she has the divorce papers. She says Charles has no ambition, shows her no support, cheats on her, and cannot do even the most basic things for himself. Charles is desperate to save his marriage. He says he is willing to make a change and wants Matthia to let him move back into the home.

programme.title: Monica Johns vs. "Chino" Toribio
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Monica is tired of Chino's lies and empty promises. When they got together 4 years ago, he promised her marriage, a home, and a baby. Instead, she says he manipulated her into becoming a webcam girl, started controlling her money, and refuses to let go of his ex. Chino says everything he does is for Monica and denies any cheating allegations. Can Judge Star Jones help mend this broken relationship? Find out on the next Divorce Court with Judge Star Jones.

programme.title: Chiffona Thompson vs. "Orvalle" Williams II
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Chiffona says she's been financially supporting Timothy for the last 5 years. She says he promised her they would get married, but time is running out. She says if he doesn't propose today, she will kick him out and charge him for 5 years' worth of expenses. Timothy says Chiffona treats him like a child and even puts him on punishment when he makes mistakes. He argues she's a party animal who hasn't proven to him she's ready for a family.

programme.title: Ashley Williams vs. Joshua Davis
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Ashley says her fiancé, Joshua, is an emotionally unavailable liar and a cheater. She wants to get married and have children, but feels Joshua is not putting in the same amount of effort and she's had enough. She also believes Joshua continuously hides her from his family. Joshua says Ashley's constant nagging and accusations are the real cause of the turmoil in their relationship. Can Star Jones put the brakes on this runaway train of a relationship?

programme.title: "Dawna" Harvey vs. "Wayne" Harvey
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Dawna says she has no doubt her husband, Wayne, has been cheating on her. She says she's seen text messages, tracked his locations, and found his live porn. Now she's ready to end their marriage on the day of their 8th wedding anniversary. Wayne says he's never cheated on his wife and all of her "evidence" is in her head. Can Judge Star Jones perform a miracle and get this marriage back on track or will it end in shambles?

programme.title: Amanda Rodriguez vs. Alonzo Gordon
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Amanda says her fiancé is a passive-aggressive narcissist who lives in a fantasy world and would rather waste money on scams to buy land on Mars than show her any affection or save money. Amanda says their relationship is dying because Alonso has massive control issues and his only concern in life is his own personal gratification. Alonso says he is a dreamer with big ideas and goals and never receives support at all from the mother of his child.

programme.title: Lizabet Comstock vs. Chris Comstock
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Lizabet says her marriage with Chris is crumbling because he has put his failed surfing career over her and their family. On top of that, it seems Chris has been ditching his wife to spend time with a hot new "surf babe." Chris denies cheating with his protégé. He further maintains his wife knew what she was getting into when she married a surfer. Is there still hope for this marriage or have the tides turned? Find out on the next Divorce Court with Judge Star Jones.

programme.title: Cyn Wilson vs. Tyrone Wilson Jr.
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Cyn says the man she met is not the man she married. She says she unknowingly entered a marriage with a man suffering from drug addiction. She says if her husband can't get sober, she wants a divorce! Tyrone argues he's been sober for the last 3 months and needs his wife to trust him. He says his wife is his soulmate and a divorce would be devastating. Will Judge Jones be able to cast this marriage one last thread of hope?

programme.title: Ronneice Reedy vs. Aubrey Murphy
programme.desc: Ronneice says she's caught Aubrey shirtless in their home with three other women. Aubrey is sick of the constant accusations and says she should focus on doing "wife stuff."

programme.title: Lex Andrickson vs. Joseph Dale
programme.desc: Lex says Joseph is avoiding any intimacy with her but cheats with other women. Joseph says Lex needs to stop pressuring him to have a baby when it's not in the cards right now.

programme.title: Ashante Peeples-Hampton vs. Christopher Peeples-Hampton
programme.desc: Ashante says Christopher is a jealous husband who refuses to work, cheats, and even steals from her. Christopher says Ashante is a liar and has no desire to save their marriage.

programme.title: Azaina Smith vs. DMario Gray
programme.desc: Azaina says her fiancé has crossed the line with other women but refuses to show affection to her. DMario says Azaina is just insecure and argues she's no angel either!

programme.title: Viviane Koenig vs. Stuart Koenig
programme.desc: Viviane has been unhappily married for 50 years and she can't take another day of disrespect. Stuart argues Viviane is a spiteful nag who tries to control everything in his life.

programme.title: Tresha Joel vs. "Teejay" Joel
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Tresha says her 1-year marriage to Thomas is hanging by a thread. She says he has major anger problems, unconventional sexual fantasies, and lies to her all the time. Thomas says he and Tresha are not on the same page and she is to blame for many of their problems. Will Judge Jones be able to get these two on the same page? Find out on the next Divorce Court with Judge Star Jones.

programme.title: Deidra Rodriguez vs. Jamar Pinkett
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Deidra says her fiancé and baby's father, Jamar, is an unreliable narcissist and a cheater who only shows up when it's convenient for him and she's sick of it. Jamar says he loves Deidra and is the same person he's always been. Can Star Jones clean up this mess of a relationship or is it too late? Find out on the next Divorce Court with Judge Star Jones.

programme.title: Miriam Te'o vs. Anthony Bridges
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Miriam says Tony has been taking advantage of her for the last 4 years and she's ready to cut ties. He does not contribute financially, does not respect her culture, and worst of all, she just found out he's been swinging with other couples behind her back. Tony says he loves Miriam, but she needs to keep an open mind when it comes to their relationship. Can Judge Star fix this unraveling relationship or will these two only find true happiness elsewhere?

programme.title: Henry Bromin vs. Julia Saavedra
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, after 4 years, Henry is tired of Julia using her religion as an excuse not to have sex with him and he wants a change. Henry says Julia has been hiding behind her religion and refusing to allow their relationship to take its natural course. Julia says Henry needs to respect her religion or their relationship is over. Can Judge Star Jones get these two on the path of a healthier relationship or is it time to part ways?

programme.title: Jillian Allen vs. David Madwin
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Jillian says David has been gaslighting her for 3 years. From vacationing with his ex-girlfriends to spooning with other women, Jillian says she is tired of David's lack of boundaries and respect. David says Jillian is just insecure about his other relationships and she needs to loosen up. Can Judge Star Jones help bring some respect back into this hurting relationship? Find out on the next Divorce Court with Judge Star Jones.

programme.title: Shawntay Vaughn vs. Derrick Taylor
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Shawntay says her husband, Derrick, refuses to provide, cheats, walks out on her frequently, and denies he's the father of their baby. She's had enough and is in Divorce Court today as a last resort. Derrick says he's tired of his wife constantly emasculating him. He is an "Alpha Male" and expects to be treated accordingly. Can Judge Star Jones bring the hammer down on this case and reestablish some order? Find out on the next Divorce Court with Judge Star Jones.

programme.title: Elizabeth Glass vs. Dontavious Wellons
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Elizabeth says Dontavious is a lying, cheating momma's boy with a gambling problem, and she is tired of it. On top of stealing money to fuel his gambling addiction, he's also canceled their vacation plans to accommodate his mother at a whim. Dontavious says Elizabeth is unappreciative and territorial. He denies cheating and says Elizabeth is overreacting. Is Judge Star Jones willing to bet on this couple or will this relationship come up with snake eyes?

programme.title: Earicka Stith vs. Gary Scott
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Earicka says her fiancé, Gary, is unreliable, cheap, and sneaky. She claims she has evidence that he's been committing infidelities both locally and out of state and she's demanding answers. Gary says Earicka is not supportive of his career, and because she isn't perfect herself, she needs to adjust her expectations. Can Judge Star Jones help this couple put the pieces back together or is it not even worth the effort?

programme.title: Shannon Block vs. Zachary Griffin
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Shannon feels she is at a dead end in her relationship. She says her boyfriend, Zachary, is more interested in his conspiracy theories rather than focusing on their future together. She's given him an ultimatum...she wants a ring or she's moving on. Zachary says Shannon is financially irresponsible and uses his credit cards behind his back. Can Judge Star Jones plant some common sense into this relationship or is it time to move on with their lives?

programme.title: Ashley Victor vs. "Dex" Williams
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Ashley says her partner, Dex, has completely given up on himself and given into his gaming addiction. According to Ashley, Dex's gaming addiction has left her paying all the bills. She says if he doesn't start prioritizing their family, she's out the door. Dex says Ashley needs to be patient with him and give him time to get a job. Can Judge Star Jones help straighten out this couple's priorities or is it game over?

programme.title: Sonya Gonzales vs. Eric Sandoval
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Sonya says for the last 3 years she's been trying to get a divorce. She says her husband's unwillingness to meet her halfway has caused issues within her new relationship. Sonya says her husband, Eric, is an alcoholic who destroyed their family with his infidelity, and she's moved on without him. Eric doesn't want a divorce and wants to keep his family together for the sake of their 3 children.

programme.title: April Whitaker vs. Joshua Goodlow
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, April says her boyfriend is a sneaky, male chauvinist who won't fully commit to their relationship. April argues Joshua holds an archaic belief that a woman should always be submissive to her man. April says she is 20 years older than Joshua and she has no plans of changing her lifestyle. Joshua admits that he has no interest in being committed to one woman and wants to explore a polygamous relationship with April.

programme.title: Samantha Bracci vs. "Bob" Maillard
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Samantha gave her boyfriend, Bob, an ultimatum; propose in 6 months or she's done with the relationship. Samantha says after 8 years, it's time for him to finally commit. Bob has built a tight bond with Samantha's 3 children and sees a future with her, but he will not be given an ultimatum on when to propose. Can Judge Star Jones help this couple before their relationship goes up in smoke? Find out on the next Divorce Court with Judge Star Jones.

programme.title: Shanelle Chapman vs. Richard Swiney
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Shanelle says she is tired of being verbally belittled and publicly humiliated by the man she's been in love with for the past four years. She's decided to end the relationship if her boyfriend doesn't change his controlling behavior. Richard thinks there's bigger fish to fry when it comes to their relationship. He believes Shanelle is cheating and noticed her receiving suspicious calls from other men. He's even seen another guy leave her home once.

programme.title: Maria Francombe vs. Cesar Ruiz
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Maria says her husband has completely checked out of their marriage and doesn't contribute financially to their household. She's had enough and wants a divorce. Cesar says his wife's mother passed away from Covid and she hasn't been the same person since. He says she's been inconsolable, and their communication has deteriorated. He says he wants to salvage their marriage, but it takes two.

programme.title: Keita Singleton vs. Teresa Jefferson
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Keita says his partner of 16 years, Teresa, is a cheater with no ambition. He wants her to confess her infidelity and strongly believes he is not the father of one of their four children. He demands a DNA test to determine if he should stay in this relationship. Teresa refutes she's not the cheater, Keita is! She says the DNA test request is ridiculous and he is the one living a double life.

programme.title: Roselyn Coleman vs. David Debardeleben
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Roselyn is at a crossroad in her relationship. She says her fiancé, David, is too emotional, is addicted to seeking attention on social media from other women, and they've lost their intimate connection. David says his fiancée is not the same woman he met. He says she is distant, doesn't care to spend time with him, and even blocked him on social media. He feels like she is hiding something from him...or someone.

programme.title: Doris Cochran vs. Marie Sexton
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, after 25 years of friendship, Doris and Marie decided to enter a relationship. As their relationship progressed, Doris says Marie didn't want to hold her hand in public, post their photos on social media or engaged in certain intimate acts. Doris believes she was an experiment, but Marie refutes this kind of relationship is very new to her and she needs time to get a feel of things.

programme.title: Tatiana Amaro vs. Jaquoby Joseph
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Tatiana says she doesn't want a player, she wants a husband. She says her fiancé flirts with other women in front of her and was sexting with another woman while he was in bed with her. Jaquoby says he's turned off by Tatiana's binge drinking. He says she is an angry drunk who picked a fight with the wrong person which resulted in a gun being pulled on them. Can Judge Star Jones mitigate this emotional mayhem before someone gets hurt?

programme.title: Alexa Smith vs. Jaqirah Wright-Whitney
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Alexa says her fiancée, Jaqirah, constantly questions her loyalty and wants to always know her whereabouts. Alexa says Jaqirah's insecurities are ruining their relationship and if things don't change, the engagement is off. Jaqirah says Alexa hasn't been honest with her and notices how she fraternizes with other men which makes her uncomfortable. Jaqirah says Alexa has dated men in the past and believes she could end up leaving her for one.

programme.title: Kevin Feagins II vs. Amanda Torbett
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Kevin says Amanda, 17 years his senior, constantly accuses him of wanting a younger woman, tracks his whereabouts and treats him like a child. Amanda says Kevin doesn't make her a priority in their relationship and catches him of looking women up and down right in front of her while they're out in public. Can Judge Star Jones get these two to open some productive dialogue? Find out on the next Divorce Court with Judge Star Jones.

programme.title: Tania Taylor vs. Darnell Brooks
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Tania can't trust her boyfriend, Darnell, after he cheated with an ex. Tania says the lies, broken promises and deceit from Darnell has left her questioning their relationship. Darnell admits to his mistakes but wants a fresh start with Tania, and for a fresh start, he needs her to quit with the accusations. Can Judge Star Jones get this rocky relationship back on a smooth path or is too late to look back now? Find out on the next Divorce Court with Judge Star Jones.

programme.title: Somebody's Creeping: Shaniece Degazon v Trey Riley
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Shaniece says she caught her boyfriend, Trey, texting other women, found his profile on a dating app, and reveals they haven't had sex in months. She wants to get married and start a family but she's tired of waiting. Trey argues Shaniece is very controlling and always doing things she shouldn't be. He says his girlfriend took it upon herself to transfer money out of his own account for "investing" purposes.

programme.title: Darrell Gast II vs. Ravontis Simpson
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Darrell says his partner of 14 years continuously cheats on him. He claims Ravontis has had another man in his car, she will disappear for hours, and she turns her tracker off on her phone so he can't locate her. He loves her and wants to fix their relationship for the sake of their 2 children, but he can't trust her anymore. Ravontis says Darrell's insecurities and controlling ways are the real problem.

programme.title: Donte Reams vs. Joyce Broadnax
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Donte says his dreams of having a committed relationship with his fiancée, Joyce, has turned into a nightmare. He's caught her on a singles hook-up site, texting her ex, and turns her tracker off when she's out. Joyce says Donte is extremely controlling. According to Joyce, Donte cut her phone service off when he suspected her of cheated. Can Judge Star Jones fix this failing love? Find out on the next Divorce Court with Judge Star Jones.

programme.title: Ashley Holmes vs. Trevor Holmes
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Ashley says she wants one thing and one thing only...a divorce! She says her husband, Trevor, relied on her to pay the bills, burned her personal items when he was upset, and is a mean drunk. On one occasion, he threw a drink in her face at a restaurant when he thought she was on the phone with another man. Trevor says they've been separated for 8 months, but he says he's ready to move back into the house and start new.

programme.title: I'm Too Popular For You: Aquilla Kennedy v Gideon Mba
programme.desc: Aquilla says Gideon's misogynistic views have her ready to leave this relationship. Gideon is from Africa and has different ideological beliefs of a woman's role in a relationship.

programme.title: I Don't Want You To Die: Danni Thompson v "Alex" Thompson
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Danni says she loves her wife, Alex, but this isn't the relationship she envisioned for herself. Danni says Alex is financially irresponsible, they have intimacy issues and Alex has an eating disorder. Alex says Danni has a friend she doesn't approve of and believes her wife is cheating. Can Judge Jones navigate through this cracking, glass house of a marriage? Find out on the next Divorce Court with Judge Star Jones.

programme.title: "Queen" Williams vs. Johnny Williams
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Queen is convinced her husband, Johnny, cheated after he abandoned her and her children. Queen says their issues started when Johnny started staying out all night acting single. She wants to save her marriage but needs him to put her first. Johnny state Queen is controlling and tracks his every move via smart phone device. He's also done with Queen publicly embarrassing him on social media. Can Star Jones help put the crackle and glow back into this whimpering flame?

programme.title: Vanitra Johnson vs. "Benz" Hardaway
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Vanitra says her boyfriend has continuously embarrassed her and she's had enough. She says he gambled away their rent money and she caught him flirting with another woman. Benz says he's made mistakes in the past with his gambling but on one occasion, he won enough money to buy them a car. He wants his family together for the sake of their 2-year-old daughter. Can Judge Star help this couple or is the juice just not worth the squeeze?

programme.title: Amanda Stitt vs. Hunter Whittington
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Amanda says she no longer trusts her fiancé and doesn't want to get married. She says Hunter calls her derogatory names, has cheated on her with her own best friend, and won't watch their 4-year-old son. Hunter is pleading for a second chance and doesn't like the idea of co-parenting their 4-year-old son. Can Judge Jones repair this broken relationship or is its fate already sealed? Find out on the next Divorce Court with Judge Star Jones.

programme.title: Porscha Shannon vs. Angel Navy
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Porscha says her fiancée, Angel, is a flirty drunk who acts inappropriately in public and is financially careless. Though, they have another problem that could mean the end of their engagement. programme.desc: Two convicts run an ingenious bank robbery scheme...until they meet an eccentric housewife.

programme.title: Maverick - Plunder of Paradise
programme.desc: Bart Maverick and Big Mike McComb head to a remote Mexican fishing village to help find buried Spanish treasure. But the man who invited them is nowhere to be seen. They find themselves in a dangerous situation with several people, including bandits.

programme.title: Far Haven
programme.desc: In 1887, Hunter Braddock moves back to Far Haven, Arizona to start over with his two young children, but when his father-in-law is brutally attacked he must take on the corrupt forces strangling the town in order to protect what he loves most.

programme.title: Maverick - The White Widow
programme.desc: A beautiful widow hires Bart Maverick to protect her from a mysterious killer, but Bart realizes the poison pen letters and threats are also aimed at him. Intrigue involving money and a dangerous scheme escalate while Bart uncovers the truth.

programme.title: Cheyenne - Sweet Sam
programme.desc: Cheyenne arrives in Rock Springs. He meets Sam Pridemore, who stops a killer and becomes the town hero. He seems to be everyone's friend. But Cheyenne is suspicious, thinking he is planning to rob the bank of its gold.

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Sheridan Story
programme.desc: At the end of the Civil War, General Sheridan and his staff arrive at the McCain Ranch. Trouble begins when ex-confederate soldier and hired hand Frank Blandon confronts the general, who shot and wounded him in the war.

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Retired Gun
programme.desc: Wes Carney, a famous gunfighter, and his new wife Clair move to North Fork. They open a store and settle down. However, three outlaws come to town to challenge him. Carney refuses and they ransack his store, forcing him to put his gunbelt back on.

programme.title: The Deadly Companions
programme.desc: When a former Army officer accidentally kills a woman's young son, he offers to escort the grieving mother through dangerous Indian territory on the way to lay the boy to rest at the family homestead.

programme.title: Cheyenne - Test of Courage
programme.desc: A frustrated Army post commander court-martials Cheyenne for cowardice after he abandons a herd of needed Army horses. The commander wants answers and orders Cheyenne to take them to a desolate cavalry base used during enemy strikes.

programme.title: Easy Mark
programme.desc: Bart Maverick impersonates a wealthy railroad heir, Cornelius Van Rensselear Jr., to gain access into a crucial shareholders' meeting in St. Louis. However, Bart is soon the target of rivals who plan to sabotage the meeting.

programme.title: Maverick - Shady Deal at Sunny Acres
programme.desc: Bret Maverick is conned out of $15,000 in Sunny Acres by a crooked town banker, John Bates, who denies taking the money. Bret decides to set up his own con and recruits Bart and other con artists to trick Bates in Denver, using his greed against him.

programme.title: Cheyenne - Gold, Glory and Custer - Prelude
programme.desc: Assigned as a scout, Cheyenne travels with Lt. Colonel George A. Custer and his regiment into Sioux territory while they search for gold. However, events lead up to the famous Little Bighorn disaster.

programme.title: Cheyenne - Gold, Glory and Custer - Requiem
programme.desc: A disastrous massacre at Little Bighorn wipes out Colonel Custer's regiment and forces Cheyenne into hiding. But when Major Marcus Reno faces charges of cowardice, Cheyenne re-emerges to testify for him.

programme.title: The Rifleman - Closer Than a Brother
programme.desc: Marshal Micah Torrance loses his confidence in his job of authority and begins drinking again after an old enemy from the past terrorizes him. When Lucas learns of the situation, he invites the man to North Fork and convinces Micah to face his fears.

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Lost Treasure of Canyon Town
programme.desc: On the way home to North Fork, Lucas, Micah, and Mark take a detour to Micah's hometown. A thriving mining town years ago, it is now a ghost town except for Mr. Newman and his son who still live there. Something is amiss, and a mystery is revealed.

programme.title: Maverick - The Golden Fleecing
programme.desc: Bart Maverick takes a break from the poker table and tries his hand in the stock market as he attempts to bluff wealthy con artist Loftus Jaggers. Jaggers and his pretty daughter Adele attempt to steal a farmer's interest in a gold-mining company.

programme.title: Maverick - Guatemala City
programme.desc: Bret Maverick goes to Guatemala City to follow the woman he loves, Ellen Johnson, whom he fears may be linked to a million-dollar jewel theft. After arriving, he meets a clever young street kid named Angelita who becomes his guide to help find Ellen.

programme.title: Cheyenne - Man Alone
programme.desc: Cheyenne finds a young, injured cowboy who is suffering from amnesia. Cheyenne takes him to the doctor and then leaves to investigate a murder and bank robbery. Cheyenne suspects that the young man could be involved.

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Photographer
programme.desc: Abel Goss is doing a portrait of Mark standing on a North Fork street. Suddenly he sees Colonel Whiteside and his sidekick, Jamison. When he recognizes them as the cruel men who tortured him in a Civil War prison camp, problems soon arise.

programme.title: The Rifleman - Shivaree
programme.desc: A young couple traveling to Yuma to get married come across Aaron Pelser's wagon train. Pelser and his group take things too far by forcing them to marry in North Fork, which is not the friendly spirit for a shivaree. Lucas steps in to help.

programme.title: F Troop - La Dolce Courage
programme.desc: An Italian man, Emilio Barberini, and his beautiful daughter, Gina, visit the F Troop at Fort Courage. Her beauty attracts the attention of every man, but her hot-headed suitor is pursuing her and swears vengeance on anyone who even glances her way.

programme.title: F Troop - Wilton the Kid
programme.desc: A gunman known as Kid Vicious, who looks exactly like Captain Wilton Parmenter, arrives at Fort Courage. Wrangler Jane initially thinks he is the captain but after he terrorizes the F Troop, Parmenter shows his leadership and confronts the intruder.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - Jim Roberts Cleans Up Jerome
programme.desc: In his first week on the job as the new constable of Jerome, Arizona, Jim Roberts gets to work arresting the town's troublemakers and teaching his timid deputy how to be a courageous lawman as they track down a stone-cold killer and his gang.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - Last Shot at the OK Corral
programme.desc: In an odd twist of fate, photographers C.S. and Mollie Fly decide to open a studio next to a dusty corral in Tombstone, Arizona, and they end up taking the last shot of the Old West's most infamous gunbattle, the Shootout at the O.K. Corral.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier - Daniel Boone: Hero of Kentucky
programme.desc: After frontiersman Daniel Boone forges paths across the Appalachian Mountains and into the newly discovered lands of Kentucky, he founds the settlement of Boonesborough, which quickly becomes one of the most important outposts on colonial America's frontier. But this westward expansion comes at a price. Despite agreements made with the powerful Cherokee nation, conflict between the settlers and natives soon rages like wildfire. For Boone, the strife becomes intensely personal when his daughter a

programme.title: The Cowboy Way - Crazy Rich Texans
programme.desc: The cowboys are deep in the heart of Texas! In this episode of The Cowboy Way, the guys try to cash in on a cattle bounty roundup: hard cash for each cow they catch. But this money ain't easy thanks to a sprawling 500-acre ranch covered in mesquite brush with razor-sharp thorns. Just when the cowboys think they've found a promising Texas cattle connection, Booger makes a big mistake that could jeopardize their first meeting with a hard-nosed rancher. Back in Alabama, Bubba and Kaley's house gues

programme.title: Maverick - Island in the Swamp
programme.desc: Bret Maverick is attacked on a riverboat and set adrift in a dinghy, eventually floating to a dock on a secluded island. The island's residents fear Bret is a spy and take him prisoner, but he soon convinces them otherwise.

programme.title: Cheyenne - Riot at Arroyo Seco
programme.desc: Cheyenne faces issues in a small town, including a dry well and anxiety from townspeople, which leads to an uprising. As sheriff, he tries to keep the peace, but the formation of a lynch mob forces him to shoot and kill a prominent citizen's son.

programme.title: Cheyenne - Apache Blood
programme.desc: Cheyenne returns a young white man named Mickey, who was kidnapped by the Apaches when he was a child. Problems arise when Mickey's family isn't accepting of his Mexican wife. Mickey rebels against his family, and Cheyenne tries to save his marriage.

programme.title: The Rifleman - Dark Day at North Fork
programme.desc: While hauling dynamite, Lucas accidentally creates a spark, leading to an explosion. He is blinded and Doc Burrage isn't sure if he will regain his sight. When an enemy from Lucas' past shows up in town, he is in danger, as the man aims to kill him.

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Prisoner
programme.desc: When two ex-Confederate officers come to town, trouble ensues for Lucas as he was a lieutenant in the 8th Indiana which defeated the 12th Cavalry 15 years ago. The beaten men were sent to a Union prison camp and now want revenge on Lucas.

programme.desc: To avoid jail, Bart Maverick is forced to chaperone three unrefined mail-order brides from the Barbary Coast set to marry the naive sons of rancher Joe Wheelwright. Bart is tasked with giving them a crash course in manners.

programme.desc: Bart Maverick runs for senator in Silverdale after rescuing Reform Party candidate Ellsworth Greeley from an assassination attempt. Bart's campaign run becomes dangerous when his enemies intend to kill him if he wins, forcing him to throw the race.

programme.title: Cheyenne - The Quick and the Deadly
programme.desc: On his stop to pick up prisoners for Huntsville, Cheyenne learns of Deputy Gary Thomas' conviction of a crime. He believes that the banker's son, Jud Ainley is behind Thomas' arrest and begins unraveling the truth.

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Deadeye Kid
programme.desc: After witnessing a murder, 16 year-old Donnel O'Mahoney panics and comes to the McCain Ranch. A posse is on the hunt for the young man, believing he commited the crime. Mark befriends and hides O'Mahoney, who is traveling west from New York.

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Indian
programme.desc: U.S. Marshal Sam Buckhart escorts an Indian prisoner back east to stand trial. They arrive in North Fork and Lucas finds out that Buckhart is also an Indian who was educated at Harvard. Angry townspeople try to take matters into their own hands.

programme.title: F Troop - The Return of Wrongo Starr
programme.desc: The jinxed cavalryman, Wrongo Starr, comes back to Fort Courage. However, this time he is making the F Troop very nervous with a load of dynamite in his possession. While there, he gets mixed up with a goat after Parmenter assigns him as a guard.

programme.title: F Troop - Survival of the Fittest
programme.desc: An army captain arrives at Fort Courage and tells Captain Permenter that two troops must undergo a survival test in the wilderness. Parmenter decides to go with Agarn. Realizing they must survive on their own, the two face challenges finding food.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - The Bone War
programme.desc: It's not gold that inspires a rush of treasure hunters to flood the windblown bluffs of Wyoming: it's bones. After stumbling upon a strange fossil, a man is caught in the crossfire of rival paleontologists warring over a trove of dinosaur bones.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - The Gold Rush Lawman
programme.desc: When failed prospector John Hicks Adams is elected sheriff of Santa Clara County, he must prove that he won't be a bust as a lawman too. Just weeks into the job, his courage is tested when a band of stagecoach robbers begins terrorizing the area.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier - Lewis & Clark: Captains of Discovery
programme.desc: Under orders from President Jefferson to explore America's vast unknown frontier, Meriwether Lewis and William Clark lead an expedition up the Missouri River in an attempt to reach the Pacific Ocean...a journey no American has made before, and one that may not even be possible. Leaving Fort Mandan after their first winter on the frontier, the Corps of Discovery enters completely uncharted territory. But as the waterways they travel become too shallow for boats, Lewis and Clark desperately seek t

programme.title: The Cowboy Way - Cash Cows
programme.desc: First, the cowboys need to track down one of Bubba's most troublesome heifers before she can bust through his fence again. After briefly tending to business and family in Alabama, the guys head back to the Lone Star State to try and expand their network of contacts. Bubba, Cody, and Booger help their new friend Cash with a big Texas cattle drive in the hopes of both leading the herd to greener pastures and finding the big cattle deal they came west for. On the range they forge deeper bonds with

programme.title: Drinking Buddies
programme.desc: Although they're both dating other people, two co-workers (Olivia Wilde, Jake Johnson) hang out together in bars and try to ignore their mutual attraction.

programme.title: Life Partners
programme.desc: A 29-year-old lawyer (Gillian Jacobs) and her lesbian best friend (Leighton Meester) experience a dramatic shift in their longtime bond after one enters a serious relationship.

programme.title: Flawless
programme.desc: A janitor (Michael Caine) convinces a frustrated executive (Demi Moore) to help him steal gems from their employer, the London Diamond Corp.

programme.title: Detour
programme.desc: Harper (Tye Sheridan), a seemingly naive law student, obsesses over the idea that his shifty stepfather (Stephen Moyer) was involved in the devastating car crash that left his mother hospitalized and comatose. While drowning his suspicions in whiskey, he suddenly finds himself engrossed in a conversation with a volatile grifter (Emory Cohen) and his stripper companion (Bel Powley). As daylight breaks, Harper soon realizes that he's in over his head with this violent duo.

programme.title: Humboldt County
programme.desc: Aspiring doctor Peter Hadley (Jeremy Strong) gets the shock of his life when his hard-nosed father (Peter Bogdanovich) -- and medical-school professor -- fails him, invalidating his acceptance to an elite residency program. His long-standing life plan suddenly in question, the introverted Hadley stumbles through the streets of Los Angeles, until a one-night stand with singer Bogart (Fairuza Balk) lands him on an unexpected pilgrimage to Humboldt County, the marijuana capital of the West Coast.

programme.title: Ceremony
programme.desc: An obsessed young man (Michael Angarano) crashes the wedding of his older former lover (Uma Thurman) in a misguided attempt to reignite romantic sparks.

programme.title: Filth
programme.desc: A drug-addled, manipulative misanthrope (James McAvoy) begins to experience increasingly severe hallucinations as he tries to solve the murder of a Japanese student.

programme.title: Lemon
programme.desc: After Isaac's blind girlfriend walks out on him, his life goes into free fall, and he directs an unhinged staging of Chekhov's "The Seagull," attends the Passover Seder from hell, and attempts to woo a new flame.

programme.title: Four Lions
programme.desc: A group of young Muslim men living in Sheffield decide to wage jihad, and they hatch an inept plan to become suicide bombers. Omar (Riz Ahmed) and Waj (Kayvan Novak) have a brief, disastrous run at a Pakistan training camp, while Faisal (Adeel Akhtar) works on an unlikely scheme to train birds to carry bombs. Their ill-conceived plan culminates at the London Marathon with their bumbling attempts to disrupt the event while dressed in outlandish costumes.

programme.title: Swan Song
programme.desc: A retired hairdresser escapes his nursing home and embarks on an odyssey across his small town to style a dead woman's hair for her funeral, confronting the ghosts of his past and rediscovering his sparkle along the way.

programme.title: The Napa Boys
programme.desc: A mysterious individual known as "The Sommelier" leads a group of friends on a raucous road trip through wine country.

programme.title: Tapawingo
programme.desc: When an oddball mailroom worker finds out that his boss's son is being bullied, he forms a ragtag team of would-be mercenaries to protect the boy.

programme.title: Support the Girls
programme.desc: Lisa is the general manager of Double Whammies, a sports bar that features skimpily dressed waitresses. Always nurturing and protective of her staff, she soon faces one trying day that tests her optimism at every turn.

programme.title: The Great Buck Howard
programme.desc: Defying his father and dropping out of law school, aspiring writer Troy Gable looks for a way to gain some meaningful life experience. Troy gets that and more when he takes a job with Buck Howard, a vainglorious mentalist who hopes to reinvigorate his fading career by staging a big comeback.

programme.title: Permanent
programme.desc: Aurelie, 13, dreams about getting a perm so that she can finally fit in at her small-town Virginia school. Things soon go incredibly wrong when her clueless parents bring her to a beauty school to save a few bucks.

programme.title: Deadfall
programme.desc: En route to Canada with stolen casino loot, a thief (Olivia Wilde) separates from her brother (Eric Bana) and falls in with a boxer (Charlie Hunnam) who's on his way home for Thanksgiving.

programme.title: First Date
programme.desc: Conned into buying a shady '65 Chrysler, shy teen Mike's eagerly anticipated first date with the girl next door, Kelsey, implodes as he finds himself targeted by criminals, cops and a crazy cat lady. A night fueled by desire, bullets and burning rubber makes any other first date seem like a walk in the park.

programme.title: Tyrel
programme.desc: Tyler spirals out of control when he realizes he's the only black person attending a weekend birthday party in a secluded cabin.

programme.title: Frances Ferguson
programme.desc: A substitute teacher's crushing discontent drives her to an ill-advised transgression.

programme.title: What Just Happened?
programme.desc: During the course of an ordinary week in Hollywood, movie producer Ben must navigate his way through shark-infested waters as he struggles to complete his latest projects. A demanding studio boss demands extensive changes to a movie starring Sean Penn, while another chief won't greenlight a project unless star Bruce Willis shaves his beard. Meanwhile, Ben tries to reconcile with his wife and maintain a relationship with his young daughter.

programme.title: Take This Waltz
programme.desc: A young woman (Michelle Williams) is torn between the husband (Seth Rogen) that she loves and a new man (Luke Kirby) in her life, whom she's unable to ignore.

programme.title: Infinity Baby
programme.desc: A man works for a company called Infinity Baby, which is tasked with farming out 3-month-old babies who don't age.

programme.title: The Magic of Belle Isle
programme.desc: An alcoholic, disabled novelist finds his muse again after he moves into a lakeside cabin and meets a single mother and her daughters.

programme.title: The Hunter
programme.desc: A shadowy corporation sends a mercenary (Willem Dafoe) to Tasmania to track down a nearly extinct tiger whose genetic code holds the secret to a dangerous weapon.

programme.title: The Canyon
programme.desc: A honeymooning couple has to survive in the Grand Canyon after getting lost.

programme.title: Mister America
programme.desc: Despite being completely inexperienced and broke and having just defeated a murder charge, a man mounts a campaign to unseat the San Bernardino district attorney.

programme.title: Frank
programme.desc: An aspiring musician (Domhnall Gleeson) finds himself way out of his element after he joins a pop group led by an enigmatic figure (Michael Fassbender) who wears a giant fake head.

programme.title: The Right Kind of Wrong
programme.desc: A stubborn idealist (Ryan Kwanten) spies a bride (Sara Canning) on her way to her wedding and immediately falls in love with her.

programme.title: Diggers
programme.desc: During the 1970s as corporate fisheries began snatching up water rights around the Hamptons, independent clammers Hunt and his friends could do little else but watch their way of life slip away. While members of the group look for ways to cope, Hunt begins a summer romance with a young vacationer.

programme.title: The Double
programme.desc: An awkward office drone (Jesse Eisenberg) becomes increasingly unhinged after a charismatic and confident look-alike takes a job at his workplace and seduces the woman (Mia Wasikowska) he desires.

programme.title: The Last Days on Mars
programme.desc: Astronauts (Liev Schreiber, Elias Koteas, Romola Garai) on Mars contend with a microbe that turns those it infects into zombielike killers.

programme.title: Centurion
programme.desc: In ancient Scotland, the Ninth Legion liberates a Roman officer named Quintus Dias (Michael Fassbender) from his Pict captors. The soldiers are in pursuit of the Pict leader, and Quintus joins their quest. Soon afterward, the Romans' Pict guide betrays them, resulting in the slaughter of all but a handful of men. The Roman survivors try desperately to reach safety, as the indigenous warriors pick them off one by one.

programme.title: Jack & Diane
programme.desc: Diane's feelings for Jack, the girl she met over the summer, begin to manifest themselves in terrifying ways when she learns that her friend will soon be moving away.

programme.title: How I Live Now
programme.desc: As conflict in Europe escalates, an American teen (Saoirse Ronan) fights to survive in the English countryside.

programme.title: Thomas / Sherman V. Castello
programme.desc: A woman believes her aunt is blinded by grief on the paternity of a child born after her brother's death.

programme.title: McKinney v. Brown
programme.desc: A husband believes more than a sex tape was produced when his wife slept with another man.

programme.title: Lillard V. Holt / Holt

programme.title: The Caribbean: The Wild Side of Paradise
programme.desc: Between the continents of North and South America is a tropical paradise: the Caribbean. This archipelago of over 7,000 islands and reefs lies within the crystal clear waters of the Caribbean Sea. From just a few metres wide, to hundreds of kilometres across, every island is different, and each has its own unique wildlife.

programme.title: British Garden: Life And Death On Your Lawn
programme.desc: The British back garden is a familiar setting, but underneath the peonies and petunias is a much wilder hidden world, a miniature Serengeti, with beauty and brutality in equal measure. In this 90-minute documentary Chris Packham and a team of wildlife experts spend an entire year exploring every inch of a series of interlinked back gardens in Welwyn Garden City. They want to answer a fundamental question: how much wildlife lives beyond our back doors?

programme.title: Trophy hunting - just killing or conservation?
programme.desc: Hannah Emde tries to illuminate the subject of trophy hunting from all sides. She talks to the Khwe chief, villagers and game guards in the Zambezi region. She meets a trophy hunter and follows the topic back to Germany, where she exchanges ideas with Izak Smit, the Chairperson of Desert Lions Human Relations Aid, Delhra in short.

programme.title: Galapagos: Darwin's Eden
programme.desc: Situated 1,000km west of Ecuador in South America, the Galapagos archipelago contains 13 main islands and a hundred or so smaller rocks and reefs. The region's wilderness is so pristine and rich in life it altered our entire view of the natural world. It was the Galapagos islands' finches and mockingbirds that proved key to Darwin's theory of evolution.

programme.title: The Fragile Islands/Andaman
programme.desc: What seems calm and tranquil may not necessarily be so. Under the tranquility there maybe a vibrant dynamic world and above water there maybe dangers which are lurking at very corner. Mahatma Gandhi Marine National Park is one such. In the Andaman Islands a group of 15 islands make up this fragile eco system. Coral, is one of the most productive and endangered wild fauna in the shallow coastal waters.

programme.title: Rhino Rescue Cote d'Ivoire
programme.desc: In the heart of the Ivory Coast a small rural village has a very special resident. The last white rhino in the country sleeps on the village outskirts and feeds on the villagers' crops. He's survived a gunshot to the shoulder and a decade of civil war, and he's something of a celebrity here. But all is not well. The rhino has killed the chief of the village, and it's time for him to go.

programme.title: The Marine Ecosystem
programme.desc: Costa Rica is home to some of the richest marine ecosystems in the world; biologists and conservationists have undertaken a race against time to better understand and protect marine ecosystems.

programme.title: Return of the Shan/Hemis
programme.desc: Snow Leopard is the one of the most elusive big cats in the world. This episode details how the wildlife guards and the wildlife department has set up conservation and scientific plans to protect and indeed to enumerate and increase it's population. For the first time we see the radio collaring operations of the big cats and also the very rare Lynx. The episode also shows how the guards live and work in these tough terrains sometimes even by putting their lives in danger.

programme.title: Wild Wolverine
programme.desc: To many the wolverine is the stuff of movie superheroes. To others they are a creature of myth and legend. They look like a weird hybrid between wolf, bear and skunk and are some of the toughest, strongest and most aggressive animals around. In the sub-arctic forests of Siberia survival is an expert skill. The creatures of the far north strike a delicate balance and must show ingenuity and cunning if they are to survive.

programme.title: Fight for Territory
programme.desc: Biological instinct is driven by three things: the desire to stay alive, to find food and to breed. But to do all these things, animals first need a home. Out in the wilderness a safe place to call home can be the difference between life and death. A place to secure meals, raise their families and hide from danger. Ideal spots are in short supply and well worth fighting for!

programme.title: July
programme.desc: As schools break up for summer and kids can play in meadows amid poppies and singing sky larks, wildlife around the world has very different stories to tell. Lemmings are going crazy. On the Arctic tundra, the ground's frozen for most of the year, now they need to make the most of the time of plenty. But the giving summer heat is too much in southern Spain, where pools are drying out leaving fish high and dry, a feast for herons.

programme.title: Icy Coast
programme.desc: Cold coasts create challenging landscapes for all wildlife. It's hard to believe that these freezing oceans can be bringers of life. In fact, cold water holds onto oxygen much better than warm, encouraging aquatic activity. Great eagles hunt abundant marine life in the bleak northern hemisphere whilst cold water corals thrive off the nutrient rich currents passing through their reefs, and massive elephant seals fight for territory off the coast of Australia.

programme.title: Beaver Lumberjacks
programme.desc: Anchorage has a rather unique resident who is renowned as nature's lumberjack and North Americas largest rodent, the beaver. With their powerful teeth the trees they fell can be huge and their dams can be so enormous they can be seen from space. But since humans arrived here, many beavers have been forced to live in an urban jungle! And as the Wild City of Anchorage expands, that means more people, more cars, and the biggest risk to the beavers, dogs!

programme.title: Artic Refuge
programme.desc: Alaska one of the last true wildernesses on earth. With 600 square miles of pristine habitat this state is home to an abundance of wildlife. Herds of caribou roam the plains, wolves stalk in the forest and the brown bears are the kings of the rivers. But you don't always have to head to the wild to come face to face with an animal. In the city of Anchorage the wildlife is a lot closer than you think, because a city with so much green space means everywhere is fair game for its wild neighbours.

programme.title: Naledi: A Baby Elephant's Tale
programme.desc: Under a blanket of stars on an African night, in the serene grasslands of Botswana's Okavango Delta, something rarely witnessed by humankind is about to happen: the much-anticipated birth of a baby elephant. An emotional life-or-death drama that champions the struggle of Africa's native elephant population, Naledi: A Baby Elephant's Tale tells the urgent story of an international crisis.

programme.title: Coasts - Life's a Beach
programme.desc: To us the beach is one giant playground, but for wildlife it's a place to live, to find food and to raise their young. Amongst the fish and chips, sandcastles and donkey rides it's easy to forget that beaches are vital habitats, home to a myriad of animals. Whether grey seals are duelling for a mate and raising their young, or black bears and tigers are scouring the coastline for a tasty snack, animals have been using the beach for millennia.

programme.title: Jungle of Asia
programme.desc: Some of the most beautiful rainforest, jungle landscape and wildlife are in Asia. The rainforests of Asia stretch from India and Burma in the west to Malaysia and the islands of Java and Borneo in the east. The Great teak forests and Jungles in Asia have long been under threat from intensive logging and industrial farming of cash crops. Slash and burn agriculture has also taken a heavy toll on the eco-structure and environment. Bangladesh has the largest mangrove forests in the world.

programme.title: Open Ocean
programme.desc: It might look uniform from the air, as we fly over it, but the oceans are deep and varied. The underwater landscape is made up of continental shelves, volcanoes, mountains, valleys, trenches and large, flat plains similar to the landscape on land only on a much larger scale. Ocean habitats come in all forms. Under water creatures make homes wherever survival is assured.

programme.title: Westlands
programme.desc: Large areas of water, broken up by small islands. Massive vegetation. Swamps, wetlands, marshes, bogs and fens are found all over the world, generally in more temperate regions where there is fast vegetation growth. Many of the larger animals that inhabit swamps and wetlands have a fish-based diet. LARGE CRABS dwell in the salt-water swamps, along with SNAPPING TURTLES and even CROCODILES AND ALLIGATORS. LIZARDS AND AMPHIBIANS live in and around the water's edge.

programme.title: Desert
programme.desc: Deserts - dry, arid landscapes, environments of intense sun, heat and very little rain. The desert is extreme. An extre-me climate and an extreme environment where wild life has had to adapt to survive. Many of the animals that live in deserts have adopted a nocturnal lifestyle, surfacing only at night when it is cooler.

programme.title: Mammal Takeover
programme.desc: With the dinosaurs' passing, a land of opportunity was laid bare for the little mammals that had scampered about their feet.

programme.title: Mountains - Gateways to Heaven
programme.desc: Mountains define our most spectacular landscapes. As they climb the changing altitude results in a mosaic of dramatic habitats, teaming with incredible wildlife. They're found on every continent on Earth, literally from pole to pole, covering 22% of the planet's surface. An incredibly important part of our ecosystem, a quarter of terrestrial animal and plant species, live in mountains and they house an incredible 85% of all amphibians, mammals and birds.

programme.title: Incredible Journeys
programme.desc: Whether by wing, fin or hoof, epic migrations are among nature's most awe-inspiring events. Animals undertake these arduous journeys, for many reasons: to find a mate, to give birth, or to move to new feeding grounds. And danger lurks at every turn. In this episode we discover the lengths they go to in order to survive.

programme.title: Turtle Tales
programme.desc: Ever wondered how to look after dozens of tiny turtles? This episode of An Aquatic Life will show you just that! Meet the turtle team and their amazing ambassadors, Bob, Sandy and the monstrous loggerhead, Yoshi! The collections team is running at half capacity while most of the team members collect Ragged-Toothed Sharks in East London for the upcoming predator exhibit... But with a colossal storm en route to the city of Cape Town, will it all be ready for their arrival?

programme.title: Meet the Meerkats
programme.desc: Meerkats live in close families and rely on their companions to watch their backs. In their vast and unforgiving home of the Namib desert, only together can they defeat the odds stacked against them. One young female is forced from her group, overcoming a brutal attack from the alpha pair and fearing for her life. Cast out and left to fend for herself, she has no choice but to roam the desert and find a way to live.

programme.title: Rise of the Giants
programme.desc: In the great story of life, reptiles were one of the first major players. For 180 million years they ruled the land, seas and skies - this was the rise of the giants.

programme.title: March
programme.desc: As northern forests become carpeted by bluebells and wood anemones, and damp corners become singles bars for frogs and a toads, hailing the first hint of spring sun, South Africa needs a break from the heat, fire season is in full swing, threatening the fynbos and the extraordinary animals living in them. Ground squirrels get inventive to find shade. Gray whales migrate up the Californian coast, passing colonies of sea otters. March is a month of change

programme.title: The Inner Workings
programme.desc: Join us as we delve into the inner workings of the Two Oceans Aquarium and meet the team who keep the machine running! Learn how they cater for hundreds of different dietary requirements, how they keep up with the demand of life-giving water and meet the new arrivals to the aquarium; from the six-legged spider crabs of Japan, to the tiny turtles in need of rehabilitation. We'll move behind the glass to reveal the secrets of Africa's premier Aquarium!

programme.title: Of elephant & trackers
programme.desc: Hannah Emde meets one of Africa's most experienced elephant trackers: Hendrick Munembome, the Director of Elephant Human Relations Aid (EHRA). The struggle for water often makes elephants and humans rivals in Namibia. Therefore, EHRA builds water wells for the elephants with volunteers from all over the world, far away from the villages. Hannah helps dig a ditch for a pipeline, then heads up the dry Ugab riverbed in search of the endangered Mama Afrika' herd.

programme.title: Hidden Japan
programme.desc: The culture of Japan is incredible. But there are also more than 130 mammals and 600 bird species dwelling in Japan's 6,852 islands.

programme.title: Forest High Life
programme.desc: Who doesn't love a peaceful, relaxing walk in the woods? A green bath in nature, one that some-times leads to exciting glimpses of wild animals going about their daily lives. But no matter how hard we look, we are missing the action; it goes right over our heads - literally! The leafy shade that makes forests so cool, shady and relaxing also hides a vast community head and shoulders above the rest. But this is the canopy, a habitat that holds the most wonderful animal diversity.

programme.title: Polar Bear Family
programme.desc: We have a complex relationship with polar bears. One of the most loved creatures in the world, we see them as cute and funny but at the same time as dangerous top predators. One of the few that might actually hunt us. They are the ultimate icons of polar wilderness and have become figureheads for climate change and conservation. One thing is for sure, the lives of polar bears are nothing short of remarkable.

programme.title: New Arrivals
programme.desc: The poaching crisis intensifies and poachers turn their attention to orphanages. After losing her mother, four-week-old Jamila finally finds sanctuary at The Rhino Orphanage. She's not the only newby as Nox the bushbaby, and new volunteers are around to keep her company.

programme.title: Caribou: Extreme Survivors
programme.desc: There are more Caribou in Alaska than people! Across the Arctic, they're the lifeblood of many remote communities. But human expansion, and wild predators, have led to their rapid decline. Out on the tundra, Caribou are the prey of choice for Alaska's carnivores, and at a ranch on the edge of Anchorage, the reindeer are at constant risk from the area's wolves and brown bears. The people of Anchorage have vowed to protect them, but will their help be enough for the Caribou to survive?

programme.title: Europe's Living Waters
programme.desc: The story of Europe's living waters begins at great altitude. Melt waters from the highest snow-capped peaks feed some of the greatest rivers. On their relentless downward journey, streams and rivers have carved through all of Europe's greatest landscapes. Gorges, lakes and wetlands are home to an incredible array of wildlife and seas and oceans have sculpted a coastline of endless variety.

programme.title: Life In The Seas
programme.desc: Our planet is one of oceans, and it was this great mass of water that gave birth to Earth's greatest creation - life

programme.title: Wild Madagascar - Fantastic Creatures
programme.desc: Madagascar is located roughly 250 miles from Africa's Southeast Coast. It is roughly the size of France, making it the world's fourth largest island. Isolated from the African mainland for over 160 million years, more than 250,000 different species of animal can be found here; 70% of which are found nowhere else on the planet. Madagascar supports the third largest coral reef system in the world; the Toliara reef system.

programme.title: Wolves on Main Street
programme.desc: For years, at least four highly elusive wolfpacks have lived and hunted on the edge of the wild city of Anchorage. But as the city spreads further and further into wolf country, the wolves are now getting bolder, and attacks on humans are on the increase. A group was recently targeted whilst jogging with their dog on a trail near one of the city's main roads.

programme.title: Hidden Australia
programme.desc: Sometimes called the biggest island on Earth, Australia is a subcontinent of incredible diversity, beauty, danger and downright weirdness.

programme.title: Hidden Germany
programme.desc: A dramatic country steeped in history and ancient culture, it's easy to focus on Germany's great cities and landmarks. But Germany also has a more hidden treasure-trove, one full of natural wonders

programme.title: Journey to Land
programme.desc: As the first landmasses emerged from prehistoric seas, animals took their first steps on dry land. The explosion of life that followed changed the world forever.

programme.title: Among cheetahs
programme.desc: Hannah Emde meets the most famous big cat researcher in the world. Dr. Laurie Marker is the founder of the Cheetah Conservation Fund (CCF), which has set the global benchmark for cheetah conservation. Hannah spends a day at the CCF center near Otjivarongo, gets very close to the big cats in the enclosure and is impressed by the simple, but effective concept of protecting these animals.

programme.title: Elephants - Changing Lives
programme.desc: Living for over half a century, elephants see the world change around them as they grow. They say an elephant never forgets; if we could enter the massive brain of a veteran elephant, what would we see? Imagine one elephant to represent them all, giving us a unique glimpse into the remarkable life of these magnificent giants.

programme.title: April
programme.desc: aster, a time of babies, easter eggs are everywhere as birds get busy breeding, lambs dance around fields and cute baby bunnies emerge from their borrows. Migrants like ospreys and puffins return to their breeding sites. Migrants can come in all shapes and sizes and for different reasons. Hammerhead sharks swarm around Galapagos and take advantage of cleaning services on the reef.

programme.title: Master of the Sky
programme.desc: The masters of the sky are the winged predators of the aerial world. Whether swooping from altitude at phenomenal speed to strike an unsuspecting target from above, flicking and darting between trees in a lethal tail chase, or ghos-ting silently through the night in pursuit of prey, they excite our admiration and inspire awe in equal measure. All are superbly adapted to hunting and masters of their position at the top of the food chain.

programme.title: Fresh Waters
programme.desc: Lakes and rivers are created by streams high in the mountains. Fresh water springs, rain drawn up as moisture from the oceans, and melting snow all ebb, rush and flow down into our rivers and streams. Streams, rivers and lakes are home to countless animal species. A wide variety of species from insects, to amphibians, repti-les, fish, birds and even mammals are found in rivers, lakes and streams all around the world.

programme.title: American Mountains
programme.desc: Wildlife that inhabits mountainous regions has be able to survive successfully at high altitudes. Any creature that lives in the mountains must also be able to cope with changing temperatures. Many species of hoofed and herbivorous mammal such as GOATS, DEER, SHEEP AND LLAMAS have adapted well to living high in the mountains and are often found grazing on ledges and on cliff faces. These herbivores in turn attract large predators such as BEARS, COUGARS AND MOUNTAIN LIONS.

programme.title: Madagascar
programme.desc: Islands come in all shapes and sizes all over the world. Any land mass surrounded by water is an island. They are found in seas, oceans lakes and rivers. Atolls, Islets, keys or cays are formed either as result of land brea-king away, water encroaching on the land, or by volcanic eruptions on the sea bed . Islands are often isolated, which leads to the development of a unique flora, fauna and wildlife. The environmental eco-structure of islands differs widely, as does the wildlife.

programme.title: Marine Mammals - Born to Swim
programme.desc: Every year some 15 million of us around the world cram onto little boats and head out onto the ocean, hoping for the encounter of a lifetime. For centuries whales and dolphins seem to have reached out to us, capturing our imaginations and our souls. Despite their popularity, much of their lives remain a mystery, taking place beneath the waves and beyond our reach.

programme.title: Cook Islands/ Kūki ''Airani
programme.desc: It's a miracle the first seafarers ever found the Cook Islands/ Kūki 'Airani scattered across two million square kilometres of the Pacific Ocean. But every year, these tropical islands become the destination for over three thousand Humpback whales who've undertaken one of the longest migrations on the planet. They come here to socialise, mate, and raise their young.

programme.title: The Power Of Plants - Race to Grow and Breed
programme.desc: Just like animals, the lives of plants are dominated by the need to become strong and pass on genes to the next generation - a race to grow and breed. They must race to beat their competition to the best light spots, and to make the most of perilously short seasons. And also like in the animal kingdom, different species have developed a near unending list of strategies to ensure their legacy is passed on.

programme.title: The Battle of the Horn/Kaziranga
programme.desc: Rhino horn is very expensive in the illegal market and the poachers know it. Kaziranga has the only concentrated population of the one horned Rhino in the world. And poachers are attracted to Kaziranga like ants are to sugar. The primary work of the forest department here is to then protect the rhino from the poachers and save the horn. We meet forest guard Shanti Ram Chetri who after 33 years of glorious service retires.

programme.title: Episode 002
programme.desc: Owls - with their huge eyes, flat faces and distinctive hoot - they are truly iconic!creatures. But how much do we really know about these mysterious nocturnal birds? We're about to find out as we follow the fate of new born baby owls as they grow up and learn to fly.

programme.title: Rumble in the Jungle
programme.desc: In this episode we explore why and how animals fight and reveal the ways in which they are programmed to survive at all costs. Most animals will defend themselves against predators, but many also do battle with members of the same species. Animals fight for two main reasons: for a mate or to defend their young or territory. And when animals fight, it can often be to the death.

programme.title: The reclaimed forest/Pakke
programme.desc: Hunting has been a long-standing cultural tradition in the North Eastern India for long. But with the shirking of the forests and endangering of the wildlife, hunting has become unsustainable. But it is not that this has stopped hunting. The architects of Pakke, a 800 sq Kms forest reserve, in the heart of the hunting villages has done a wonderful job of giving protection to the several endemic species here by keeping the forest safe from the hunters.

programme.title: Animals of Thanksgiving
programme.desc: Thanksgiving. A most treasured holiday, and not just in the USA; it continues to be celebrated across the world in many different guises. These traditions are all united by a celebration of the harvest and the generosity of the natural world. Many animals have weird and wonderful connections to the holidays. Turkeys are one of the most iconic characters, but deer, lobsters and even eagles are also part of the feast.

programme.title: The Hebrides: Land of Legends
programme.desc: Lying just off the coast of west Scotland, the Hebrides archipelago is made up of more than 500 islands and islets. Isolation from the mainland has made it the perfect breeding ground for millions of creatures, making it home to some of the largest gatherings, and greatest spectacles on the planet.

programme.title: The fear of the Stripes/Sunderbans
programme.desc: The Royal Bengal Tiger is in it's most primeval form here in the Sunderbans. `The tangled mangroves along the tributaries of the river Ganga are one of the most fearsome forests of the World. The tigers could kill humans and eat them. The people living around the forests are also one of the poorest in the country. They have to go inside the forest to eke out a living by catching crabs and fish. And that's the opportunity the tiger may seek.

programme.title: Wild Indochinas - Wild heart
programme.desc: Indochina; three ancient kingdoms, Laos, Vietnam and Cambodia, linked by one great river: the mighty Mekong. A mystical land shaped by the forces of the monsoon. A region ravaged by war but, like a Phoenix, risen from the ashes. Within its boundaries can be found one tenth of the world's species, and some of the richest ecosystems on the planet. This is the land of the Mother River, one of the most bio diverse regions on Earth.

programme.title: City of Dogs
programme.desc: Bred from wolves, Huskies have helped humans carve out an existence in Alaska's desolate wilderness. These dogs still maintain many physical adaptations of their wild ancestors, enabling them to withstand the fierce conditions of the Alaskan winter. And in Alaska's most extreme terrain, sled dogs are still the only form of transport. In the south, the modern city of Anchorage is still home to the start of the World's Toughest Race, a 1000 mile sled-dog race, known as the Iditarod.

programme.title: The Season's Feast
programme.desc: On the savannah of southern Africa, rains have turned the land green and lush. It's the time of plenty and for the cast of wild characters here, cashing in is priority number one. From polecat to aardwolf, some of the continent's most seldom seen creatures are out to make the most of the abundance. Some families gorge on the plentiful grasses, while for others there's no such thing as an easy meal, even at this time of year.

programme.title: Manatees on the Move
programme.desc: Manatees, sea cows, these gentle giants go by several names. They were once thought to be beautiful mermaids that could lure sailors to their deaths, though they probably won't win too many beauty contests. To retain their weight, manatees need to eat for 8 hours and consume 8% of their bodyweight every day. And keeping eating also means keeping moving - but though always on the move they're not exactly speedy.

programme.title: Seals - Clowns of the Sea
programme.desc: Much loved clowns of the sea, seals are endlessly fascinating. Even though they're not much more than bloated sausages on land, they're agile hunters and supremely graceful in the water. They en-tertain us with dramatic courtships, an endlessly playful sense of curiosity and some of the cutest babies on the planet.

programme.title: Snares/Tini Heke
programme.desc: Deep in the Southern Ocean, the Snares islands are one of the most pristine island wildernesses left on the planet. Every summer, millions of seabirds converge here to breed. More than 50,000 endemic Snares crested penguins battle massive Southern Ocean swells to come ashore. Deep in the forest they find their mates and raise their chicks in a frantic race to take advantage of the short subantarctic summer.

programme.title: Animal Record Breakers
programme.desc: We love to measure aspects of life at its extremes. The biggest, the tallest, heaviest, fastest, slowest - even the rarest. The creatures that hold the records for these categories are some of the most interesting in the natural world. Some are familiar and iconic, but it's also important to recognise some of the more surprising record breakers. These quirky and unusual animals that often go ignored are inventive, ingenious and awe-inspiring.

programme.title: Hunt or die
programme.desc: This episode explores nature's deadliest killers. From a tiny but deadly insect, to a pod of hungry Orca's, predators come in all sizes, and are found on every continent on earth. Chasing, stalking, ambushing or using camouflage, the way each predator hunts, catches and kills food is determined by many factors, including the anatomical adaptations of both the predator and the prey.

programme.title: Hidden UK
programme.desc: For its tiny size the UK is a hugely varied landscape with a surprising collection of remarkable and awe-inspiring wildlife.
