programme.title: Introducing the Kindig CF1
programme.desc: Dave and the team put the finishing touches on the first-ever Kindig CF Corvettes to complete a lifelong dream; however, the clients argue about who will get the first one, all in advance of a once-in-a-lifetime debut at SEMA.

programme.title: How We Got Here
programme.desc: Dave and Kevin, who have been an absolute treat for automotive enthusiasts for years, come back to the SEMA show with something special on their minds.

programme.title: Strawberry Rolls Forever
programme.desc: A Beatles fanatic challenges Dave to paint a modern Rolls-Royce to match the car John Lennon commissioned in the late 1960s.

programme.title: New York, New York
programme.desc: Dave and Kev take the show as far east as they have ever gone and head to Lake George, New York, for the Adirondack Nationals; the town shuts down for the car show, attracting some of the best on the east coast.

programme.title: The Pantera of the Future
programme.desc: A 1970s Pantera is an iconic sports car, but once Dave gets his hands on it, the style will never be the same; the client has given Dave free rein to change the car as he sees fit, but has one request: he is 6'4" and can't comfortably get in it.

programme.title: Not So Subtle
programme.desc: With the whole team in agreement over the body mods, the crew must make the designs into reality; their list of tasks include bulging out the fenders, creating a spider-shaped exhaust, executing the stretch and getting the car to body.

programme.title: Now That Is a Bitchin' Ride
programme.desc: The Pantera is almost done, but nothing is simple with this car; Dave and Kev get a chance to upgrade their semi rig.

programme.title: Holley Carb Tuning Tips
programme.desc: Carb whisperer Steve Brule has tips to get a Holley 4150 running its best.

programme.title: Slant-Six Manifold Shootout!!
programme.desc: Dulcich tests four aftermarket intake manifolds on his 225ci slant six.

programme.title: Rectangle vs. Cathedral Ports
programme.desc: The guys test which type of cylinder head delivers more power.

programme.title: The Battle of Gen III Hemis
programme.desc: We're battling the two most recent iterations of the 5.7 III Hemi.

programme.title: SBF Intake Shootout!
programme.desc: The Windsor family finally gets its turn at an intake shootout!

programme.title: Solid Lifter Cam Comparo
programme.desc: The guys debate if a solid roller camshaft is worth the extra money.

programme.title: Manifolds or Headers?
programme.desc: We run our LS with factory exhaust manifolds and again with turbo headers.

programme.title: Does Fuel Temperature Matter?
programme.desc: The guys deliberately heat and cool fuel to see the difference it makes.

programme.title: Measuring the Max Wedge
programme.desc: The guys find out if Max Wedge heads are really a worthwhile upgrade.

programme.title: Do Header Wraps Work?
programme.desc: We find out whether header wraps really do create more power.

programme.title: Which Ram? All the Rams?!
programme.desc: The guys test out a bunch of Holley's "Ram" intakes on their 6.2-liter LS.

programme.title: Manifold Shootout
programme.desc: We test six manifolds with our old-school carb and our new-school 6.0 LS.

programme.title: Exhaust Cutouts
programme.desc: The guys see if exhaust cutouts do more than rattle passersby's eardrums.

programme.title: Every Trick in the Book
programme.desc: The crew super-tunes every HP out of the 410 Windsor from the Disgustang.

programme.title: Low Buck SBC Head Shootout
programme.desc: The guys test out three low-buck cylinder heads on a 383 small-block Chevy.

programme.title: Pick-a-Carb Shootout
programme.desc: The guys test how different carb features affect horsepower and tunability.

programme.title: Single Pattern vs. Split
programme.desc: The guys challenge their previous findings testing single-pattern cams.

programme.title: Oil Pumps for Power?!
programme.desc: The guys see if too much oil pressure robs precious horsepower.

programme.title: Quest for F-Rod Greatness
programme.desc: The guys try to boost an 800-horspower 572 up to a comfortable 950+.

programme.title: Six Pack Shootout!
programme.desc: The guys shoot out six packs on a 440 to see which makes the most power.

programme.title: Magic of the Flex Fuel Sensor
programme.desc: The guys figure out how to make more power with a flex fuel engine.

programme.title: The Leaker Episode
programme.desc: The guys see whether boost and vacuum leaks actually affect power.

programme.title: Wet vs. Dry Nitrous
programme.desc: The guys see how wet and dry nitrous systems stack up on an EFI manifold.

programme.title: Carb v. EFI Multipoint Edition
programme.desc: Multipoint EFI gets its turn against the venerable Dominator.

programme.title: Blown v. NA
programme.desc: A supercharged medium-sized mill takes on a naturally aspirated big block.

programme.title: Tunnel Ram Battle
programme.desc: The crew pits a four-barrel carb against dual quads on the tunnel ram.

programme.title: How Hard Can a Hardtop Be?
programme.desc: A 1971 Chevy Nova with tremendous pedigree arrives at the shop to get classic Kindig-It styling cues; Dave wants to make this car into a hardtop; tucked-in bumpers, front valance and a new engine provide a good test for the crew.

programme.title: The Gentleman's Hot Rod
programme.desc: Will makes miracles happen, and Dave decides to make a wholesale change to the car's color; challenges mount at each stage of the build, and the upholstery shop changes up their routine as the client arrives for a reveal years in the making.

programme.title: Just Pick a Color
programme.desc: While the shop perfects its process in building the CF1s, word about the car spreads and potential buyers line up; the latest client has a big problem when he can't choose the perfect color combination.

programme.title: Blue Suede Cruise
programme.desc: Dave and Kev take the show to the Midwest, as more than 2,500 cars descend on the Summit Motorsports drag strip for a weekend of fun; Kev gets a ride in a lean, mean drag racing machine; Dave steps up his autocross game.

programme.title: A Bitchin' Mission
programme.desc: A client enlists Dave on a mission from God to make his dreams of a father/son road trip along Route 66 come true; getting the client's mechanically unsound reproduction of the Bluesmobile ready for the road will test the crew's mettle.

programme.title: Starry Starry Night
programme.desc: Kevin Schiele breathes new life into a semi-hauler by giving it a visual and functional upgrade that impeccably reflects his expertise in trucks.

programme.title: The Kindig Academy
programme.desc: Training the next-generation car builders is near and dear to Dave's heart, and after years of planning, he's finally realized his passion project, the Kindig Academy.

programme.title: Is There Anything Good on It?
programme.desc: A 1969 Camaro comes in; when Dave and team get a closer look, they determine with the owner that it requires a full rebuild; since the team will be starting from scratch, the client decides to go all-out on the chassis, engine and details.

programme.title: Mean, Green and Bitchin'
programme.desc: With the Camaro's design firmed up, the build continues, but hits a roadblock when it comes to getting the engine dialed in just right; Dave has second thoughts about the color combination.

programme.title: There's a Bolt in My Motor
programme.desc: A simple engine repair slowly turns into a patented Kindig slippery slope, as a show-ready 1935 Roadster V8 requires a full rebuild.

programme.title: Rumble in the Rockies
programme.desc: The shop hits the road to check out the competition; Will and Dave's cousin Brad comes along for the ride to share their view on the cars they come across; they team up to challenge Dave in an autocross.

programme.title: Super Charged and Super Secret
programme.desc: The 1955 Nomad is an iconic car, but the original power isn't enough for the current owner, who wants the guys to put a blower on to boost the power; a new project for a secret client arrives in pretty rough shape, but emerges ready to rumble.

programme.title: Deadliest Car
programme.desc: A new client, Rick Mezich from "Deadliest Catch," tests Dave's design prowess on his CF1, while the upholstery shop shows off some of the new processes it has developed to streamline the builds.

programme.title: Hum-Dinger
programme.desc: Off-road vehicles are few and far between at the shop, but when they do arrive, Dave and the guys love to go all out; this particular Hummer gets a huge conversion from two-wheel drive to four-wheel, a new LS engine, interior and a fresh paint job.

programme.title: Concours d'Ele-Bitchin'
programme.desc: The shop has a busy week prepping for the 2022 SEMA show in Las Vegas, Nevada; once in Vegas, Dave and Kev attend the first-ever concours d'elegance at the famous Wynn hotel and golf course, where their knowledge of cars will be pushed to its limits.

programme.title: Everything But the Kitchen Sink
programme.desc: As the workshop buzzes with activities, the latest CF1 becomes a new challenge for the team, as Dave makes alterations to the original.

programme.title: Automotive Oasis
programme.desc: Scottsdale is about to witness one of the fiercest competitions at the last car show of the year; Dave gets all the help he needs with his toolbox.

programme.title: A Rusty Mess
programme.desc: The shop preps for the 2022 SEMA show in Las Vegas; Dave and Kev attend the first concours d'elegance, which pushes their knowledge of cars to the limits.

programme.title: Heavy Metal
programme.desc: Getting the hood just right proves tricky and the guys invent a new process to make it work; the body work on this truck is where the art of the build truly comes out.

programme.title: The Bitchin' C10
programme.desc: The C10 moves into final assembly, but getting the bed to fit perfectly and dialing in the new air ride are a challenge; the upholstery runs into one problem after another.

programme.title: Diesel Little Red Express
programme.desc: Building a 1979 Little Red Express from a Cummins diesel on out, including compound turbos; down the block from Ekstensive, the father-son team at Wide Open Garage builds a Samurai lake crosser from the ground up.

programme.title: Samurai and the Gladiator
programme.desc: The father-son team at Wide Open Garage have their hands full converting a rusted shell of a Suzuki Samurai into a rock-crawling mega-truck; a customer arrives at Mod Mafia with a big problem: their Jeep Gladiator isn't safe to drive.

programme.title: Humvee Overlander
programme.desc: Mod Mafia transforms a fire-damaged M1038 Humvee ambulance into an extreme camping overlander; the Wide Open Garage team builds a bulletproof race car for the appropriately billed Death Car Race, in which drivers are blindfolded.

programme.title: '47 Ford Turbo
programme.desc: A request about a 1947 Ford truck becomes 1 Way Diesel Performance's next ground-up build; Mod Mafia jumps into uncharted territory with a Viper ACRX race car.

programme.title: Fishing, Hunting Chevy Truck
programme.desc: Looking into what happens if a Cummins diesel engine is put into a 2004 Lamborghini Gallardo; a customer wants Wide Open Garage to turn an old, rusted Chevy truck into a lifted, all-terrain truck on huge 74-inch tires.

programme.title: Cummins Diesel in a Lambo
programme.desc: Putting a twin-turbo Cummins into a 2004 Lamborghini Gallardo is a monster build unlike any other for 1 Way Diesel Performance; YouTube's "Unspeakable" star Nathan Graham asks Mod Mafia to help him out of a jam with his all-terrain, amphibious SHERP.

programme.title: Defender and Bronco
programme.desc: The 1991 Land Rover Defender is known for ruggedness and simplicity; Mod Mafia does a reboot of a tired, old Defender with modern performance, power and custom luxury; Wide Open Garage takes an old-school Bronco monster truck into overdrive.

programme.title: Hummer H1 King
programme.desc: Social media star Liver King not only wants Mod Mafia to beef up his prized 2001 H1 Hummer's performance, he wants to customize it for his primal lifestyle; the team at Wide Open Garage must build a custom off-road truck completely from scratch.

programme.title: Big '88 Silverado, Bigger '82 C10
programme.desc: Wide Open Garage's mega-truck build gets even bigger as they take an old-school '82 C10 square body and create a one-of-one show truck, monster truck; one Way Diesel Performance lives up to their name by giving an '88 Silverado more than 1,200 horsepower.

programme.title: '48 Power Wagon Supreme
programme.desc: 1 Way Diesel Performance is thrown a mega-curveball with a classic '48 Dodge Power Wagon; in a race pitting garage vs. garage, a 2,700hp diesel truck hits the line against a turbocharged first-generation Camaro.

programme.title: Carlos Carrasco's Ferrari 488
programme.desc: Alex customizes professional baseball player Carlos Carrasco's rare Ferrari 488 GTB; a 1975 International Harvester Scout gets a total overhaul.

programme.title: Cespedes' Mercedes GLE63
programme.desc: Alex customizes a high-performance Mercedes SUV for professional baseball player Yoenis Céspedes; a family converts a Mercedes Sprinter into a recreation room on wheels.

programme.title: Beto Perez's Lamborghini Aventador
programme.desc: Zumba fitness creator Beto Perez gets a customized 2017 Lamborghini Aventador; Miami construction mogul Aquino Melo has his work truck transformed into a luxurious ride.

programme.title: Corey Shapiro's Cadillac Fleetwood
programme.desc: Alex modernizes a vintage Cadillac Fleetwood to its former gangster glory for a fashion mogul specializing in celebrity eyewear; professional baseball player Alexei Ramirez gets a custom Jeep Wrangler supercharged.

programme.title: Teyana Taylor's Polaris Slingshot

programme.title: Ghosts of the Gallows
programme.desc: The Tennessee Wraith Chasers encounter the spirits of two infamous murderers at the Old Idaho Penitentiary; they follow the trail of one murder into Boise, Idaho, where they learn shocking details about the victim, crime and killer.

programme.title: Phantoms of the Frontier
programme.desc: The team heads to the "Gateway to the West" to face the spirits of madmen and murderers as they try to uncover what's behind the aggressive paranormal activity in Independence, Mo.

programme.title: Wraith Revenge
programme.desc: The Tennessee Wraith Chasers head to Wyoming to investigate a former frontier town infamous for the botched hanging of one of its most notorious criminals; some believe the Wild West outlaw is seeking revenge in the afterlife.

programme.title: Vigilante Vengeance
programme.desc: The Tennessee Wraith Chasers are in uncharted territory as they head to Montana for the first time to investigate the haunted streets of Virginia City, a Wild West town known for its excessive crime and mass hangings.

programme.title: Five Miles From Hell
programme.desc: The Tennessee Wraith Chasers head West to investigate haunted Port Townsend, Wash.; a history of crimes, curses and broken dreams have left behind dark and angry spirits who are ready to confront the team.

programme.title: Darkness in the Underworld
programme.desc: The Tennessee Wraith Chasers head to Pendleton, Ore., a forgotten town with a sordid past and a long-hidden underground secret; to uncover the darkness, the team navigates a maze of tunnels that lead to a mysterious underworld.

programme.title: Wrath of the Fire Goddess
programme.desc: The Tennessee Wraith Chasers experience terror as they investigate the town of Hilo, Hawaii; voices in underground lava tubes warn of impending danger on the Big Island, giving the team a new respect for the vengeful fire goddess Pele.

programme.title: Shepton Mallet Prison
programme.desc: Nick and Katrina spend 72 hours confined in one of the U.K.'s most notorious haunted hotspots, Shepton Mallet Prison; they investigate the spirits locked inside.

programme.title: Drakelow Tunnels
programme.desc: Nick and Katrina dive into the buried horrors of Drakelow Tunnels.

programme.title: The Royal Oak Pub
programme.desc: Nick and Katrina find what's troubling the spirits of the Royal Oak Pub.

programme.title: The Abandoned Park Hotel
programme.desc: Nick and Katrina explore the ghostly claims at the abandoned Park Hotel.

programme.title: The Skegness Hell House
programme.desc: A family hit by decades of hauntings calls Nick and Katrina for help; during their investigation, they find the activity may have an entirely unexpected origin.

programme.title: Newsham Park Hospital
programme.desc: Nick and Katrina have researched the haunting at Newsham Park Hospital for years; after 72 hours in the former orphanage, they question their preconceptions.

programme.title: Margam Castle
programme.desc: Nick and Katrina delve into the haunted past of the sacred Margam Castle.

programme.title: The Mill Street Barracks
programme.desc: Nick and Katrina pursue a negative presence in the haunted Mill Street Barracks; during their investigation, they are followed by an unexpected entity.

programme.title: The Kenton Theatre
programme.desc: For decades, staff and patrons of the Kenton Theatre have seen the spirit of a notorious local murderer; as investigations proceed, there could be more lurking in the wings than what was first thought.

programme.title: Hinchingbrooke House
programme.desc: The Hinchingbrooke estate has hosted English royalty and nobles, but it also reportedly harbors a horrific haunting.

programme.title: Glitch in Reality, Long Island Bigfoot and More
programme.desc: Glitches in the matrix stun spectators in Paris, Los Angeles and Argentina; a spirit attempts to halt construction on a family's home in the Philippines; a Bigfoot enthusiast captures something shocking in Long Island.

programme.title: Ghost Photobombs Kids and More
programme.desc: A mother's blood runs cold when a ghostly child photobombs a family picture in England; a shape-shifting alien sends a family running for cover in Mexico; a social media influencer finds a monster under her bed.

programme.title: Haunted Doll Bites Child and More
programme.desc: A possessed doll latches onto a little girl in Canada; extraterrestrial visitors stun a rugby team; siblings cross paths with a terrifying headless apparition.

programme.title: Shadow Figure Intruder and More
programme.desc: A shadow figure latches onto a first responder in Tennessee; a ghostly chef cooks up trouble at a Connecticut restaurant.

programme.title: Tormented Souls Trapped in Italy and More
programme.desc: A school in the Philippines houses spirits from an adjacent cemetery; shadow figures and phantom flames lurk within an abandoned brick factory in Italy; a group of friends witness a massive UFO taking off in Argentina.

programme.title: Mischievous Duende in Argentina and More
programme.desc: Paranormal investigators capture a shadow figure in a haunted Nevada prison; a hidebehind in Oregon gives a girl and her grandma a serious fright; a tiny elfin creature makes a toddler uneasy in Argentina.

programme.title: Ghost Girl in Chicago Bar and More
programme.desc: A dark entity shows itself to investigators inside one of America's haunted homes; the ghost of a young girl materializes in an Illinois bar; a father and son in California film a UFO that appears to be alive.

programme.title: Inside the Screaming House and More
programme.desc: U.K. investigators are confronted by a dark presence in an abandoned home; Bigfoot stalking two brothers in Rochester, N.Y.; a smoke break in San Juan turns into a double UFO sighting.

programme.title: Green Creature in Aruba Cave and More
programme.desc: A party store in Mexico is plagued by a malicious entity; a treasure hunt is interrupted by Bigfoot in New Mexico; a mysterious green creature lurks inside a cave in Aruba.

programme.title: The Departed DJ and More
programme.desc: A creature that tormented an Australian man's childhood is back for more; a DJ in North Carolina is still spinning sets from beyond the grave; a UFO in Islamabad remains immobile for hours.

programme.title: Little Girl vs. Ghost and More
programme.desc: A Michigan toddler plays a spirited game of tug of war with a ghost; a paranormal enthusiast in England captures a shadow figure lurking at the foot of his bed; a massive lake monster surfaces in China.

programme.title: The Darkness Over Houston and More
programme.desc: An unknown entity continues to torment a New Jersey family; a strange specter spies on a paranormal investigator at an abandoned train station in Sweden; a woman captures a mysterious dark mass hovering in the skies above Houston.

programme.title: Mysterious Lights in Moab and More
programme.desc: A Bigfoot enthusiast captures evidence of the legendary cryptid's elusive cousin -- the Ohio Grassman; mysterious glowing orbs manifest in the Utah desert; a haunted doll torments a Canadian family.

programme.title: The Axman Cometh
programme.desc: A father-daughter team confronts the ghost of an ax-murderer; Jack Kenna fights the spirit of a sea-captain.

programme.title: House of Horror
programme.desc: The ghost of a murderer fights to keep his secrets; in Massachusetts, investigators come to the aid of a man suffering from violent hauntings; an investigator goes on the hunt for the ghost of a violent prisoner in Michigan.

programme.title: Crazy Train
programme.desc: Investigators disturb tortured spirits trapped in an old passenger train with a tragic past; a ghost hunter is toyed with by the demonic spirit of a child; the violent ghost of a school principal attacks.

programme.title: The Forbidding Funeral Home
programme.desc: Father-daughter team Alan and Anna look into a crumbling mansion and find a scorned wife; a former funeral home in Ontario haunts Michelle Durocher; ghost hunters respond to a call from a family home in Ohio.

programme.title: This Isn't a Game
programme.desc: A couple flirts with the occult and gets more than they bargained for; a ghost hunter in Massachusetts disturbs an ancient spirit desperate for revenge.

programme.title: The Imaginary Friend
programme.desc: Investigator Joe Cetrone tries to protect his son from a demonic being; a child's imaginary friend in Ohio has a dark side; a doppelgänger stalks investigators.

programme.title: Here Be Demons
programme.desc: Jack Kenna discovers a family secret in a historic house in Massachusetts; a young teenager gets attacked in her sleep; a client faces life-threatening danger in Kansas.

programme.title: Ghost Child
programme.desc: Michelle tries to stop a demonic spirit; a hunter faces his own fear of child ghosts when called to help a family in Massachusetts; Richard faces a whole family of spirits in an Italian restaurant.

programme.title: Haunted Hospital
programme.desc: Ursula investigates one of Chicago's most haunted places; hunters come face-to-face with a terrifying entity in a Utah hospital; Joe battles a powerful animal spirit summoned by dark satanic rituals.

programme.title: The Doppelganger
programme.desc: Marie Yates is convinced that the death of her grandmother was the work of an evil spirit; investigator George Acosta believes the only cure for a woman with a mysterious illness is an exorcism; investigators explore an old jail.

programme.title: Spiritual Warfare
programme.desc: George gets locked in a spiritual battle to expel demons from a client's home; Richard investigates mysterious and terrifying events in a Colorado museum; Jay goes toe to toe with ancient native spirits in Arizona.

programme.title: Close to Home
programme.desc: George helps his sister with a dark and malevolent spirit; a group of teens mistakenly unleash a demon; an investigator spends the night in a church rectory with a dark past.

programme.title: Night at the Cemetery
programme.desc: During an investigation of a Chicago cemetery, Ursula endures the most terrifying time of her life; George is asked to remove a spirit that's attacking a young boy.

programme.title: Get Help
programme.desc: Tim and Sapphire go to Montana to solve the haunting of Gunslinger Gulch.

programme.title: A Place for the Dead
programme.desc: Tim and Sapphire make connections between the bloody history of Anaconda, Montana, and Gunslinger Gulch; a trek into the hills in search of a mysterious pit has medium Sarah Lemos fearing for everyone's safety.

programme.title: Hunted
programme.desc: Tim uncovers a link between Gunslinger Gulch and a former brothel in Butte, Mont.; back at the ranch, the team grows more concerned for the Broussards after an experiment reveals a dark force's psychological warfare.

programme.title: Ornias
programme.desc: Broussard matriarch Karen reluctantly moves her family off the ranch while investigators Tim Wood and Scott Di Lalla confront the dark haunting alone; grim discoveries are made at an abandoned home Karen claims to be drawn to.

programme.title: Let Us Have Her
programme.desc: The team builds a psychomanteum, a dimly lit room of mirrors, to force a controlling entity to manifest inside the church; a psychic sketch artist reveals a dark secret, sending the Broussard family and the investigation into fresh turmoil.

programme.title: My Name Is Pain
programme.desc: It's a showdown between good and evil at Gunslinger Gulch when the team invites a priest to the ranch to expel the dark entity.

programme.title: Magnolia Plantation
programme.desc: The Magnolia Plantation in Derry, Louisiana, entices the Ghost Brothers to investigate claims of deceased slaves still practicing voodoo in the afterlife.

programme.title: The Allen House
programme.desc: A love triangle and a jilted woman's suicide that took place in the house in 1949 are the source of apparitions at the Allen House in Monticello, Arkansas.

programme.title: Prospect Place
programme.desc: Prospect Place, in Trinway, Ohio, was once a stop on the Underground Railroad. This historic mansion lures the crew to find out if an evil entity still resides on the property.

programme.title: The Delta Queen
programme.desc: The Delta Queen, a historic riverboat relocated to Houma, Louisiana for extensive renovations, sets off paranormal activity.

programme.title: Magnolia Hotel
programme.desc: The Ghost Brothers decipher if there is a link between the past murders and suicides and the present continued paranormal activity.

programme.title: The Fitzpatrick Hotel
programme.desc: The Ghost Brothers head to Washington, Ga., to try to solve the mysterious haunting of The Fitzpatrick Hotel, which sits upon a grave site.

programme.title: Long Leaf Sawmill
programme.desc: Investigating a desolate sawmill that locals of Long Leaf, La., call the Mill of Death, and attribute claims of apparitions and shadow people to numerous tragic accidents.

programme.title: Winchester Mystery House
programme.desc: Investigating the maze-like home of the heir to the Winchester Rifle fortune in San Jose, Calif., who was convinced that the spirits of anyone killed with a Winchester rifle were trying to harm her.

programme.title: Old City Jail
programme.desc: Investigating claims of apparitions and physical attacks in Charleston, S.C., believed to be connected to the first female serial killer and other dangerous inmates.

programme.title: Rose Hall
programme.desc: Investigating a Montego Bay, Jamaica plantation rumored to be haunted by the infamous White Witch of Rose Hall, who, according to legend, murdered her three husbands and practiced voodoo.

programme.title: Cocke County Memorial Building
programme.desc: Investigating the Cocke County Memorial Building in Newport, Tenn. Where there have been claims of apparitions and threatening activity connected to a mysterious and tragic plane crash that happened in 1964.

programme.title: Poasttown Elementary School
programme.desc: Investigating an abandoned elementary school in Middletown, Ohio that's believed to have paranormal activity connected to a tragic train crash.

programme.title: House of Wills
programme.desc: A former funeral home in Cleveland was constructed to trap energy and could be the reason behind reports of a dark presence and apparitions being seen roaming the property.

programme.title: Thornhaven Manor
programme.desc: Investigating paranormal claims at the historic Thornhaven Manor in New Castle, Ind.; the phenomena may be caused by a murder victim, his family members and the murderer.

programme.title: Not Today, Satan
programme.desc: Kesha is pushed to her limit when she and comedian Whitney Cummings make contact with demonic forces at a maximum-security penitentiary in Tennessee.

programme.title: Songs For the Dead
programme.desc: Kesha and Betty Who unravel the dark mysteries of a historic opera house.

programme.title: A Terrifying Truth
programme.desc: Kesha and GaTa show up for a night of terror at the Westerfeld House, trying to figure out whether illusionist Harry Houdini is responsible for the paranormal activity there or if it's something else.

programme.title: Into Bigfoot's Lair
programme.desc: Kesha and Jojo Fletcher enter a supernatural vortex in search of Bigfoot.

programme.title: Kesha Faces Mortality
programme.desc: Kesha and Karen Elson peel back the curtain on an infamous secret society.

programme.title: Descent Into Madness
programme.desc: Kesha and Big Freedia face their fears at Trans-Allegheny Lunatic Asylum.

programme.title: The Osbournes: Night of Terror
programme.desc: Steve and Amy travel to Waterford, Conn., to investigate a recently separated woman's claims that her family is under attack by a paranormal entity; Amy discovers that the key to what's haunting the living may not necessarily reside with the dead.

programme.title: Phantoms of the Fire
programme.desc: The team reopens Hans Holzer's 50-year-old case documenting rampant paranormal activity at one of the oldest houses in Rye, N.Y., to find out if its tortured souls have finally moved on or simply moved.

programme.title: From a Flat-Head to a Chrysler Slant-Six, to a Ford FE to a boosted Chevy Straight-Six
programme.desc: From a Flat-Head to a Chrysler Slant-Six, from a Ford FE to a boosted Chevy Straight-Six, Mike and Pat celebrate their vintage builds and how they turned retro into big modern muscle.

programme.title: Supercharged '89 K5 Square Body Searches For a Mud Hole
programme.desc: The supercharged big block Blazer hits the trails in search of a big mud hole.

programme.title: Chevy C-10 - Part 6: Bed Redefined
programme.desc: Work continues on our '72 Chevy C-10 Project Cream Puff as the Music City Trucks crew relocates the hood hinges for a cleaner, more functional front end. Then, it's all about strength and style as they fabricate a custom bed frame to support our short-bed conversion. Plus, we'll hit the road to visit a top-tier custom interior shop that is specializing in the DIY guy.

programme.title: Chevy K1500 5.3 LS Swap
programme.desc: LT hoists the tired 350 from the engine compartment for a budget conscious 5.3L LS.

programme.title: Restoring a Scuffed Up Windshield - Road Runner Part 6
programme.desc: We get into some arts and crafts to create a one-of-a-kind emblem that redefines ransom wear and we'll use some wool to clear up Road Burner's eyes. When it's all said and done, the guys will be literally exhausted.

programme.title: Hard Charger Power Plant Reveal
programme.desc: It's time to reveal the engine that's going to power the 1969 Charger project, and a viewer's Chevelle gets a helping hand with a Driveway Rescue.

programme.title: Dodge Challenger Tears It Up At NCM Motorsports Park
programme.desc: The Challenger tears it up at NCM Motorsports Park! Plus we'll help a viewer perk up her pickup in this week's Driveway Rescue.

programme.title: Tearing Down a Duramax to Prep for 1000 HP
programme.desc: We take apart our 6.6L Duramax from our '11 Denali HD for an upgrade to 1000HP. Plus, we meet a diesel junkie who built a Cummins powered Ford Ranger pocket rocket for the dragstrip.

programme.title: Driveway Rescue: Z71
programme.desc: We help one of our viewers take care of some essential safety items on her '99 Chevy Z71.

programme.title: Building An Exhaust To Fit The Abandoned Chevy Silverado's 5.3L LS - Part 3
programme.desc: We continue to work on our abandoned '96 Chevy Silverado truck, buttoning up underneath the hood with cooling and power steering installations. Plus we build a custom exhaust for our freshened up 5.3 liter engine.

programme.title: Tackling The Worn Out Road Runner Interior - Part 4
programme.desc: Tommy and Joel give the '69 Road Runner's interior a much-needed makeover. We'll restore the dash and give the seats and headliner some much needed attention.

programme.title: Faux Guy Square Body Screams '80s With Chrome Wagon Wheels
programme.desc: The frame work for our 1985 Chevy K-10 is being blasted and painted. We add a new fuel system and assemble it all back together. We get this K-10 chassis on a new set of wheels and tires and add our freshly painted cab.

programme.title: Cooling Down & Increasing Power On The '71 Chevy Caprice
programme.desc: Cool Running - We install the cooling system on our '71 Caprice and then put the pedal to the metal to give you the lowdown on electronic throttle vs mechanical.

programme.title: Dropping the Hammer On The Retro Rocket Hurst Olds - Part 5
programme.desc: Tommy and Joel visit a museum in a Lane of its own to see some one-of-a-kind vehicles. Then, they head over to the track to put the pedal to the metal on their '83 Hurst Olds retro rocket!

programme.title: The '91 Suburban Gets A Triple Stick Shifter
programme.desc: Our Unbreakable Chevy Suburban makes its final preparations for payoff with completion of the engine bay, drivetrain, exhaust, and interior.

programme.title: 600+ Horsepower 2nd Gen Camaro Shakedown
programme.desc: With over 600 horses the Gen II is ready to pound the pavement! From the street, to the track, to the strip, this split bumper is a beast. We also take you inside the PRI Show to checkout the latest in race engine technology.

programme.title: Pit Pass at a NHRA Race Weekend
programme.desc: Meet the graduates of SAMTech who have found a home in NHRA racing.

programme.title: Low-Fi S-10: This Project is Coming Together
programme.desc: We are on the home stretch of our '95 Chevy S-10 Mini Slam Project. We begin to button things up, including the driveshaft, exhaust, shocks and more. The end is in sight as we get closer to laying frame.

programme.title: Axles, Tires and Turbo, Oh My!
programme.desc: It's time to get our shop projects back on track. Chris and Eric tackle axles for Project Spartan, their '69 M715 Jeep Kaiser build, and they'll turbocharge the shop's Polaris UTV for future off-road adventures.

programme.title: Ford F-250 Project Part 2: Functionality Features
programme.desc: The MCT Ford F-250 gets a few more features added to help performance and function while hauling. We improve throttle response, plus help our visibility with new work lights.

programme.title: How to Build a 1000HP Diesel Beast
programme.desc: Modifying a Duramax to make 1000 Horsepower starts with a teardown and some machining before the new performance parts are added. Plus Austin mods up the body for a cool clean look.

programme.title: Project Bullseye - Match Game
programme.desc: Paint by numbers - Painting a '69 Dodge Dart? We'll show you how to get perfect factory-match paint! Our 1969 Dodge Dart, Project Bullseye, is a bare shell providing the perfect blank canvas. Brian will show you some easy DIY color mixing methods for perfect pigment matching paint to get your project back to factory spec.

programme.title: Project Creep it Real Part 3
programme.desc: The team is adding a transfer case, hydraulic steering and getting the JK riding on 40s!

programme.title: 427 cubic inches of Naturally Aspirated HP for Javelin Trans Am Tribute Build
programme.desc: A 427 ci LSX engine goes naturally aspirated for an underappreciated muscle car.

programme.title: Keeping it F-100
programme.desc: With no time to kill, Eric and Joel install the remaining components to get Clint Black's old 1960 Ford F-100 back on the road again.

programme.title: '69 Charger Front End Assembly
programme.desc: Project Hard Charger gets the front end buttoned up and we help a viewer restore his cranky Camaro.

programme.title: Boosting A Crown Vic Police Interceptor 160 Horsepower
programme.desc: Tommy and Marc almost double the horsepower on a 2008 Ford 4.6L Crown Victoria P71 Police Interceptor. The solution for more power is adding a small tailpipe turbo, exhaust and fuel mods. Then the dyno don't lie! From 200HP to 368HP, this Vic is ready for high pursuit!

programme.title: Low-Fi S-10: New Audio System & Interior
programme.desc: We're back on our '95 Chevy S-10 Mini Slam Project. We send our truck out to an expert who will create and install a custom audio system and interior. That will help us BUMP UP our street cred in the Mini Truck scene.

programme.title: Jeep Wagoneer Transformed: "TrashHawk" Hits The Track
programme.desc: After completing final work on our TrackHawk inspired 1986 Jeep Wagoneer we call TrashHawk, it's time for some high performance fun at the National Corvette Museum Motorsports Park track.

programme.title: Custom Cooling, Custom Exhaust, The Test Sled Build is On!
programme.desc: Our rolling dyno sled receives a fuel system, intercooler, and hand-built exhaust. Plus: take a visit inside Dustless Blasting's manufacturing facility.

programme.title: Adding More Power to the Rally Car's 4 Cylinder
programme.desc: We do a little wrenching on our Honda 4 cylinder. Updating some key components and sealing up some oil leaks. Plus, the Civic gets a facelift with a Rally Car inspired paint job.

programme.title: Tearing Down a Pair of 351 Small Blocks: Windsor vs Cleveland
programme.desc: HorsePower goes on a salvage yard treasure hunt and finds a pair of 351 smallblocks -- Cleveland and Windsor. After twin teardowns, exploring the characteristics of each, the guys start the first of two performance build-ups.

programme.title: Easy Upgrades for a Stock Big Block Chevy
programme.desc: It's not all about horsepower! We take a Chevy 454 big block and dial in hard-hauling, heavy-pulling torque.

programme.title: Stage 2 Ram Wrap-Up
programme.desc: Final top end mods, rear locker & traction bars installed before our 1 ton dually hits the strip.

programme.title: Project Shell Shock - Brakes, Wiring & More!
programme.desc: This week on our '56 Chevy 210 Gasser, we're checking a few more things off the list. We'll install new brake pads, drop in some fresh taillights, and show you a few wiring tips to help keep things clean and simple. We're also adding power windows for a little extra comfort, and giving our interior trim panels a quick facelift with some fresh paint. It's all about knocking out the details that make this classic that much better.

programme.title: 69 GTO Part 8 - Power Moves
programme.desc: Wired and inspired - The guys enter the winding maze of wiring as they install a new ECU. Then, it's out with the old and in with the new as Joel upgrades the sound deadening and Tommy puts a new shine on the original taillights.

programme.title: Project Struck Out
programme.desc: As Tommy and Peyton resume work on their 1966 Chevy Nova, they suddenly learn that this project may go from Starstruck to Struck Out. With that, they switch gears into another historic muscle car, 1969 Pontiac GTO.

programme.title: Modern 410ci Stroker Windsor with Custom EFI & Coil-Near-Plug Conversion - Part 2
programme.desc: We're expecting great numbers in the dyno cell for the 410ci Small Block Ford, after it receives an aggressive intake manifold, a custom coil-on-plug conversion, and a powerful EFI system!

programme.title: Ford F-150: Preparation F
programme.desc: Today, we're prepping a big-block Ford to go in our big blue F-150. We'll walk you through the ins and outs of any and everything you'll need to plumb an entire fuel injection system from sump to solenoids.

programme.title: Sierra HD Duramax Allison Transmission
programme.desc: We'll show you the step-by-step inner workings of an Allison transmission when our guys build the gearbox for a Sierra HD Duramax.

programme.title: A Pair of New Horseshoes
programme.desc: Tommy and Peyton get to work on their 1990 Mustang. They install a new front and rear suspension in Project Fast Lane Fox Body to handle its new engine.

programme.title: F150 Dream Truck Turbo Reloaded
programme.desc: We revisit the F150 Dream Truck and find out what bolt on upgrades actually do to your horsepower numbers, and we'll test it on the dyno.

programme.title: 496ci Stroker Big Block Chevy
programme.desc: We put some custom touches on our 496ci Stroker Big Block Chevy and get it ready for the street rod life!

programme.title: The Beach Cruiser Bronco Gets Its Colors
programme.desc: We welcome legendary custom car builder Chris Ryan and his team to help with our 1974 Bronco. We give it a professional paint job that will completely transform this build.

programme.title: Pulling The L28 Out Of Our 1978 Datsun 280Z Heritage Restomod
programme.desc: We start tearing into the powertrain of our Datsun 280Z, freshening up the engine and converting the automatic transmission to a sportier manual setup. We'll also take a look at the new Nissan Z!

programme.title: Jeep JK Part 2: Trail Accessories
programme.desc: The guys put the final touches on the Jeep JK, adding a new bumper and winch. Plus, we'll show you a few techniques on how to fix poorly installed nutserts.

programme.title: Classic Car Collaboration
programme.desc: The Engine Power crew hits the road and travels to Boston to visit famous Factory Five Racing and some of their new facilities. They're expanding their "build it yourself" classic car line with an all-new reengineered version of their well-known classic.

programme.title: Our Sleeper Granada Gets Four Times The Horsepower!

programme.desc: When Bill arranges for an interior decorator to redo Cissy's and Buffy's bedroom, Buffy becomes withdrawn as the changes seem to separate the room and she fears Cissy is separating from her.

programme.title: Mrs. Beasley, Where Are You?
programme.desc: Buffy leaves Mrs. Beasley with Mr. French, who accidentally knocks the doll off the terrace. When Bill learns from Cissy the importance of Mrs. Beasley to Buffy, he goes on a hunt to find the doll.

programme.title: Who's Afraid of Nural Shpeni?
programme.desc: The owner of a Middle East Delicacies store, upon learning Mr. French is unmarried and knowing he is wealthy, introduces him to his cousin, Nural Shpeni, who he and her brothers want Nural to marry.

programme.title: A Matter for Experts
programme.desc: The vice principal and a child psychologist are concerned that Buffy and Jody only spend time with each other instead of playing with the other children.

programme.title: Beware the Other Woman
programme.desc: Cissy thinks Bill is planning to get married to an old friend, but when her new friend tells her how her stepmothers sent her away, Cissy then suspects that the woman will send them away.

programme.title: Take Two Aspirin
programme.desc: Restless, Bill takes a job in the Yutacan, but then starts to miss the family. It gets worse when he is led to believe, through miscommunication by phone, that Mr. French has the flu.

programme.title: Love Me, Love Me Not
programme.desc: Jody doesn't think Bill loves him because he won't punish him, so Jody looks for ways to get in trouble, but his plans backfire.

programme.title: The Thursday Man
programme.desc: For a school project, Cissy wants to write a story about Mr French. She starts following him and finds out what he does every Thursday.

programme.title: Think Deep
programme.desc: Cissy develops an infatuation with her school teacher who teaches philosophy and spouts big ideals that everyone should follow. Bill finds a way to show that the teacher is just a regular man.

programme.title: Hard Hat Jody
programme.desc: Jody talks about having a job with a man who builds buildings. Uncle Bill thinks he is making it up. Bill later meets the man and realizes it is the person he has been trying to meet for a project.

programme.title: That Was the Dinner That Wasn't
programme.desc: Cissy's school is having a mother / daughter dinner. This makes Cissy miss her mother more.

programme.title: All Around the Town
programme.desc: Due to a miscommunication of who would watch Buffy and Jody, the twins find themselves all alone in New York City.

programme.title: One for the Little Boy
programme.desc: Giles French leaves town for a month, so his brother Niles comes to help with the Davis'. Jody is tired of always being around the girls and having to do the things they want to do.

programme.title: Fancy Free
programme.desc: Jody & Buffy are excited to be moved to Upper First Grade at school, but it means more homework. They do not know how to do the math problems nor read some of the new books.

programme.title: A Helping Hand
programme.desc: Buffy & Jody have problems with a building project for school. Bill is hosting a large dinner party, and French has to hire an assistant to help serve the food.

programme.title: Once in Love with Buffy
programme.desc: Bill has to babysit Buffy and Jody and tells friends that he is stuck with the kids. Buffy overhears this, and the twins start to decide if they should stay with Bill or move to their aunt's place.

programme.title: Ballerina Buffy
programme.desc: Buffy gets upset when she does not get the role of The Big Bad Wolf in her ballet recital.

programme.title: The Mother Tongue
programme.desc: Buffy & Jody's new friend at school has them doing things differently. When Marilyn visits, Bill and French learn she speaks only Mandarin, and the kids communicate through child-speak.

programme.title: Everybody Needs Somebody
programme.desc: French congratulates a friend on his wedding, and makes the comment about how wonderful it will be to have a wife and home. Buffy overhears this and tells Jody they need to find French a wife.

programme.title: The Way It Was

programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark visit a halfway house for people who were confined to mental facilities but released because they were deemed no longer a danger to society.

programme.title: A Father's Faith
programme.desc: A fisherman's livelihood is in jeopardy because of the amount of time he devotes to his comatose son.

programme.title: A Heavy Date

programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark (Michael Landon, Victor French) help a lonely writer (guest star Didi Conn) meet a secret agent (guest star Warwick Sims) murdered in 1968.

programme.title: The Gift of Life

programme.title: Man's Best Friend - Part 1
programme.desc: A lost dog becomes the missing link between an orphan and a married couple, who are unable to have children.

programme.title: Man's Best Friend - Part 2
programme.desc: The orphan boy has formed an attachment to the dog, although he is going away to living with a new foster family.

programme.title: Fight For Your Life
programme.desc: A trainer is reminded of his own shady past when a fighter he's been mentoring is asked to take a fall.

programme.title: I Was a Middle Aged Werewolf

programme.desc: A youngster turns to a fantasy world and a comic-book superhero to cope with the pain of his father's death.

programme.title: Why Punish the Children?
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark clash with a warden over reforms that would unite female inmates with their children.

programme.title: A Dream of Wild Horses
programme.desc: The patriarch of a ranch family feels he's too old to rein in some wild horses.

programme.title: In With the "In" Crowd
programme.desc: A cop is working undercover at a school to put an end to drug use, but faces suspension because of a mistake Mark has made.

programme.title: A Mother's Love
programme.desc: Four brothers go on the run to escape a court order that would split them up.

programme.desc: A country doctor's (Roscoe Lee Browne) dedication to his community's medical needs nearly ruins him physically and financially. With Renee Jones.

programme.title: Time in a Bottle
programme.desc: A zealous district attorney tries for a felony conviction of a vagrant accused of stealing a bottle of wine.

programme.title: Back to Oakland

programme.title: We Have Forever - Part 1
programme.desc: Jonathan hopes that he'll be released from his duties to be reunited with his wife when she passes away.

programme.title: We Have Forever - Part 2
programme.desc: Jonathan hopes that he'll be released from his duties to be reunited with his former wife when she passes away.

programme.title: The Correspondent
programme.desc: A war correspondent finds himself imprisoned and facing execution. Meanwhile, Jonathan and Mark show him what's he's missed during his life by putting work ahead of family.

programme.title: Aloha
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark (Michael Landon, Victor French) help a former dancer (Mokihana) overcome her bitterness at being disabled.

programme.title: A Dolphin Song for Lee - Part 2
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark convince teenager Lee to lobby in the state senate for broader environmental protection.

programme.title: Heaven Nose, Mister Smith

programme.title: The Whole Nine Yards

programme.title: Whose Trash Is It Anyway?

programme.desc: Jonathan helps Commander Michaels to deal with flashbacks of Vietnam; he also tries to convince her to go to therapy. Mark deals with his fear of flying.

programme.title: Hello and Farewell - Part 2
programme.desc: A veterans' support group becomes a lifeline for Commander Michaels, who continues to deal with post-traumatic stress disorder. Meanwhile, she discovers that her son David came into the emergency room due to an accident.

programme.title: The Silent Bell
programme.desc: A pastor must follow a council's decision to fire some staff at the school because they're not Christian.

programme.title: The Reunion

programme.title: The Source

programme.title: The Squeaky Wheel

programme.title: Choices
programme.desc: Private detectives Mark and Jonathan help a Vietnamese couple locate their sons that were adopted and raised by an American family.

programme.title: Summer Camp

programme.title: The Inner Limits
programme.desc: A young man decides to institutionalize his brother who has been completely paralyzed for many years.

programme.title: It's a Dog's Life
programme.desc: Mark believes that God has turned Jonathan into a dog. Meanwhile, he must contend with a runaway kid and the kid's scatterbrained mother.

programme.title: Disaster Runway
programme.desc: On July 17, 2007, TAM Airlines Flight 3054 slides off runway 35L at Congonhas Airport in São Paulo, Brazil, and crashes at high speed into a warehouse adjacent to a petrol station killing nearly 200 people.

programme.title: The Plane That Flew Too High
programme.desc: West Caribbean Airways Flight 708 crashes down killing 160 people in 2005, ultimately leading to the bankruptcy of the troubled airline.

programme.title: Split Decision
programme.desc: Arrow Air Flight 1285 with 248 American soldiers on board crashes seconds after refueling in Newfoundland.

programme.title: Break Up Over Texas
programme.desc: Near the end of its flight, Continental Express Flight 2574 suffers wing damage and goes into a dive falling out of the sky.

programme.title: Mayday Munich
programme.desc: A plane with members of the Manchester United football team crashes while heading home from Yugoslavia, killing 23 aboard.

programme.title: Turning Point
programme.desc: A Northwest Airlines flight cruises above the Bering Sea before problems develop and pilots must make an emergency landing in Anchorage.

programme.title: Bad Attitude
programme.desc: Korean Air Cargo Flight 8509 crashes shortly after take off from London Stansted Airport on December 22, 1999.

programme.title: Hiding in Plane Sight
programme.desc: In 1978, PSA Flight 182 collides with a Cessna and crashes into a San Diego residential area killing people on both planes and seven people on the ground.

programme.title: Under Pressure
programme.desc: On July 11, 1991, the crew of Nigeria Airways Flight 2120 unsuccessfully tries to return to the airport after a burst tire creates an in-flight fire which causes 247 Nigerian pilgrims and 14 crew to perish.

programme.title: I'm the Problem
programme.desc: Moments before Pacific Southwest Flight 1771 crashes on a cattle ranch in California, gunshots are heard in the cabin.

programme.title: Nowhere to Land
programme.desc: Pilots of TACA Flight 110 make a remarkable landing on a narrow levee, but investigators must find out why the engines in a brand-new plane failed.

programme.title: The Invisible Plane
programme.desc: SAS Flight 686 takes off from Milan's Linate Airport and moments later collides with a Cessna on the runway.

programme.title: Impossible Landing
programme.desc: A shocking look at the fate of United Airlines Flight 232 which crashed into Sioux City's runway in 1989 causing a subsequent explosion that left 111 people dead.

programme.title: Hanging by a Thread
programme.desc: Aloha Airlines Flight 243 loses part of its roof of the front fuselage before landing safely at Kahului, Maui.

programme.title: Attack Over Baghdad
programme.desc: The crew of DHL Flight OO-LL must land the plane using only the engines to control the craft when a left wing explodes causing the plane to lose hydraulic pressure.

programme.title: Out of Control
programme.desc: JAL Flight 123's steering system stops working 12 minutes after takeoff, causing the plane to crash into the side of a mountain and kill 520 people in 1985.

programme.title: Suicide Attack
programme.desc: A FedEx flight out of Memphis descended into chaos when a surprise attack by a disgruntled employee threatened the lives of all on board.

programme.title: Bomb on Board
programme.desc: On December 11, 1994, a terrorist bomb explodes on Philippine Airlines Flight 434, yet only one passenger dies.

programme.title: Mistaken Identity
programme.desc: A high-tech American gunship stationed in the Persian Gulf shoots down Iran Air Flight 655 carrying 290 people when its systems confuse it with an Iranian fighter.

programme.title: Helicopter Down
programme.desc: In 1995, a chopper carrying 18 people to a North Sea oil platform crashes; miraculously, everyone onboard survived in a life raft.

programme.title: Death and Denial
programme.desc: EgyptAir Flight 990 suddenly crashed into the sea, killing all 217 people aboard and causing controversy over whether it was intentional or a mechanical malfunction.

programme.title: Kid in the Cockpit
programme.desc: A Russian pilot allowed his teenage son to take control of Aeroflot Flight 593, setting in motion a chain of events that caused the deaths of 70 people.

programme.title: Impact on the Rails
programme.desc: With its conductors sound asleep, a freight train fails to stop and collides with an oncoming train, resulting in tragedy.

programme.title: Express Samina
programme.desc: A Greek ferry, the Express Samina, is pushed off course by strong waves and crashes into a rock formation causing eighty passengers to lose their lives in the freezing water as they wait for rescue.

programme.title: Unstoppable Train
programme.desc: A freight train carrying an excess of cargo loses its brakes while descending a mountain causing it to gain speed and derail into a neighborhood killing several people.

programme.title: African Hijack
programme.desc: When three hijackers ordered an Ethiopian plane to fly to Australia, the pilot tricked them by flying south along the African coast, with deadly consequences.

programme.title: Desperate Escape
programme.desc: In August 2005, Air France Flight 358 skidded off the runway in Toronto, trapping more than 300 passengers on the plane.

programme.title: All Engines Failed
programme.desc: British Airways Flight 9 falls toward the ocean when all four engines mysteriously fail, and then restart.

programme.title: Fiery Landing
programme.desc: When fire erupted aboard Air Canada Flight 797, the pilot made an emergency landing; flames engulfed the plane when the doors opened, killing half of the passengers.

programme.title: Missed Approach
programme.desc: Korean Airlines Flight 801 overshoots a runway during the final approach for a night landing and crashes into a hillside on Aug. 6, 1997.

programme.title: Mystery Crashes
programme.desc: Mystery surrounds two 737 crashes until USAir Flight 427's near miss gives investigators the information to solve the case.

programme.title: Panic Over the Pacific
programme.desc: A stalled engine causes China Airlines Flight 006 to go into a deadly spin before crew members were able to regain control.

programme.title: Out of Sight
programme.desc: A 1986 midair crash between Aeroméxico Flight 498 and Piper Archer N4891F near Los Angeles results in the creation of a collision-avoidance system.

programme.title: Inbound
programme.desc: U.S. Secretary of Commerce Ron Brown and 34 others are killed in 1996 when their Air Force 737 crashes on a mountain in Croatia.

programme.title: Deadly Disorientation
programme.desc: Flash Airlines Flight 604 crashes into the Red Sea shortly after take-off, killing all 148 people on board.

programme.title: Unconscious Pilot
programme.desc: The worst crash in Greek aviation history occurs in 2005 when all 121 people on board Helios Airways Flight 522 lose consciousness.

programme.title: Invisible Killer
programme.desc: During a storm, a strong gale slams Delta Air Lines Flight 191 to the ground killing most people on board.

programme.title: Miracle Flight
programme.desc: A pilot heads for a decommissioned air force base, not knowing it is hosting a weekend family event, when the passenger jet he is flying unexpectedly runs out of fuel.

programme.title: Behind Closed Doors (American Airlines Flight 96 and Turkish Airlines Flight 981)
programme.desc: A design fault leads to an explosion on a DC-10 and two years later the same design fault causes another tragedy.

programme.title: Fanning the Flames (South African Airways Flight 295)
programme.desc: A complex recovery operation is launched to find out if a 747 which disappeared into the Indian Ocean was carrying illegal weapons.

programme.title: Dead Weight (Air Midwest Flight 5481)
programme.desc: Air Midwest Flight 5481 plane plummets to the ground just after take off killing all on board and injuring one on the ground.

programme.title: Southern Storm (Southern Airways Flight 242)
programme.desc: The pilots of Southern Airways Flight 242 must try to land on a Georgia highway after the engines die and the windshield shatters.

programme.title: Explosive Evidence
programme.desc: A bomb explodes on Air India Flight 182 en route from Canada to India causing it to disintegrate over the coast of Ireland.

programme.title: Mixed Signals (Birgenair Flight 301)
programme.desc: The conflicting alarms confuse pilots of Birgenair Flight 301 before it crashes into the ocean with no survivors.

programme.title: Miami Mystery
programme.desc: The pilots of Eastern Airline Flight 401 try to determine why both landing-gear lights do not function, distracting them.

programme.title: Phantom Strike (Gol Transportes Aéreos Flight 1907)
programme.desc: In September 2006, a new Embraer Legacy business jet collides with a Boeing 737 over the Amazon Rain Forest.

programme.title: Ripped Apart
programme.desc: Ripped Apart revisits some of the most spectacular aviation disasters of the last fifty years to expose the explosive power of decompression.

programme.title: Fatal Flaw
programme.desc: Ripped Apart revisits some of the most spectacular aviation disasters of the last fifty years to expose the explosive power of decompression.

programme.title: Who's Flying The Plane?
programme.desc: Ripped Apart revisits some of the most spectacular aviation disasters of the last fifty years to expose the explosive power of decompression.

programme.title: Scratching the Surface (China Airlines Flight 611)
programme.desc: After taking off from Taiwan, a China Airlines 747 suddenly disappears from radar and crashes, killing 225 people.

programme.title: Explosive Device
programme.desc: The tragic circumstances surrounding the bombing of Pan Am Flight 103 by terrorists.

programme.title: Silent Killer
programme.desc: In September 1989, Partnair Flight 394 crashed into the sea killing all 55 people on board.

programme.title: Collision Course
programme.desc: Saudi Airways and Kazakhstan Airlines jets hit each other at 14,000 feet sending both planes spiraling to the ground.

programme.title: Operation Babylift (C-5 Galaxy 68-0218 )
programme.desc: During the Vietnam War when over 250 children, who were being airlifted to safety on a US Air Force C5A Galaxy, died in an explosion.

programme.title: Falling Fast
programme.desc: Investigators discover a shocking mistake when pilots must ditch their plane in the Mediterranean, killing 14 of the 34 passengers.

programme.title: Flight 574: Lost (The Plane That Vanished, Adam Air Flight 574)
programme.desc: An Adam Air Boeing 737 crashes into the Makassar Strait killing 102 people on board; the pilots inadvertently disengaged the autopilot while trying to fix the inertial reference system, causing the plane to plunge to the water.

programme.title: Deep Freeze
programme.desc: A design flaw sends American Eagle Flight 41-84 smashing into a cornfield outside of Chicago, killing all 68 people on board.

programme.title: System Breakdown
programme.desc: Ripped Apart revisits some of the most spectacular aviation disasters of the last fifty years to expose the explosive power of decompression.

programme.title: Panic on the Runway (British Airtours Flight 28M)
programme.desc: On August 22nd, 1985, 55 people died aboard British Airtours flight 28M when its engine caught fire as it accelerated.

programme.title: Braven
programme.desc: A logger and his father head to their hunting cabin, hoping for a quiet weekend. Instead, they find themselves in a kill-or-be-killed stand for survival when they encounter a gang of ruthless drug traffickers.

programme.title: Detroit
programme.desc: In the summer of 1967, rioting and civil unrest starts to tear apart the city of Detroit. Two days later, a report of gunshots prompts the Detroit Police Department, the Michigan State Police and the Michigan Army National Guard to search and seize an annex of the nearby Algiers Motel. Several policemen start to flout procedure by forcefully and viciously interrogating guests to get a confession. By the end of the night, three unarmed men are gunned down while several others are brutally beaten.

programme.title: Brooklyn's Finest
programme.desc: A drug operation changes the lives of three conflicted New York cops. Burned-out vet Eddie Dugan is close to retirement; narcotics cop Sal Procida faces the difficult task of caring for his large family on his ordinary salary. Undercover officer Clarence Tango Butler finds his loyalties beginning to shift toward a powerful drug dealer. Over seven chaotic days, the three men are drawn toward a fateful crime and destiny.

programme.title: Snitch
programme.desc: At 18 years old, Jason receives a mandatory 10-year prison sentence after being caught with a package that contained illegal drugs, although he was unaware of its contents. His father, businessman John Matthews (Dwayne Johnson), is devastated. When Jason turns down a chance to lessen his sentence by manufacturing evidence to implicate someone else, John begs to be sent undercover instead, but the already dangerous venture turns deadly after he exposes a major player in the Mexican drug trade.

There, Jack and nine other prisoners learn they are to fight each other to the death, with freedom as the prize for the sole survivor. The producer plans to broadcast the event live and uncensored over the Internet.

programme.title: The Condemned 2

programme.title: The Crazies
programme.desc: Anarchy reigns when an unknown toxin turns the peaceful citizens of Ogden Marsh into bloodthirsty lunatics. In an effort to contain the spread of the infection, authorities blockade the town and use deadly force to keep anyone from getting in or out. Now trapped among killers, Sheriff Dutton and his wife and two companions must band together to find a way out before madness and death overtake them.

programme.title: Man-Thing
programme.desc: When a greedy oil baron (Jack Thompson) sets his sights on drilling in a Louisiana swamp, a monstrous creature is awakened. The baron and his associates are killed in the swamp thicket, spurring an investigation led by Sheriff Kyle Williams (Matthew Le Nevez). Although the Seminoles are initially suspected of the murders, the swamp creature, known as Man-Thing (Conan Stevens), is the killer. A gruesome creature made of plants and vines, Man-Thing possesses strange and dangerous powers.

programme.desc: A young woman desperately tries to escape a seedy life of crime and drugs in a Kentucky coal mining town. She believes her bad luck may finally be changing when a newly minted FBI agent recruits her as an informant for a high-profile case.

programme.title: Freelancers
programme.desc: The son (Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson) of a fallen police officer joins the NYPD, where he falls in with his father's former partner and a band of rogue cops.

programme.title: City of Lies
programme.desc: Los Angeles Police Department detective Russell Poole has spent years trying to solve his biggest case -- the murders of The Notorious B.I.G. and Tupac Shakur -- but after two decades, the investigation remains open. Jack Jackson, a reporter desperate to save his reputation and career, is determined to find out why. In search of the truth, the two team up and unravel a growing web of institutional corruption and lies.
