programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - John Lithgow (12/11/84)
programme.desc: John Lithgow and Buddy Hackett stop by the couch, plus Johnny talks about the Christmas season.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Arnold Schwartzenegger (8/22/85)
programme.desc: Arnold can't help but talk about his workout habits and Johnny jokes about killer bees. Ed Begley Jr. and Ginger McLamb also appear.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Ted Danson (9/19/85)
programme.desc: Ted Danson has a hit show on his hands in Cheers and Courteney Cox enjoys being single in this episode.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Garry Shandling (2/27/86)
programme.desc: Garry Shandling does a standup routine and inventor Joe Newman talks with Johnny.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Sean Penn (10/9/86)
programme.desc: Sean Penn has a special message for his wife Madonna and Richard Pryor talks about his new Ferrari.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Rosanna Arquette (11/7/86)
programme.desc: It's a fear-themed episode as Rosanna Arquette discusses her phobia of critics, plus Oprah Winfrey and Alan Thicke also reveal their fears.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Danny DeVito (3/12/87)
programme.desc: Danny DeVito appears on the couch, as well as Rohan Varavadekar and Calvin Trillin.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Don Johnson (9/25/87)
programme.desc: Don Johnson is a surprise guest in this episode, which also features David Brenner and Dale Robertson.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Patrick Swayze (10/13/87)
programme.desc: Patrick Swayze discusses Dirty Dancing, plus Johnny interviews A. Whitney Brown and Alexandra Paul.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Christopher Reeve (11/2/88)
programme.desc: Superman himself flies onto the Tonight Show couch when Christopher Reeve talks to Johnny. Melanie Mayron and Jonathan Zachary also appear.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Michael J. Fox (11/3/88)
programme.desc: Michael J. Fox talks Family Ties and marriage, Larry Miller does standup and Harry Lorayne will test your memory.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Danny DeVito (12/9/88)
programme.desc: Danny DeVito has to cut off his ponytail for a role, Richard Benjamin stops by and Johnny jokes about the NBC Christmas party.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Isabella Roselini (2/1/89)
programme.desc: Isabella Rossellini talks about being raised in France and Italy, plus Martin Short is ready to cook a goose.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Fred Savage (2/2/89)
programme.desc: A 12-year-old Fred Savage "Kind-Of-Sorta" has a girlfriend, plus future host Jay Leno stops by and Brian Gillis does magic

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Jason Bateman (9/27/89)
programme.desc: A young Jason Bateman joins Johnny but might be upstaged by Florence Hodges, a 93-year-old hospital volunteer who shares her amazing stories.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Jennifer Grey (2/2/90)
programme.desc: Jennifer Grey talks about her famous parents. And Carl Reiner talks about his friends Mel Brooks and Steve Martin, and also about....his dog Homer.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Dabney Coleman (5/2/90)
programme.desc: Vodka and Russia are twin themes on this fun episode: Russian comedian Yakov Smirnoff talks about his recent trip home; and Dabney Coleman talks about one of his first jobs--in a vidka commercial!

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Judge Reinhold (5/4/90)
programme.desc: Judge Reinhold discusses a nude scene in his latest movie; and Rita Rudner does her brand of stand-up comedy.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - John Larroquette (5/10/90)
programme.desc: John Larroquette tells Johnny how to deal with autograph seekers. Then Johnny tries to do a split with Olympian Kurt Thomas.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - John Larroquette (3/20/91)
programme.desc: John Larroquette is always a fun guest and for his latest appearance he discusses, hair loss, playing the saxophone and...The Weasel Awards. Don't ask!

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Barry Levinson (11/14/91)
programme.desc: 96-year-old George Burns says he smokes 15-20 cigars a day. Director Barry Levinson discussed his iconic film "Diner."

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Melanie Griffith (1/29/92)
programme.desc: Imagine hearing about Dakota Johnson when she was a baby! Dakota's mom Melanie Griffith is Johnny's guest this week, and she talks about her new baby, and her marriage to Don Johnson.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Kevin Bacon (1/31/92)
programme.desc: Kevin Bacon talks about this new kid and Amanda Plummer talks about her famous parents

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Michael Douglas (2/21/92)
programme.desc: What a star-studded show!! Elizabeth Tylor and Michael Douglas join Johnny. Nuff said?!

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Michael Keaton (5/14/92)
programme.desc: Jokes are the theme on this show, with Martin Short, Terri Garr and Michael Keaton. Lotsa fun!

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Adrienne Barbeau (12/20/73)
programme.desc: Actress Adrienne Barbeau worked as a secretary before landing on Broadway in "Grease" and then getting cast in TV hit "Maude."

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Christopher Reeve (7/26/79)
programme.desc: Superman himself Christopher Reeve describes taking acting classes with Robin Williams. Meanwhile, Diahann Carroll reflects on her lowcut dress and dressing to please men.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Emmanuel Lewis (5/5/83)
programme.desc: TV actor Emmanuel Lewis admits he watches The Tonight Show "only once in a blue moon." Comedian David Steinberg claims that nudity can be really boring.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - John Ritter (3/2/84)
programme.desc: Comic actor John Ritter whines about doing commercials, being student body president at Hollywood High, and getting his star on The Walk-of-Fame.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Olivia Newton-John (11/12/76)
programme.desc: Grammy magnet Olivia Newton-John sings 2 of her numerous chart-topping tunes and fills in Johnny on growing up down under in Australia.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Patrick Duffy (2/12/80)
programme.desc: Dallas heartthrob Patrick Duffy says he always dreamed of becoming a TV star but now he wants to change his nice guy image. Also reveals his love for off-road racing.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Ricky Schroder (11/19/80)
programme.desc: 10-year-old TV star Ricky Schroder (Silver Spoons) chats about his Mexico vacation, spending his earnings and his 2 girlfriends! Also tells Johnny the questions he does not like to be asked.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Ricky Schroder (11/9/82)
programme.desc: 12-year-old TV star Ricky Schroder (Silver Spoons) shows off his skill juggling plastic eggs. Then Johnny gives it a try, unaware that Ricky swapped the plastic ones for real eggs. What a mess!

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Ricky Schroder (2/6/85)
programme.desc: 15-year-old TV star Ricky Schroder tells Johnny that when he gets his license, he wants to buy a Corvette. Also chats about dating, getting good grades in school and learning to sing.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Tim Reid (6/19/85)
programme.desc: The genius behind WKRP's Venus Flytrap, actor Tim Reid describes his experience auditioning for The Tonight Show. Also details his dream about his dear grandma.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Tim Thomerson (10/4/85)
programme.desc: Stand Up comedian Tim Thomerson announces he's leaving comedy to act in grade B sci-fi movies. His most recent role was as a time-traveling future cop in Trancers.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Patrick Duffy (7/22/87)
programme.desc: Dallas star Patrick Duffy commemorates Johnny's recent wedding, to wife #3, with a hilarious gift: A set of towels With Velcro monograms for quick switches.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Christie Brinkley (3/4/81)
programme.desc: Supermodel Christie Brinkley is also a boxing photographer? She fills in Johnny about her ringside gigs. Also talks about posing for Sports Illustrated's swimsuit issue and life in Malibu.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Christie Brinkley (5/14/82)
programme.desc: Super model Christie Brinkley describes doing photo shoots all over the world, and going skydiving, but chickening out at the last minute.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Amy Irving (3/20/84)
programme.desc: Oscar nom'd Amy Irving describes her kissing scene, with Barbra Streisand, in Yentl. Also fills in Johnny on her recent trip to Europe and her life at home in Santa Fe, New Mexico.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Christie Brinkley (3/1/85)
programme.desc: Supermodel Christie Brinkley chats about the hard work posing for Sports Illustrated's swimsuit issue and her upcoming marriage to Billy Joel, second time at the alter for both.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Alan Thicke (3/18/87)
programme.desc: Fellow talk show host Alan Thicke discusses his early days playing in a band on a cruise ship. Also riffs hilariously on doing a sex seminar with Dr. Ruth.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '90s - Tom Hanks (2/4/82)
programme.desc: Another superstar panel, with Lynn Redgrave and Tom Hanks, who talks about learning to juggle.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '90s - Ally Sheedy (6/9/83)
programme.desc: Richard Pryor discusses his latest film, "Superman," and seeing Ronald Reagan. Then Ally Sheedy talks about the transition from NYC to LA.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '90s - Courtney Cox (9/19/85)
programme.desc: Stars of two of the televisions biggest shows join Johnny--Ted Danson (Cheers) and Courtney Cox (Friends).

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '90s - Jeff Daniels (1/23/86)
programme.desc: Jeff Daniels discusses the amazing experience of working with Jack Nicholson on the film "Terms of Endearment."

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '90s - Woody Harrelson (7/19/89)
programme.desc: Woody Harrelson talks about his latest film project, but he might be upstaged by the appearance of animal wrangler Sunni Black, who brings parrots and vultures to the show.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '90s - Kenneth Branagh (2/1/90)
programme.desc: Famed Shakespearean actor Kenneth Branagh was young when he visited Johnny and talks about the thrill of meeting Kirk Douglas

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '90s - Kevin Spacey (4/27/90)
programme.desc: Comedian Robert Klein regales Johnny with stories about growing up in the Bronx and kosher foods. Also on this episode is Kevin Spacey.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '90s - Lara Flynn Boyle (5/9/90)
programme.desc: Tony Randall always lights up "The Tonight Show" panel and for this episode he's joined by Lara Flynn Boyle, who discussed "Twin Peaks."

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '90s - Kevin Pollak (10/31/90)
programme.desc: Find out why is Kevin Pollack dressed as Cupid when he joins the show?

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '90s - Kenneth Branagh (8/23/91)
programme.desc: Comedian David Steinberg talks about going to Theological school before his career as a comedian. And Kenneth Branagh also joins the fun.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '90s - Glenn Close (11/13/91)
programme.desc: Glenn Close discusses two movies that couldn't be more different--"Fatal Attractions" and "The Big Chill."

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '90s - Tim Allen (1/29/92)
programme.desc: Tim Allen, Melanie Griffith and......the great dog photos by famed photographer William Wegman.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '90s - Woody Harrelson (3/20/92)
programme.desc: Woody Harrelson joins Johnny again, this time talking about....doing Yoga before joining the show.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '90s - Craig T. Nelson (4/2/92)
programme.desc: Actor Craig T. Nelson recalls his first and (disastrous) appearance on The Tonight Show. Also chats about car racing and his teenage son, an aspiring actor who has difficult hair.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: The Best Of Garry Shandling (3/18/81)
programme.desc: Garry Shandling was a regular guest and always had something new and fun to discuss. This time, the topics are laundromats and Disneyland!

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: The Best Of Garry Shandling (12/7/82)
programme.desc: Garry is joined by Jimmy Stewart on this episode, who talks about working with Carol Burnett Bette Davis and others.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: The Best Of Garry Shandling (4/28/83)
programme.desc: This time around Garry talks about turning 30, Chinese food and...sex education.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: The Best Of Garry Shandling (2/27/86)
programme.desc: Garry Shandling is ALWAYS funny, whether he's talking about his hair, pets, or traffic tickets.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: The Best Of Garry Shandling (5/17/89)
programme.desc: Only on "The Tonight Show" will you see Patrick Swayze talking about a song he wrote called "Sweet June Farts."

programme.title: Episode 23
programme.desc: In this final couples stunt, both contestants will be riding on the back of an Ultraboat they each must grab hold of their own rope ladder hanging from a helicopter. Once touching down, contestants enter a trailer bed of a semi trailer and complete a small task to retrieve a car key, hop into a car, fasten their seatbelts and drive the car out of the back of the semi.

programme.title: Battle of Reality Stars - Part 2
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's putting out a fire on a houseboat and escaping a box of bugs submerged underwater.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Contestants are dunked by a helicopter, transport disgusting items from a conveyor belt, and fight to stay inside a human hamster wheel.

programme.title: Episode 30
programme.desc: Contestants will free fall from a 300 foot building, splatter bugs on their face like a windshield, and try not to fall from a rotating beam.

programme.title: Car Crush/SnakeTank/Floor Drop
programme.desc: This episode has six celebrity contestants competing for charity. The winner receives $50,000 for their charity and the others receive $10,000 for their charities. In the first stunt, contestants sit in a car at the end of a line of junkyard cars. As a monster truck drove over the line of cars, they have to find which of six keys started the car and drive over a finish line.

programme.title: Episode 28
programme.desc: Models Episode - Players will 8free themselves from hanging in chains, pull alligator tails, and crawl between two helicopters with only a rope.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: The contestant is sitting on a bicycle on top of a semi-truck that is traveling down a road at approx. 35 miles per hour. Using only their mouths contestants will have to pick-up tomato hornworms and squeeze the juice out of the worm and into a glass. In this stunt the contestant must walk on a 12 inch, 60 foot teeter totter beam from one building to another.

programme.title: Episode 30
programme.desc: Contestants are seated at a table behind six covered trays that conceal six different types of Fear Factor Sausages. For this "Best Friends" final stunt, both team members will be seated in separate stunt cars on opposite ends of a track, indirectly facing each other. On "go", both contestants must drive their car at towards their own pipe ramp.

programme.title: Helicopter Slalom, Piercings, Maggoty Cheese, Flag Snag
programme.desc: This was an extended 4-stunt episode. For the first stunt, contestants have to hang by their ankles from trapeze hanging from a helicopter that flew over 20 flagpoles. The have to release as many flags as possible. In the second stunt, they are strapped down and their left arm would be pierced by 10 needles which would get progressively thicker.

programme.title: Semi Finals: Part 2
programme.desc: Male contestants must identify disgusting items, then eat any they guess incorrectly; female contestants must retrieve dead feeder mice with their mouths while swimming in a vat of dead rodents.

programme.title: Heli Boat Drag/Bull Buffet/Window Washer
programme.desc: For the first stunt, contestants ride a raft behind a speedboat. They climb a rope hanging from a helicopter and release 6 flags before dropping 20 feet into the water. If contestants completed this stunt, they would win $1,000.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: In this couples stunt, the contestants will be standing on opposite platforms suspended 100 feet in the air. Contestants will have to siphon gross fluid (worms, crickets, cow parts, pig parts etc) out of 4 containers and into a large funnel.

programme.title: Semi Finals: Part 1
programme.desc: Contestants must drop out of a helicopter and race to pick up flags while swimming, and participate in a gross pot luck dinner. Then they must make their way through an airborne greasy maze.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Contestants get dragged by a horse, rest in a pit of rats and crawl on a car suspended 150 feet in the air.

programme.title: Episode 25
programme.desc: Contestants must stand on a truck as it drives through a tunnel, hit targets to avoid eating bugs, and dodge eing flipped by a tractor.

programme.title: Triple Beam Walk/Glass Walking/Magnetic Car Drop
programme.desc: Perched on the hood of a car suspended 100 feet high by a giant electric magnet, contestants must switch it off, sending themselves and the vehicle plummeting toward a target on the ground.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Contestants will be laying on their back bound at their ankles, waist, and one wrist to a plexiglass platform that is hung from a helicopter. Contestants will play a game to determine how much skunk, possum, rattlesnake and armadillo they will have to eat. Contestants will have to cross 4, 20-foot rotating beams placing flags along the way.

programme.title: Episode 27
programme.desc: Players must wedge themselves between two walls to avoid falling, eat live snails, and jump cars into trucks.

programme.title: Traverse Dam/Bee Headed/Water Coffin
programme.desc: Are you worth a Dam? Suspended high over a dam is a 350-foot long tightrope with flags attached. Contestants would have to cross the tightrope and collect flags while holding on to a higher tightrope for support. The two men and the two women to collect the most flags in 5 minutes would advance to the next round. Stunt 2 is a real Bee. The ones left are covered with over 200,000 honeybees.

programme.title: Burning Building/Scorpion Pit/Rotating Climbing WallF
programme.desc: It's hot for the first stunt as contestants climb a ladder, enter the fourth floor, follow a hose line to a room they put out a fire, rescue a dummy, and get out of the building. The two slowest are eliminated. In the second stunt, they lie in pit with over 3,000 scorpions.

programme.title: Episode 14
programme.desc: Couples Episode - Contestants brave a gross dunk tank and slalom to grab flags from a speeding helicopter

programme.title: Spin Cycle/Breakfast of Champions/Stilt Walking
programme.desc: Contestants climb a rope ladder hanging from a spinning girder and cross monkey bars from one end of the girder to the other and release a flag and drop into the water below. It's Breakfast of Champions as they have to eat balut eggs silkworm moth cocoons in brine, and liquefied pig liver.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Contestants must hold their breath in a leech-filled coffin and drive a motorcycle off a 100-foot cliff in hopes of winning $1 million.

programme.title: HeeHaw HeeHaw
programme.desc: Four sets of twins compete for $50,000 as they are electric shocked

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: In this episode we see stunts including the Free Fall, Sheep delicacies and upside down water tank.

programme.title: Miss USA Fear Factor
programme.desc: Contestants must race to milk a goat with their mouths, and unlock themselves from a box which let's them fall from a helicopter.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: The contestants will be riding on the back of a jet ski, traveling at approx. 25 to 30 miles per hour. Contestants are placed in a plexiglass helmet, which is then filled with water and moray eels. The contestants must ride a platform that is continuously moving up or down, along the way there are 6 stations that they must get off and retrieve a flag and return to the moving platform.

programme.title: Episode 16
programme.desc: Couples Episode - Players will lean over a ledge to collect flags, bob in rats, and cut cables off their hog-tied partner.

programme.title: Episode 31
programme.desc: Contestants will be lying on their backs in a muddy trough on the roof of a building. On "go" the contestants will be dragged through the mud and must pluck as many flags as they can before dropping off the edge of the building.

programme.title: Blind Date Fear Factor: Take Two
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's being weighed down underwater, digging into rotten picnic snacks, and a tag-team challenge on a moving train.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Contestants must hang on as they are dragged through water, juice cow eyes with their mouths, and jump between moving trucks to gather flags.

programme.title: Episode 11
programme.desc: 2 poles will be attached and hung off the front end of a dump truck, contestants must make their way out on the pole pulling flags as they make their way to the end. Contestants will be standing on a car that is suspended over the water by a crane. The car is specially designed to rotate like a rotisserie.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: In this episode we see stunts including the Leap on Faith, Pig Eat and High speed Climbing wall.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Contestants will be seated in the driver's seat and truck of a stretch limousine suspended on a 45-degree angle just above the surface of the water. Contestants will have to transfer a gross blend of bugs through a plexiglass tube. Contestants are tied into their seat and to the steering wheel of a convertible automobile, which will be hanging over a cliff approx 100-feet in the air.

programme.title: Episode 31
programme.desc: Family Episode - Players will walk on high beams, be buried in roaches, and catapult their children into a lake.

programme.title: Episode 21
programme.desc: Contestants go through the Fear Factor Triathalon. Contestants must guide their blindfolded partner through a maze of electrical tripwires designed to deliver a safe but shocking electrical charge when triggered. For every sprung tripwire, both contestants will receive a jolt.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Boat Jump As two ultra boats raced down a lake at 40 miles per hour, contestants would have to jump the gap between them that was approximately 7 feet wide and land on the second boat. Contestants who jumped from boat to boat successfully would advance to the next round.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Blimp Climb As a blimp flew high above the ocean, contestants would have to climb down a 35-foot rope ladder, release a flag, and climb back up the ladder. The two men and the two women to complete this stunt fastest would advance to the next round. The others would be eliminated.

programme.title: Episode 32
programme.desc: Contestants will beam walk between helicopters, test bug shakes, and jump cars over trains.

programme.title: Blizzard Fear Factor
programme.desc: As a ferris wheel-like structure begins to move, the contestant must walk while keeping up with the constantly increasing speed of rotation. For the next challenge, a platform will start descending into the water until the contestants are completely submerged. They will have two locks that they must unlock to remove the chains to escape.

programme.title: Episode 13
programme.desc: Tunnel Swim Contestants would have to swim through an underwater tunnel that was 80 feet long. Along the way, there were four air pockets. The two men and the two women to get through the tunnel the fastest would advance to the next round. The others would be eliminated.

programme.title: Episode 16
programme.desc: Contestants will play a game to determine how many disgusting donuts they will have to eat along with a tall glass of curdled milk. Contestants will be standing on a truss structure that is approx. 20' above the water. On go, the contestants must make their way across each of the 3 sets of beams of various widths to pull flags at the opposite end of the structure.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: The contestants will be bound face to face by their wrists to a pole that is attached to a circular platform hanging under a helicopter. Two contestants are placed into a single plexiglass helmet filled with thousands of spiders. The contestants will be bound by their ankles to a platform which is attached to a lever that is weighted at the opposite end holding the platform in the air.

programme.title: Snake Bite
programme.desc: In order to win they must face getting catapulted off the top of a tall building, transfer snakes with theirs mouths

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Contestants become human wrecking balls, eat boiled testicles and rescue a fake baby from a submerging car.

programme.title: Counter Balance Beam/Weenie Roast/Swinging Rope Bridge
programme.desc: For the first stunt the six have to release up to 12 flags from the edges of an 8-foot by 24-foot see-saw platform over 100 feet in the air. The two men and the two women to release the most flags the fastest before falling would advance. Next stunt is to eat a penis, within 5 minutes, of either a deer, elk, bull, or water buffalo.

programme.title: Episode 13
programme.desc: Couples Episode - Contestants hold on to a spinning suspended beam, and look for Fear Factor tokens in disgusting pies

programme.title: Military Fear Factor
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's launching into a net hanging from a helicopter, a race to eat worms and maggots, and collecting flags on top of a moving truck that's about to drive off a ship.

programme.title: Episode 12
programme.desc: Couples Episode - Players will be submerged in chains, and retrieve cow hearts and dunk them back out as a team.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Contestants must climb hand over hand around the skids of a moving helicopter, move maggots with their mouths, and attempt to flip their car the furthest on a pipe ramp.

programme.title: Farm Fear Factor
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's exploring a pig pen with their mouths, seeing how it feels to become a rotisserie chicken and a rotting milk escape attempt.

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: Vertical Gauntlet Contestants would have to cross 12-inch wide support beams between two 14-story buildings, climbing rope ladders to get from one beam to the next. On each beam, with the exception of the first, they would have to navigate an obstacle.

programme.title: Episode 21
programme.desc: Twins Episode - Players will jump from helicopters and try to hit targets, rescue each other from bees, and rescue a dummy from a sinking car.

programme.title: Speedboat to Heli/Worm Transfer/Car Thru Building
programme.desc: For the first stunt contestants ride on the back of a speedboat as a helicopter flew overhead. They would grab a 20-foot rope ladder hanging from the helicopter and climb it. The two men and the two women to climb into the helicopter the fastest would advance.

programme.title: Mother/Son Fear Factor
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's a suspended shoulder stand, facing off with a very dirty kitchen sink, and driving under a moving semi-truck.

programme.title: Episode 24
programme.desc: In this stunt a rope will be suspended between two helicopters. On "go" the contestant must traverse the rope from beneath one helicopter to the other end of the rope beneath the other helicopter while releasing flags along the way. For the last stunt, the contestants will be driving their stunt car over a ramp car.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Airplane Walk Contestants would have to climb out on the wing of a bi-plane as it flew at 100 miles per hour and over 4,000 feet above the ground. They would have to release a flag at the end of the wing and return to the cockpit. The two men and the two women to complete this stunt the fastest would advance to the next round.

programme.title: Burger King Viewers Choice Fear Factor
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's a high-flying challenge with saws and mud, outrunning attack dogs, and a suspended bus escape.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Helicopter Fire Drill Players will have to climb out one side of the helicopter as it hovered twenty-five feet above the cold water, then traverse underneath the helicopter using a cargo net fastened to the runners. Only after they hoisted themselves back inside on the other side of the helicopter would their time complete.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Contestants must retrieve flags from a tall pole, brave a piranha tank and play roulette to eat spiders

programme.title: Episode 29
programme.desc: Miss USA Episode - Players will fall from platforms, eat sea cucumber and hang from bars until they drop.

programme.title: Scary Movie 5
programme.desc: Much bizarre activity follows after a husband and wife bring their newborn infant home from the hospital. When they realize that a demon is stalking their family, they consult paranormal specialists and install numerous cameras to drive out the pesky spirit. This results in an ongoing battle with the villainous and powerful Gen. Katana (Michael Ironside), but MacLeod receives help when the noble Juan Ramirez (Sean Connery) returns.

programme.title: The Devil's Arithmetic
programme.desc: Hannah Stern (Kirsten Dunst), an American-born Jewish adolescent, is uninterested in the culture, faith and customs of her relatives; however, Hannah begins to reevaluate her heritage when she has a supernatural experience that transports her back to a Nazi death camp in 1941. There, she meets a young girl named Rivkah (Brittany Murphy), a fellow captive in the camp. As Rivkah and Hannah struggle to survive in the face of daily atrocities, they form an unbreakable bond.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: A misfit kid and his foster uncle go on the run in the New Zealand bush, evading child services and the law.

programme.title: Cold Blood
programme.desc: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

programme.title: Straight A's
programme.desc: Compelled by his mother's ghost, a former addict (Ryan Phillippe, "Crash") returns home to face his first love (Anna Paquin, "The Piano"), who happens to be his brother's wife.

programme.title: I'm Charlie Walker [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

programme.title: Jack's Back [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: Mysteria
programme.desc: Fighting to finish his script for a producer (Billy Zane), screenwriter Aleister (Robert Miano) finds inspiration amid a murder investigation led by Captain McCarthy (Michael Rooker) and his interrogator (Danny Glover).

programme.title: The Getaway (1994) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Hit & Run [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Are You Here
programme.desc: In this touching dramedy, weatherman Steve (Owen Wilson) must join his off-the-grid best friend Ben (Zach Galifianakis) for Ben's estranged father's funeral.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: 10th & Wolf [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

programme.title: Killing Season
programme.desc: Oscar winner Robert De Niro ("Raging Bull") and Oscar nominee John Travolta ("Pulp Fiction") star as two Bosnian War veterans hunting each other in this thrilling game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: 51st State
programme.desc: The 51st State is the story of Elmo McElroy (Samuel L. Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Going All The Way [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: The Gunman [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.

programme.title: The Devil's Arithmetic
programme.desc: Hannah Stern (Kirsten Dunst), an American-born Jewish adolescent, is uninterested in the culture, faith and customs of her relatives; however, Hannah begins to reevaluate her heritage when she has a supernatural experience that transports her back to a Nazi death camp in 1941. There, she meets a young girl named Rivkah (Brittany Murphy), a fellow captive in the camp. As Rivkah and Hannah struggle to survive in the face of daily atrocities, they form an unbreakable bond.

programme.title: Who's Your Caddy?
programme.desc: Superstar rap mogul C-Note (Antwan "Big Boi" Patton) wants to join the Carolina Pines Golf & Country Club, but faces stiff opposition from the establishment's snooty members. C-Note forces the issue by purchasing the land adjacent to the golf course's 17th hole. As the club leaders search for a way to revoke his membership, C-Note realizes his family's honor and golf history are at stake, and digs in for the fight of his life.

programme.title: More Money, More Family
programme.desc: Two cousins pretend they won the lottery to reunite their fractured family.

programme.title: Eve's Bayou
programme.desc: Over the course of a long, hot Louisiana summer, a 10-year-old black girl, Eve Batiste (Jurnee Smollett), discovers that her family's affluent existence is merely a facade. The philandering of her suave doctor father, Louis (Samuel L. Jackson), creates a rift, throwing Eve's mother, Roz (Lynn Whitfield), and teenage sister, Cicely (Meagan Good), into emotional turmoil. Eve, though, manages to find some solace with her quirky psychic aunt, Mozelle (Debbi Morgan).

programme.title: In the Mix
programme.desc: Mobster Frank (Chazz Palminteri) hires hip DJ Darrell (Usher) to man the turntables at a party for his gorgeous daughter, Dolly (Emmanuelle Chriqui). At the event, some crooks pull guns on the gangster, and Darrell steps in to save his life. Frank then gives the DJ a job as his daughter's bodyguard, but, to the mobster's dismay, Dolly starts to fall for the smooth-talking Darrell. Their romance is interrupted when Frank gets involved in a mob war and drags Darrell along with him.

programme.title: Judgment Night
programme.desc: New father Frank (Emilio Estevez) departs for a night out, joining friends Mike (Cuba Gooding Jr.) and Ray (Jeremy Piven) as they head to a boxing match. At the last minute, they are joined by John (Stephen Dorff), Frank's brother. Stuck in gridlock traffic, the guys take a shortcut that gets them lost. In a very dangerous neighborhood, they witness a murder by a gang leader called Fallon (Denis Leary). They flee, but Fallon now wants them hunted down and eliminated.

programme.title: Akeelah and the Bee
programme.desc: Akeelah, an 11-year-old girl living in South Los Angeles, discovers she has a talent for spelling, which she hopes will take her to the National Spelling Bee.

programme.title: Chaos
programme.desc: A veteran detective is teamed with a rookie cop when they are sent to negotiate with a bunch of criminals holding a bank hostage. It transpires that a master thief has planted a computer virus that will drain funds from the bank's accounts. The detective faces a race against time to catch the thief and stop the randomly evolving computer virus, which models its behavior on the bewildering principles of chaos theory.

programme.title: Falcon Rising
programme.desc: A former Marine (Michael Jai White) travels to Brazil to hunt down the brutal Japanese mobsters who attacked his sister and left her for dead.

programme.title: Medusa Deluxe
programme.desc: Talented and cutthroat hairstylists at a competition find one of their own murdered before judging can begin. Winding through neon-lit halls, competitors unspool long-simmering resentments and lies as they search for the killer among them.

programme.title: The Trap
programme.desc: A man returns home to Atlanta to save his family's struggling restaurant with the help of a new chicken recipe.

programme.title: Samuel L. Jackson: Did I Stutter?
programme.desc: Follows actor Samuel L. Jackson and his six-decade journey to becoming one of Hollywood's highest-grossing film actors.

programme.title: Eve of Destruction
programme.desc: An anti-terrorist (Gregory Hines) hunts a walking bomb made by a scientist (Renée Soutendijk) in her own image, with all of her hang-ups.

programme.title: A Haunted House
programme.desc: Young couple Malcolm (Marlon Wayans) and Kisha (Essence Atkins) have just moved into their dream home. As they settle in, they learn that they're not alone -- not because the house is haunted, but because Kisha is possessed by a demon. Desperate to salvage his relationship -- and more importantly -- his sex life -- Malcolm hires a coterie of paranormal specialists, which includes a priest and ghostbusters, to banish the unwelcome intruder from Kisha's body.

programme.title: A Haunted House 2
programme.desc: After the ordeal he suffered with his now former girlfriend's (Essence Atkins) demonic possession, Malcolm (Marlon Wayans) has decided to start fresh. He has a new girlfriend named Megan (Jaime Pressly), and they and Megan's children are moving into their dream home. Soon afterward, Malcolm is once again plagued by supernatural shenanigans -- only this time, it's not just the house that's haunted. A demon has attached itself to Malcolm, and shows no signs of letting go.

programme.title: Reasonable Doubt
programme.desc: A prosecutor (Dominic Cooper) commits a fatal hit-and-run, then manipulates the case so that the man who was arrested for the crime is acquitted. After the trial, he discovers that his actions have freed a guilty man.

programme.title: The Cotton Club
programme.desc: The lives of various characters intersect at Harlem's renowned Cotton Club. Handsome horn player Dix Dwyer falls for Vera Cicero, the stunning girlfriend of famous gangster Dutch Schultz. Meanwhile, Dix's brother, Vincent, falls in with Schultz's crew, while Owney Madden, the jazz venue's proprietor, has his own mob ties. Although Dix goes on to become a Hollywood actor, his life doesn't get any less complicated or dangerous.

programme.title: Greyson Family Christmas
programme.desc: An ambitious African-American law student returns home for Christmas with her boyfriend. The family is unsettled because the boyfriend is white.

programme.title: A Snowy Day in Oakland
programme.desc: A beautiful psychologist from San Francisco decides to end a stalled romance with her high-profile psychiatrist boyfriend and business partner. She moves on with her life by opening her own practice in a vacant office space in the middle of a small commercial block located across the bay in Oakland, turning the predominately African American and psychologically ignored neighborhood on its emotional ear.

programme.title: Brotherly Love
programme.desc: In Philadelphia, a high-school basketball player, his sister and their older brother face life-changing decisions as they struggle to make something of themselves.

programme.title: Outlaw Johnny Black
programme.desc: Cowboy Johnny Black vows to gun down Brett Clayton, the man responsible for the death of his father. He soon becomes a wanted outlaw while posing as a preacher in a small mining town that's been taken over by a notorious land baron.

programme.title: All Dirt Roads Taste of Salt
programme.desc: A lyrical, decades-spanning exploration of a Black woman's life in Mississippi, winding through love and heartbreak.

programme.title: Fled
programme.desc: During a routine prison work detail, convict Piper (Laurence Fishburne) is chained to Dodge (Stephen Baldwin), a cyberhacker, when gunfire breaks out. Apparently, the attack is related to stolen money that the Mafia is after, and some computer files that somebody wants desperately to bury. The pair, who don't exactly enjoy each other's company, escape and must work together if they are to reach Atlanta alive. Luckily, they meet a woman (Salma Hayek) who may be willing to help them.

programme.title: Mad Money
programme.desc: After her husband loses his job, upper-crust housewife Bridget Cardigan (Diane Keaton) is forced to take a job as a janitor at the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City, Mo. Spotting a weakness in the bank's security system, Bridget convinces her two new friends Nina (Queen Latifah) and Jackie (Katie Holmes) to help her steal a fortune in worn-out bills that have been earmarked for destruction.

programme.title: As Good as Dead
programme.desc: Bryant befriends a troubled teen and introduces him to martial arts. As Bryant's mysterious and dangerous past catches up to him, he is forced into a life and death struggle to clear his name, save the boy and get back all he left behind.

programme.title: Fatal Beauty
programme.desc: Detective Rita Rizzoli (Whoopi Goldberg) is accustomed to donning costumes and going undercover to nail crooks. But she'll be required to use all of her get-ups and more when a major cocaine ring is suspected of turning out a potent new strain of the drug, called "Fatal Beauty." With the help of her partner, Jimenez (Ruben Blades), and a former bodyguard for a local cartel (Sam Elliott), Rita will do whatever it takes to find out who's dealing Fatal Beauty and stop them.

programme.title: Original Gangstas
programme.desc: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence.

programme.title: Crossover
programme.desc: The lives of a gifted athlete (Wesley Jonathan) and his best friend (Anthony Mackie) change when they take a fateful trip to Los Angeles.

programme.title: Triple Threat
programme.desc: A crime syndicate places a hit on a billionaire's daughter, making her the target of an elite assassin squad. A band of down-and-out mercenaries protects her, fighting tooth and nail to stop the assassins from reaching their target.

programme.title: As Good as Dead
programme.desc: Bryant befriends a troubled teen and introduces him to martial arts. As Bryant's mysterious and dangerous past catches up to him, he is forced into a life and death struggle to clear his name, save the boy and get back all he left behind.

programme.title: Blood Brother
programme.desc: A recently released convict takes murderous revenge against his childhood friends who let him take the fall for their crimes.

programme.title: Snipes
programme.desc: Erik Triggs is a good-natured Philadelphia teen and aspiring rapper who works at a hip-hop record label. There he hangs with rising superstar Prolifik during the day and works on his own music after hours. However, when Prolifik is kidnapped and his unreleased album is stolen, the record label's sleazy owner, Bobby Starr, assumes Erik and his friend Malik are responsible. The two soon find themselves on the run.

programme.desc: A man (Darren McGavin) tries to trick an elderly woman (Patricia Collinge) out of a family heirloom.

programme.desc: A year after the murders, a newspaper reporter (Joan Lorring) attempts to interview Lizzie Borden (Carmen Mathews) and her sister about the killings.

programme.desc: An English man (John Williams) murders his wife and moves to California, thinking he has committed the perfect crime.

programme.desc: Two greedy brothers plan to murder their elderly aunt (Mildred Natwick) in an attempt to inherit her money.

programme.desc: A desperate couple (Charles Bronson, Norma Crane) plans to rob an eccentric old woman (Estelle Winwood).

programme.desc: An angel (Alan Napier) allows a murdered mystery writer (John Williams) to return to Earth to uncover his killer.

programme.title: Help Wanted

programme.title: Portrait of Jocelyn
programme.desc: A man (Philip Abbott) is startled to see a portrait of his first wife four years after she disappeared.

programme.title: Orderly World of Mr. Appleby
programme.desc: An antiques dealer (Robert H. Harris) decides his art objects are too beautiful to sell. With Louise Larabee.

programme.title: Never Again
programme.desc: An insecure woman (Phyllis Thaxter) who can't control her drinking loses control at a cocktail party.

programme.title: The Photographer & the Undertaker
programme.desc: Professional killers (Jack Cassidy, Harry Townes) with the same employer find that each has the other as his next target.

programme.title: Thou Still Unravished Bride
programme.desc: Only hours before his wedding, a London detective discovers that his American fiancée has disappeared.

programme.title: Completely Foolproof
programme.desc: A wealthy land developer is shocked to discover that his wife is seeking to divorce him.

programme.title: Power of Attorney
programme.desc: A dishonest lawyer takes over a rich widow's holdings but underestimates her companion's (Geraldine Fitzgerald) wrath.

programme.title: The World's Oldest Motive
programme.desc: A philandering husband arranges his wife's murder, then has a sudden change of heart and frantically tries to prevent it.

programme.title: The Monkey's Paw: A Retelling
programme.desc: A gruesome surprise awaits a desperate man who thinks that a monkey's paw will bring him financial luck.

programme.title: The Second Wife
programme.desc: A mail-order bride (June Lockhart) has ultimately tragic suspicions about the strange death of her husband's first wife.

programme.title: Gentleman From America
programme.desc: Using a haunted house in their ploy, two men (Ralph Clanton, John Irving) scheme to con a wealthy American (Biff McGuire) out of his money.

programme.title: The Baby Sitter
programme.desc: A garrulous babysitter (Thelma Ritter) enjoys being the center of attention after her employer is murdered.

programme.title: The Belfry
programme.desc: A murderer (Jack Mullaney) hides from a posse after killing a school teacher's (Pat Hitchcock) fiancé.

programme.title: The Hidden Thing
programme.desc: A man (Biff McGuire) struggles to remember the license plate number of the vehicle that killed his fiancée (Judith Ames).

programme.title: The Legacy
programme.desc: While vacationing in Palm Beach, a reserved heiress (Leora Dana) becomes the romantic focus of a prince (Jacques Bergerac).

programme.title: Mink
programme.desc: A woman (Ruth Hussey) is stunned to learn that a mink coat she bought had been stolen from a previous owner.

programme.title: Decoy
programme.desc: A young pianist (Robert Horton) is framed, by the woman (Cara Williams) he loves, for a murder he did not commit.

programme.title: The Creeper
programme.desc: A New York City woman (Constance Ford) is convinced she will be the next victim of a serial killer. With Steve Brodie.

programme.title: Momentum
programme.desc: Murder results when a wife (Joanne Woodward) nags her husband (Skip Homeier) to stand up for himself.

programme.title: Wet Saturday
programme.desc: After his daughter commits murder, a man (Sir Cedric Hardwicke) finds a way to protect his family's reputation.

programme.title: Fog Closing In
programme.desc: An escaped mental patient (George Grizzard) encounters a woman (Phyllis Thaxter) who's afraid to be alone in her house.

programme.title: De Mortuis
programme.desc: Two friends unknowingly tell a middle-aged professor (Robert Emhardt) about his wife's (Cara Williams) reputation.

programme.title: Kill With Kindness
programme.desc: A brother and sister (Hume Cronyn, Carmen Mathews) scheme to defraud an insurance company. With James Gleason.

programme.desc: A man (Hurd Hatfield) assumes another identity to kill his aunt (Mildred Dunnock) but forgets one important detail.

programme.desc: A man (Robert H. Harris) is overjoyed to learn that his long-forsaken love (Jessica Tandy) has searched him out to marry him.

programme.desc: A young man is overcome with grief when he learns of his father's demise and accuses his new mother of the crime.

programme.desc: An underworld kingpin (Robert Middleton) learns that his wife (Kathleen Hughes) has been unfaithful to him. With Henry Silva.

programme.desc: A publisher (John Williams), intrigued by an unpublished murder mystery, visits the author (Patricia Collinge).

programme.desc: A mystery writer with an overactive imagination conjures up murderous thoughts about her new neighbors.

programme.title: John Brown's Body
programme.desc: A wife (Leora Dana) regrets having her sane husband (Russell Collins) committed to a mental institution.

programme.title: Crackpot
programme.desc: Newlyweds (Biff McGuire, Mary Scott) meet a volatile stranger (Robert Emhardt) while on their honeymoon.

programme.title: Nightmare in 4-D
programme.desc: A gorgeous actress (Barbara Baxley) asks a neighbor (Henry Jones) to help her hide the body of a murder victim.

programme.title: My Brother Richard
programme.desc: A man (Harry Townes) kills a gubernatorial candidate to ensure his brother's (Royal Dano) election. With Inger Stevens.

programme.desc: A prisoner tries to convince a police sergeant to allow him to escape while they are on their way to San Quentin.

programme.desc: A man tries one last desperate attempt to win back the woman he loves by inviting her new lover for a drink.

programme.title: Malice Domestic
programme.desc: A woman (Phyllis Thaxter) is suspected of trying to poison her husband (Ralph Meeker).
