programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Julian sets up a blood bank for baby alpacas, but collecting donations is harder than expected. Peter is woken at 2am by an emergency call-out for a pregnant cow, and must be at his sharpest to deliver the calf safely. A sheepdog undergoes treatment to remove a tumour, a cat is in need of castration, and Katie visits a bad-tempered pig with very sore eyes.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Mangalitsa pig breeder Lisa is worried about her boar Hal, who has a large lump on his neck. A famous client brings their dog to the practice. Matt is in uncharted waters as he heads to a local college to operate on one of their fish.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Peter comes to the aid of a cow that has suffered a prolapsed uterus. He also meets elderly cat Sawsa, while Julian helps farmer Chris artificially inseminate his pigs. Plus, owner Betty is concerned when her beloved lhasa apso Billy develops a lump on his tummy and a persistent eye infection.

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: An old friend of Peter heads down to the practice with a sheep who had one lamb last night, but is struggling to give birth to her second. Although neither vet nor farmer are feeling optimistic for the unborn lamb's chances.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Two babies' lives hang in the balance. Peter rushes into Skeldale on his day off to try and save Richard Bell's lamb, who was badly injured when he was born just a few hours ago. And at Suzanne Benson's trekking centre, Julian's treating a very poorly one-week old llama called Noah.

programme.title: Autumn Babies
programme.desc: Baby rock wallabies, gorillas, little wrestlers. This is the time that animals build up their food stores for the coming winter. The time is fun for the babies while their parents are busy.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: When the RSPCA receives a report that a couple who are banned from keeping animals have got new dogs, Inspector Clare Wilson is quick to act. But, when she arrives at the property, it looks like the job is going to be slightly bigger than first anticipated...

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Julian and Peter have to cope with two night-time emergency call outs. New vet Esme performs her first emergency caesarean and a pack of bloodhound pups cause mayhem in the surgery.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: In this episode Julian is called out to a desperately ill calf, he is weak and cannot stand. This baby is so poorly that his life hangs in the balance. Peter gets a 'bum deal' when he meets a senior citizen cat with severe constipation.

programme.title: More Baby Animals From Africa
programme.desc: The wild youngsters of Africa are the focus. A pair of cheeky Lion cubs head out on an adventurous prowl, go bobbing for greens with an adorable Pygmy Hippo, plus cruise along with some playful Camels, named mini ships of the desert.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: When a baby alpaca's life hangs in the balance, Julian performs an emergency blood plasma transfusion on the front lawn of the Thirsk practice. Peter meets a cat with an unusual backstory, but who now has a serious eye problem.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Peter and Matt head to cannon hall farm, where their old friend Prince the Reindeer has antler problems. And at Skeldale Peter's also reunited with infamously feisty cockatiel Oscar, who once put a vet in hospital.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Julian Norton tries to save the lives of a heifer and her unborn calf, while his colleague Peter Wright also faces a dramatic labour with a Yorkshire Terrier cross

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Janine and her two girls are looking for a dog to join their girl squad while the Sulinom family have been waiting over 20 years to adopt a puppy.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Lanita and her two grown-up kids meet a dog with a rough backstory, mum of five Danielle wants a furry friend to keep her company and avid cyclists Jo and Jarvie are ready to join the dog club.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: New Kiwis, the Bolton family meet a cheeky puppy. Kate and Neill are ready for a new four-legged friend after a bereavement and flatmates Amanda and Rob look for a canine addition.

programme.title: Baby Animals From Asia
programme.desc: We head on an adventure through Asia, prowl around with some cheeky Amur Leopard cubs, go underwater to catch a baby Spinner Dolphin practice it's loops, plus watch some rare Giant Panda cubs grow up right before your eyes, via a den cam.

programme.title: Forest Babies
programme.desc: Our day is taking place in the forests of the world. We see grizzly bear cubs, baby gibbons and owl chicks among the many babies featured who live in the forest.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Matt Smith heads to Cannon Hall Farm where Rob and Dave's latest arrival, a Highland calf, has serious breathing problems. Elsewhere, Rohin Aojula takes his dad on a call to help a horse that has suffered a nasty injury while out riding.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: A special episode focusing on births and babies. Julian heads to a local farm where a cow is struggling in labour. And with bringing new life into the world such a vital part of a vet's job, Julian's also hoping to assist in the birth of a career.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: In this episode The Yorkshire Vet, Julian Norton, is called to an emergency down on the farm where semi-retired farmers, The Peckitt's have a cow suffering from an excruciatingly painful and life-threatening condition, bloat. Former Herriot trainee, Peter Wright, treats a hand-reared lamb who is going for the chop (not that sort) because he's causing chaos in the family to which he's been adopted.

programme.title: Urban Babies
programme.desc: A day in the life of the extremely cute baby animals that we encounter in our everyday lives.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Will 3-year old Ollie and his family find a forever friend in staffy puppy Tiger? Can Frankie the pup help Simon overcome a childhood dog attack trauma? And will Jaran be Liz and Scott's first dog?

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: The Yorkshire Vet, Julian Norton has his work cut out in this episode. There's peril in the pig pen as he risks life and limb to inject a ferocious porker and a mystery to solve with stud alpaca Lothario, who's so far failed to live up to his namesake's reputation. Steve and Jeanie Green have spent a lifetime with cows.

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: To mark International Dog Day tomorrow, a special episode celebrating the magical relationship between man and dog.

programme.title: Episode 11
programme.desc: Will Winnie's appetite for destruction get in the way of finding a happy new home? Simba has a chance at love from Jenny. However, his instant bond with her twin brother, John, could be an issue.

programme.title: Episode 12
programme.desc: A sheep is rushed into the practice to see Peter, after seriously injuring herself on a piece of metal. Peter thinks he can deal with the wound, but the bigger problem is that the ewe is pregnant with twins. And the lambs' lives are in danger.

programme.title: Baby Animals From Latin America
programme.desc: Latin America is the destination.Tear around the high plains of the Andes with a wild and woolly baby Vicuna, have your world turned upside down by some gravity defying Capuchin babies and hit the waves with an energetic pod of Patagonian Sea Lion pups.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Julian Norton is called out on an emergency to a heifer that is in agony, with an object stuck in its painful, swollen and infected hoof. Peter removes a large lump from the head of golden retriever, Holly.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: When a complaint comes in about two skinny dogs, Inspector Herchy Boal is straight on the case. Staffie crosses Rocky and Bentley are both extremely underweight and in need of help, but is it just a decent meal these two need or is something else wrong?

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Pete and Hernando are smitten with Tibetan spaniel mix Baxter. But will their picky chihuahua Bruno approve? Can doctor Patrick offer chill senior citizen Buster the red cattle dog a retirement home?

programme.title: Special Home Visits
programme.desc: In The Yorkshire Vet - Home Visits, Peter and Julian catch up with old friends and find out how they're getting on. The Greens are one of the practice's favourite farming families and their lives have been full of ups and downs. One of their most difficult times was having to sell their dairy herd. Now there's a worry about another of their animals, Britney the greyhound.

programme.title: More Farm Babies
programme.desc: We revisit the farms to catch the antics of the babies in the country. Miniature horses, baby goats, piglets and lambs are featured among other more exotic farm animals.

programme.title: Water Babies
programme.desc: We meet the water babies that live in the aquatic regions, aquariums and maritime parks of the world. We meet African penguins, baby seals and otter pups.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Julian Norton is called out to examine an alpaca, new vet Helen Blackburn performs an emergency caesarean on a beagle and Peter tries to save the eyesight of Whisper the lamb.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Following the comings and goings at the World's most famous vets - James Herriot's old practice, Skeldale Veterinary Centre in Thirsk, North Yorkshire now run by former Herriot trainee, Peter Wright and partner, Julian Norton. In this episode Julian goes head to head with Hilda the Highland Cow - battling to remove a large lump from between her horns.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Peter rushes to help a pregnant cow that is expecting twins, which is uncommon. Julian meets a champion ferret who has an infected foot. Shona heads out to see an old horse that is suffering with sore eyes.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Charlotte is looking for a dog to give her best friend Zeke the pug some love. Will loveable Harley win the Macdonald family over? Could former dance Natasha be the ticket out for husky cross Aislinn?

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Julian Norton tries to save Millie, a much-loved farm dog and an albino wallaby called Albert. Peter Wright has his hands full with a cheeky pygmy goat called Charlie. Other patients include a hedgehog called Monster.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Single Dad Rinesh and his two girls are looking for a puppy. Newlyweds Heidi and Steve are excited to rescue a fur baby and sisters Sally and Megan met a nervous dog with a traumatic history.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Melissa is looking to begin her journey as a first-time dog owner, and carer for the elderly Jillian hopes for a furry companion who will enjoy the social side of her job.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: The Ashcroft-Schulz family are excited to adopt a rescue dog, but son Arlo is nervous. Hamilton mother of eight Jo wants a furry friend and newlyweds Hannah and Lynda meet a Swiss Shepherd.

programme.title: Beach Babies
programme.desc: Our day is taking place alongside some of the beaches of the world, checking out the non-stop action both on shore and further out to sea.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Favourite stories and unseen footage from the series, following Yorkshire vet Julian Norton, his partner Peter Wright and their team.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: When footage of a dog being beaten by his owner comes to the attention of the RSPCA, inspector Mel Fisher is straight on the case. It doesn't take long for her to rescue the young German Shepherd and bring the owner to justice. In Sunderland, inspector Jaqui Miller has her hands full when three generations of dogs are signed over by their struggling owner, and help has arrived just in time.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Are two dogs too many when the Prestia family meet a bonded pair? Will retired nuns Margaret and Antoinette find their final doggy companion? Can Justin the magician handle large puppy Oreo's tricks?

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Peter rushes to an emergency. Treasured harness racing horse, Magnum, has been involved in an horrendous accident. He's sustained an horrific injury. Can Peter save Magnum or is it the end of the line?

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Will it be a love affair when Elaine is paired with fellow single girl Hayley the blue Staffy? Plus, a family have the pick of two dogs, Rusty the kelpie and Lightning the Australian terrier cross.

programme.title: Extreme Cold Babies
programme.desc: We are in the cold parts of the planet. We spend time with playful seal pups, and penguin chicks. Plus out on the pack ice a baby polar bear plays.

programme.title: Grassland Babies
programme.desc: Today's episode takes place in the grasslands of the world. We see Lynx kittens, a wild foal, and baby mongooses among other animals featured.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Julian Norton treats a cow with a rare and complex problem. The cow's stomach has become displaced and moved to the wrong side of her body, causing pain and stopping her eating. Meanwhile in Thirsk, a baby roe deer is brought into the practice as it has stopped taking milk, and a dog has a large tumour removed in a tricky operation.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Peter rushes to save a newborn calf who's going downhill fast. Julian visits Tazmin the huge eagle. Peter's old friend, Bison, the much-loved boxer, has hormone problems. Can Julian get a poorly ewe well enough to have lambs? Zoe's language skills are put to the test. Dexter the Ferret returns. He's known to nip, so will Julian keep his fingers intact?

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Julian races to help a pony with a large gash on her neck and Peter battles to save a sheep. A greedy cat has a stick stuck in his mouth and Julian faces a massive, messy job - pregnancy testing over 50 cows.

programme.title: Baby Animals From Europe
programme.desc: Venturing through Europe, meeting the youngsters that live and play there.There's Brown Bear cubs messing around, a litter of scrappy Red Fox kits doing their best impression of a whirlwind as they play fight, plus a bunch of hungry St Bernard pups.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Julian helps a pregnant ewe with a tricky birth. Peter must remove a large tumour from a dog's bottom. Julian investigates a mystery llama injury. A female rhea has been injured during mating season. And can Peter save a schoolgirl's precious pony?

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Pomeranian Prince is ready to rule his kingdom - will the Acton family be his new loyal subjects' And will Winnie's obsession with chewing squeaky toys be his downfall with the Johnsons'

programme.title: Episode 11
programme.desc: Peter heads back to the Teasdales' farm where he recently delivered a healthy calf. But this time the pressure is really on, as the expectant mum belongs to Ian's young son, Alfie.

programme.title: Pet Babies
programme.desc: We spend time hanging about with our favourite pets. Featuring puppies, kittens and baby rabbits among more exotic animals we keep for pets.

programme.title: Episode 13
programme.desc: As night falls, Matt rushes out to help a young farmer's pregnant sheep whose life is in danger. Peter treats Jean Green's trusty old rescue dog Reuben, who's couch bound with arthritis.

programme.title: More Pet Babies
programme.desc: This time we spend the day with some of the world's most beloved pets. Kittens, puppies and baby guinea pigs are some of the babies we have fun with.

programme.title: Baby Animals From Australia and New Zealand
programme.desc: We hang out with the youngsters that live and play in Australia and New Zealand. A baby Koala backpacks around the bush with its mum, join Fur Seal pups for a rocking good time on the rugged shores of New Zealand and bound around with Kangaroo joeys.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Rupert the adored trekking llama is lame and in agony. Can Julian save Rupert's career? Peter pregnancy tests cows. But will all of Arthur's prized herd be in calf? Ruben the lurcher was rescued by elderly local farmers, Jean and Steve Green. But his love of Jean's home cooking might be causing problems. Ellie May, a treasured moggie, is accidentally run over by her devastated owner.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Will Sweetie the sassy staffy hit the sweet spot for Hillary and Jaxson' Can senior snaggletooth George find the perfect retirement home that he has been looking for with ex-pat professional Janice'

programme.title: Darkness Follows
programme.desc: Some bonds can't be broken-like a mother's love or a killer's grip on his victim. Al, Kellie, and her daughter Hailey move into a Montreal townhouse, aware of its tragic past. A teen girl, evicted with her mother, took her own life. But death wasn't the end. Haunting audio recordings reveal she has returned-with a follower. As Al obsesses over a past murder, Kellie fears a killer still lurks.

programme.title: Shape of Evil
programme.desc: Jay Yaple moves his family into a fixer-upper in Enfield, CT, unaware of its dark history. Unexplained events soon turn into terrifying attacks, and Jay realizes a malevolent entity is targeting them. Anyone who tries to help is driven away by the demon. Trapped and desperate, the family turns to an exorcist as their last hope-but will it be enough to break the entity's hold?

programme.title: Phantom Room
programme.desc: Shari and Erol's new California home seems perfect-until they discover a hidden room in the garage. Strange events follow, but while Shari believes the house is haunted, Erol remains skeptical. When the ghost becomes violent, Shari seeks help from a psychic, who uncovers an angry spirit determined to drive them out. Can they reclaim their home before the ghost tears their family apart?

programme.title: Conjuring Evil
programme.desc: Harold and Cindy's peaceful Alaskan retreat turns into a nightmare when their daughter unknowingly invites a dark entity through witchcraft. What starts as small disturbances escalates into violent attacks, even hospitalizing Cindy's mother. A skeptic, Harold investigates and uncovers the terrifying truth. With their family in danger, they call in experts to reclaim their home.

programme.title: Fear Feeders
programme.desc: After buying a home near Fort Wayne, Al Gonzalez hears strange noises and sees shadows but keeps quiet, fearing no one will believe him. When entities torment him day and night-mimicking a deceased loved one-he seeks help. Investigators confirm the house is infested with dangerous spirits, and Al realizes he may not be their first victim.

programme.title: Child's Play
programme.desc: Chris and Roseann Cupit find comfort in the spirit of Chris' late grandmother watching over their Arkansas home. But her presence is a warning-a relentless demon has targeted their daughter, tormenting her with night terrors and attacks. Desperate, they seek help from their pastor, but he refuses. Turning to a paranormal team and a demonologist, they prepare for a battle to save their family.

programme.title: Hidden Terror
programme.desc: Living together requires balance, but Mike and Lisa aren't alone in their new home. Lisa's behavior changes inexplicably, and Mike grows desperate for answers. A late-night encounter with an invisible force convinces him they are haunted. He sets up surveillance, watching and waiting. What he captures shakes him to the core-are ghosts real, or is he losing his mind?

programme.title: Masks of Terror
programme.desc: After Jeanette Osborne decorates her home with Haitian masks, eerie events escalate, leading her son Grier to believe they are cursed. When an unseen force attacks him, Jeanette seeks help from a voodoo priest and paranormal expert John Zaffis. As malevolent energy threatens her family, Jeanette must confront the spirits' wrath before their home becomes a place of irreversible terror.

programme.title: The Diabolical
programme.desc: How would reality change if we couldn't perceive or communicate in conventional ways? For Marie, this question is daily life. Her daughter Julie, unable to walk or talk, interacts with unseen forces. Marie wonders if they're angels-until she comes face to face with a demon. A Ouija board session turns their home into a portal for darkness, proving that evil can lurk in the most ordinary places.

programme.title: Demon Unearthed
programme.desc: Jennifer and Norman Rice buy a historic mansion in Garden Grove, Iowa, but renovations uncover eerie rumors of a buried body. As the paranormal activity intensifies, Jennifer and their son are tormented while Norman is away. When he returns, he too falls victim to the evil force. Even the church's blessing fails, forcing the family to flee their dream home before it destroys them.

programme.title: Heartland Horror
programme.desc: Teenager Nolan Lydolph has seen ghosts all his life, but after a ghost tour in Branson, MO, his family's Iowa farmhouse becomes plagued by sinister shadows. When attacks turn violent, Nolan and his mother call paranormal investigator Wesley Fox. He and his psychic wife uncover a calculating demon targeting Nolan, forcing him into a life-threatening battle for survival.

programme.title: Demon Whispers
programme.desc: When Phil Pritchard's beloved father dies, he falls into a deep depression that renders him vulnerable to an unearthly evil that begins influencing him and will stop at nothing to render him a pawn in its relentless thirst for misery and murder.

programme.title: Dark Dreams
programme.desc: Michigan attorney Chris Gibbons and his family move into their dream house, which quickly becomes a nightmare. A bizarre combination of terrifying dreams and ghost sightings force Chris to do battle with the supernatural.

programme.title: The Lake Club Horror
programme.desc: In Springfield, Illinois, the Lake Club was once a lively dance hall where fortunes were won and lost. In 1974, Bill and Tom transform it into a rock club and soon uncover eerie secrets. Phantom music and chilling cold spots make them believe they are not alone. Others share their fears, and a young woman receives a ghostly warning: one of the owners is about to die.

programme.title: Fear House
programme.desc: Childhood fear is pure, untempered by adult rationality. After his divorce, Steven LaChance dismisses his children's nightmares as stress-until he experiences chilling disturbances himself. Shadows lurk, screams echo, and an unseen force preys on them. He flees, but when another family moves in, he vows to help them. If you enter the spirit world, the spirits enter yours.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: When Sidney's girlfriend moves in, he and his mother, Jaime, experience disturbing events, escalating from eerie calls to physical attacks. They soon discover an ex-friend is using witchcraft to tear them apart. As Jaime becomes the target of a deadly assault, the family, fearing for their lives, seeks the help of paranormal investigators before the dark forces succeed in their sinister plan.

programme.title: Tunnel of Death
programme.desc: After Candace and John St. Clair visit a haunted tunnel where slaves were buried alive, something follows them home. Their daughter has terrifying nightmares, dishes shatter, and the entity soon turns violent. Attacked and terrified, they call paranormal experts to cleanse their home-before they're forced to flee from the malevolent presence.

programme.title: Mind Control
programme.desc: In 2012, Amanda Morrisson and her family clean a relative's home to fund his care but uncover satanic objects. Soon, they face terrifying events-Nate sees shadows, David has nightmares, and Alliah spirals into depression. When Amanda encounters a sinister entity, they seek a demonologist, who traces the haunting to an evil necklace David took from the house.

programme.title: Ghost Hunter
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator Stacy Jones feels confident letting her son Jamie join her at a cemetery investigation. But after returning home, Jamie finds strange scratches on his leg and experiences terrifying activity-objects flying and unseen forces attacking him. When Stacy witnesses a demonic assault on her son, she calls in expert John Zaffis to help save Jamie from possession.

programme.title: Game of Lies
programme.desc: In 2012, Olivia and Jesse Barbour's daughter Marie befriends a boy named Jackson-who isn't real. At first harmless, Jackson soon frightens Marie, leaving bruises and urging her to follow him to heaven. When she's found with red marks on her neck, the family seeks help. Investigators reveal Jackson is a cruel spirit-an old man disguised as a boy to torment Marie.

programme.title: Portal of Doom
programme.desc: While preparing their late friend Paul's house for sale, Anita Intenzo and her son Chris encounter his spirit-along with something much darker. When a violent entity attacks Chris, Anita seeks help. A medium warns of a demon linked to a mysterious artifact Paul acquired abroad. As chaos erupts in their home, Anita and Chris must locate the artifact before the demon destroys them.

programme.title: Casa de los Muertos
programme.desc: Latin jazz guitarist Eddie Benitez moves to Arizona to revive his career, but his home is haunted. Strange occurrences escalate when his son falls mysteriously ill. With no medical explanation, Eddie discovers the room was the site of a horrific suicide. Fearing the spirit is slowly killing his son, Eddie turns to his Puerto Rican roots to battle the deadly entity before it's too late.

programme.title: A Haunting in Ireland
programme.desc: The Fahey family has lived in their Galway townhouse for decades. When Martha brings home her newborn, eerie disturbances begin. Unexplained cries echo through the night, objects vanish, and a chilling presence fills the house. A priest offers no relief, but a healer reveals a dark secret-Martha's child has awakened the psychic energy of a long-buried crime that prayer alone cannot erase.

programme.title: Marked by Evil
programme.desc: After rejecting a friend's advances, Stephanie Winters is cursed. Soon, in their new Virginia home, she and her husband experience strange noises and objects moving. When the entity violently scratches and chokes Stephanie, they seek help. A paranormal investigator suspects a demonic ritual, leading them to a demonologist and the church to battle the dark force before it destroys Stephanie.

programme.title: Back from the Grave
programme.desc: North Carolina natives Jamie and Aaron live a 'perfect' Southern lifestyle until a dark entity begins communicating with and terrifying their children. The family risks ridicule by neighbors and family when they call paranormal experts to the rescue.

programme.title: Cursed
programme.desc: Modern science suggests we are all connected by energy. This may explain why Romie feels drawn to an abandoned house in Tucson, Arizona. After moving in, nightmares bleed into reality, and she sees a shadowy spirit. A clairvoyant urges her to communicate with it, but fear holds her back. As the entity targets only her, Romie begins to question her sanity-is the house haunted, or is she cursed?

programme.title: Evil Never Dies
programme.desc: Jennifer Hoke and fiancé Jamie Jones find their dream home in Pensacola, FL, but something dark lurks within. Strange noises and shadows soon escalate to violent attacks. Jamie is pulled from bed, and the family is trapped in terror. Seeking answers, they turn to a local empath, who uncovers a history more sinister than they ever imagined.

programme.title: Devil Inside Me
programme.desc: John Drenner Jr. unknowingly unleashes a demon after finding a satanic bible in an abandoned shack. Plagued by violent attacks and nightmares, he spirals into depression. Just as the entity threatens to claim his life, he finds hope in a young woman who helps him seek deliverance. With time running out, exorcist Bill Bean must act fast to drive out the demon before it's too late.

programme.title: Trapped in Terror
programme.desc: Taylor Jones reconnects with her estranged mother, Joyce, unaware of the darkness she brings. When Taylor finds Joyce practicing black magic in her daughter's room, she cuts ties-but it may be too late. Isabelle soon has an invisible friend, then grows terrified to be alone. As the haunting escalates, a paranormal team uncovers a tragic past in the attic, trapping tormented souls forever.

programme.title: Ghost Soldier
programme.desc: It's said that every photograph steals a piece of a soul. What happens when the subject is dead? Lisa becomes obsessed with a photo of her boyfriend's brother, killed in Vietnam. As her fixation deepens, she experiences waking visions of the soldier and believes the picture has a life of its own. When her daughters report supernatural encounters, Lisa realizes the spirit is taking control.

programme.title: Provoking Evil
programme.desc: Sam Baltrusis' séance performance leaves him possessed and desperate for safety. A Shaman battles the spirit, so Sam can regain control of his life.

programme.title: The Well to Hell
programme.desc: Mark Corvo rents out rooms in his childhood home, dismissing strange noises as quirks of an old house. But when a tenant, Ashley, dabbles in dark arts, sinister activity intensifies. A paranormal team confirms a portal has been opened. Mark, an empath, is targeted by dark forces and nearly dies after being pushed from his roof. After recovering, he learns to manage his gift and protect his home.

programme.title: Grave Awakenings
programme.desc: When ghosts confront Zoe Dei, she makes the harrowing discovery that her home harbors a paranormal portal which has awakened her dormant ability as psychic medium, forcing her to learn how to live with her newfound ability to see the dead.

programme.title: Gateway to Hell
programme.desc: In life, people can be tormented by their own crimes. The same may be true in death. In Wilder, Kentucky, a nightclub stands by the Licking River, said to draw murderers and Satanists. Club owner Bobby Mackey dismisses the legends-until his wife and an employee are attacked by unseen forces. Beneath the club, an old slaughterhouse well harbors an ancient evil, waiting to claim its next victims.

programme.title: The Haunted Cabinet
programme.desc: After James Hilton and his girlfriend Sandy bring an antique cabinet into their home, they capture actual video evidence proving it's haunted. Sandy fears the entity from the cabinet is taking James over and turns to paranormal investigators for aid.

programme.title: Ghost Inferno
programme.desc: Kim and Craig settle into their dream home in Bagley, Iowa, but eerie encounters shake their peace. Kim senses an intruder, and her daughter befriends a strange man-one no one else can see. When the unseen entity turns violent, a paranormal investigator confirms the presence of a vengeful spirit. Desperate to protect their family, they turn to a demonologist to drive out the ghost.

programme.title: The Apartment
programme.desc: Newlyweds Bill and Myrisa Spencer move into a renovated apartment, eager for a fresh start. But ghostly figures soon roam the halls, and their dream home turns into a nightmare. Unable to break their lease, they endure the hauntings-until a violent attack on Bill forces them to seek help. With local ghost hunters, they uncover the building's dark past and the entities that still linger.

programme.title: Face of Evil
programme.desc: Joy expects a fun girls' trip to a haunted plantation, but after returning home, a sinister spirit torments her children. When she sees its face in a trip photo, she realizes the entity is attached to her-not the plantation. As the spirit grows more aggressive, a determined paranormal investigator helps Joy uncover a terrifying past connection and fight to save her family.

programme.title: Ashes to Evil
programme.desc: Amelia and Calvin Braddy move into a Tennessee apartment, unaware it was once the site of a deadly fire. Amelia senses a presence, believing the spirits of lost children haunt their home. But when the activity turns violent, they realize a darker force is at play-one targeting their family. Desperate for safety, they seek paranormal investigators before it's too late.

programme.title: Norman the Doll
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator, Stephen Lancaster, doesn't believe in haunted objects until he captures proof the doll he recently acquired is haunted. Fearing he is in over his head, he attempts to get rid of it, but the doll has other plans.

programme.title: Ghosts of War
programme.desc: When Dennis Pongratz discovers his late father's WWII memorabilia, including a Nazi armband, eerie phenomena erupt in his home. A vengeful soldier's spirit seeks havoc, while another tries to stop it. As their home becomes a battleground between good and evil, Dennis and his wife Debbie must find a way to end the terror before it consumes them.

programme.title: Nightmare in the Attic
programme.desc: In 1983, the Fox family moves into a historic Arkansas home, but their daughter Mary quickly becomes the target of an unseen evil. An angry ghost and a demon haunt her dreams and waking life, hinting at the home's dark past. As the attacks intensify, the family turns to a psychic, who confirms their worst fear-Mary is in grave danger.

programme.title: House of Nightmares
programme.desc: When Tracey Berrios experiences paranormal activity inside her new home, she suspects spirits tied to the house's history. But after something evil attacks Tracey, she fears for the safety of her family and turns to paranormal investigators for help.

programme.title: Nightmare in Bridgeport
programme.desc: When his mother's house is haunted by a demon, Connecticut paranormal investigator Bob Baker calls in colleagues and a Bishop for help. But when they fail to cleanse the home, it's up to Bob to do the job, using experience from his own 'haunted' past.

programme.title: Demon Child
programme.desc: Some believe ghosts are human spirits seeking peace, while others say they are inhuman entities that feed on fear. Jan's lonely son Cody seems happy with his imaginary friend-until his behavior turns violent. When Cody reveals his friend lives in a red box in a cemetery, Jan seeks help from a Native American shaman. Through ancient rituals, she battles a force far more sinister than a lost soul.

programme.title: Ghost Fury
programme.desc: Alicia and Scott Cain's daughter befriends spirits of two boys who died in a fire, but their presence brings terrifying consequences. When Alicia and her older daughter encounter a blood-soaked apparition, they uncover a brutal murder tied to their home. Paranormal investigators and a priest intervene, but will they be able to free the family from the grip of these vengeful spirits?

programme.title: Where Demons Dwell
programme.desc: The Bible tells of a man possessed by a legion of demons. In Stamford, Connecticut, 12-year-old David has nightmares of a demonic old man flying toward his home. His terror grows daily. His mother is unsure how to respond-until David is physically attacked by an unseen force. Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren discover demons within him. They must act before he is lost to darkness.

programme.title: Haunted Past
programme.desc: As Deborah Utley begins experiencing paranormal events in her home, she turns to her faith for protection. But when her children are targeted by the entity she seeks the aid of paranormal investigators to end the cycle of terror.

programme.title: The Haunting of Summerwind
programme.desc: On the shores of West Bay Lake, Wisconsin, a mansion known as Summerwind stands between the living and the dead. Ginger falls in love with the house despite warnings and moves in with her family. As she restores it, a supernatural force pushes her husband toward madness. With their family unraveling, Ginger and her children fear the house will consume them all.

programme.title: The Forgotten
programme.desc: April and Matt buy a Victorian home in Salt Lake City, eager to restore it. But an unseen force detests change. Renovations stall, voices whisper, and April's son sees movement in his closet. Then, a dark entity appears, determined to drive them out. A medium warns that the house holds tormented children's spirits-and if they don't fight back, they too will become forgotten.

programme.title: Eternal Grief
programme.desc: After moving into a rural Indiana home, Jennifer Patterson hears voices and smells strange scents, suspecting the deceased former owner still lingers. Hoping to coexist, she stays-until the activity turns violent after her boyfriend moves in. Fearing for their safety, the couple seeks help from paranormal experts to uncover the dark truth behind their haunting.

programme.title: The Dark Side
programme.desc: America is full of forgotten cemeteries, some buried beneath new homes. Bobby Wilcott buys a historic manor in Indiana, hoping renovations will strengthen his marriage. But strange occurrences strain their bond-doors won't stay shut, lights flicker, and unease grows. Paranormal experts Ed and Lorraine Warren confirm the worst: a demonic presence is feeding on their fear.

programme.title: Dangerous Game
programme.desc: Carl, Keith, and Cynthia use a spirit board to contact a ghost in their home. At first, it seems harmless, but as violent activity increases, Keith senses danger. Carl, obsessed with the entity, ignores the warnings-until Cynthia is attacked. Realizing they've unleashed something sinister, the brothers call in a paranormal investigator to stop the terrifying presence before it's too late.

programme.title: Sallie's House
programme.desc: Deb and Tony are excited to start their life together in Atchison, Kansas. With their first child on the way, they settle into a charming home, hopeful for the future. After their son is born, his toys move on their own. Deb believes he has a ghostly playmate-until Tony suffers whispers, ghostly footsteps, and bloody wounds. A psychic warns that a darker force is using the spirit to wreak havoc.

programme.title: Black Magic
programme.desc: During renovations, Debbie Guy notices strange activity in her historic Pennsylvania home. After a guest dabbles in black magic, the disturbances turn violent. A ritual sacrifice unleashes a dark force that torments the household. A pastor's blessing fails, and paranormal investigators face their toughest case yet as they battle an evil entity that refuses to be controlled.

programme.title: Dark Forest
programme.desc: Time slowly erases reminders of the past. Old roads are abandoned, and their destinations forgotten. When Clara's family moves to rural Hinsdale, NY, they expect peace but find eerie disturbances. Ritualistic chanting echoes from the woods, and neighbors whisper of roaming ghosts. A psychic warns that spirits are drawn to their home-and to a gruesome secret hidden in the crawlspace.

programme.title: A Haunting in Connecticut
programme.desc: With the help of a psychic and an exorcist, the Parker family battles evil spirits that have invaded their home... and the lives of their children.

programme.title: A Haunting in Georgia
programme.desc: The parents of four-year-old Heidi Wyrick are terrified to learn that their daughter's 'imaginary playmate' is the ghost of a man who once lived- and died- in their suburban Atlanta neighborhood.

programme.title: Halloween Special
programme.desc: Join Bex, Sean and the team as they investigate The Wellington Hotel for Halloween. Based in Halewood, this public inn has more haunting inside of its walls than the spirits behind the bar.

programme.title: The Barn
programme.desc: Something Strange is haunting the remains of a colliery in Cheshire and Ghost Dimension head in to uncover the truth behind the activity!

programme.title: Deady Vengeance
programme.desc: On September 2nd 2015, the body of 2 years-old Méline is found in her home. Her father confesses to the murder.

programme.title: Lee Rodarte Jr.
programme.desc: Lee Rodarte Jr., a chef at Bonefish Grill in Jacksonville, Florida, murdered his colleague and ex-lover Savannah Gold.

programme.title: Above the Law
programme.desc: From judges to city council members, sometimes officials who are given authority take it too far.

programme.title: Dumbest Criminals
programme.desc: Officer Brandon Cruz prepares to detain Jerry Davis, for drunk driving; three handcuffed offenders star in the worst escape ever.

programme.title: Body in the Bag
programme.desc: A murdered woman is found in a duffle bag washed up on the Florida coast; her married, military lover is the prime suspect and a single gold earring seals his fate.

programme.title: Cold Case Twist
programme.desc: 14 years after an attack of a jogger, police trace a family tree using genetic genealogy and find the rapist.

programme.title: The Bookstore Murder
programme.desc: In 2010, Sherry Black is found stabbed to death in her bookstore in Salt Lake City, Utah. Police fail to identify her killer until advancements in DNA science reignite the case.

programme.title: Night Caller
programme.desc: In Clymer, south of Buffalo, NY, there is concern that school superintendent Keith Reed Jr. has disappeared. Police discover he had enjoyed a passionate night of sex with a married woman from Virginia - who has a jealous husband.

programme.title: Smoke and Mirrors
programme.desc: In Morgantown, WV, fire crews discover the body of Jimmy Michaels in bed. There's no obvious explanation for why he wouldn't have tried to escape the burning building until news of an affair starts to provide answers.

programme.title: Shattered Lives
programme.desc: In Emporia, KS, a pair of hikers discover a body floating in the Cottonwood River. It looks to investigators as though a car careened off the road, and the driver was flung out and killed as a result of the impact.

programme.title: Troubled Waters
programme.desc: In Green Bay, WI, Police respond to a 911 call from teacher Bob Bulik, who says he can't revive his wife Pam, 35, who he found floating in their bath tub. Bob claims that his wife was distraught over their failing marriage.

programme.title: Caught on Video
programme.desc: Police detain a man after his parents ask for help; officers respond to reports of shots fired; officers apprehend a man with a warrant; officers use video evidence to catch a burglary suspect.

programme.title: Failure-To-Appear
programme.desc: This fugitive was informed of his failure to appear on a charge that he was not aware of. With four Failure-To-Appear charges related to gang membership, this fugitive has fled from Clovis, California to New Mexico and then back to Los Angeles.

programme.title: Cross Country Killer
programme.desc: Police in Chicago, Illinois connect a series of local murders that ends up putting them on the hunt for a serial killer. Little do they know, their target has been busy on the other side of the country, hunting women in the California desert.

programme.title: Fallen Hero
programme.desc: An Olympic shot putt athlete is found dead in his own yard, shot multiple times. Police determine that this murder was no random act of violence, and the evidence soon uncovers a series of dark family secrets that threatens to tear them apart.

programme.title: Death in the Village
programme.desc: In one of the biggest investigations ever carried out by Tayside Police, evidence in the case of a pensioner's murder leads to a family friend.

programme.title: Takedown with Chris Hansen
programme.desc: Over the past two decades, Chris Hansen's investigations have led to hundreds of would-be sex criminals being stopped in their tracks. Amazingly, after 500 arrests and hundreds of millions of video views, men continue to try to meet children online. So, his mission continues.

programme.title: Murder of Breezy Otteson and Riley Powell
programme.desc: Two Utah teenagers disappeared without a trace, launching a four-month investigation. Detectives eventually uncovered the horrifying truth when the teens' bodies were discovered inside an abandoned mine shaft.

programme.title: Drunk at the Airport
programme.desc: A man trying to board a flight is stopped by staff when they observed apparent signs of intoxication.

programme.title: Drinkin' & Scooterin'
programme.desc: Police struggle with a drunk man on a scooter in a Walmart.

programme.title: Body in the Bag
programme.desc: A murdered woman is found in a duffle bag washed up on the Florida coast; her married, military lover is the prime suspect and a single gold earring seals his fate.

programme.title: In Losing It
programme.desc: In Singapore's only women's prison, about 800 inmates eat, sleep and live together in close confines.

programme.title: Michael David Dunn
programme.desc: In a racially charged shooting that fueled the BLM movement, the police desperately try to prove that 17-year-old Jordan Davis was not shot in an act of self-defense but cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: An Almost Perfect Crime
programme.desc: Initially ruled an accident, the death of Jean-Bernard Wiktorska took a sinister turn when a mysterious informant implicated his wife and her lover in the murder.

programme.title: Ashley Pegram
programme.desc: 28-year-old Ashley Pegram, a mother of three, was devastated when her partner and father of her youngest son died in a car accident. Lonely, she turned to dating apps and hastily arranged to meet a man she had just met online on April 3, 2015.

programme.title: Jack The Ripper Part 2
programme.desc: An examination of the notorious crimes of Jack the Ripper, among the most infamous serial killer in history, who murdered five women in Whitechapel, England.

programme.title: The Siege of Sidney Street
programme.desc: In 1911, a gun battle on the streets of London, The Siege of Sidney Street, is the first breaking-news story in history.

programme.title: In the Marabout's Shadow
programme.desc: On November 20th 2013, a fishermen discovers the corpse of a baby on the beach of Berck.

programme.title: Michael David Dunn
programme.desc: In a racially charged shooting that fueled the BLM movement, the police desperately try to prove that 17-year-old Jordan Davis was not shot in an act of self-defense but cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Flirters
programme.desc: Can you flirt your way out of an arrest?

programme.title: Stopped by the Law 3
programme.desc: After stopping to help a stranded motorist, a trooper finds himself in the path of a vehicle careening out of control; a car passenger brandishes a pistol, triggering a shootout with police; black ice causes a chain-reaction accident.

programme.title: Body at the Dock
programme.desc: A body is found floating at a dock in a North Florida creek; police initially suspect a motive of robbery, but the victim's complex love life suggests otherwise.

programme.title: The Schoolbag in the Road
programme.desc: In 1989, 14-year-old Stephanie Isaacson's body is found in the Las Vegas desert. The case goes cold for decades until a nonprofit organization provides funding for the last DNA sample recovered to be used in genealogy research. Will it succeed?

programme.title: The Slaying of Sylvia Quayle
programme.desc: In 1981, the body of Sylvia Quayle is discovered by her father in her Colorado home: she had been sexually assaulted, stabbed and shot. After a false confession and decades of investigative work, science breaks this case open.

programme.title: The Last Dance
programme.desc: In Silverthorne, Colorado, a photographer's wife seems to have mysteriously vanished in the night, until detectives learn he has a violent past. In Darby, Montana, a husband is dead, and Police have two suspects - his wife and mistress.

programme.title: Turmoil
programme.desc: In Easton, Pennsylvania, a lesbian love triangle spins out of control while in Gillette, Wyoming, a desperate housewife has a shocking tale of murder and revenge.

programme.title: Intruder
programme.desc: In Wilkes-Barre, Pennsylvania, Police respond to a report of a vicious home invasion, while in Olathe, Kansas, a brutal murder sends shock waves through Bible country.

programme.title: Ashes to Ashes
programme.desc: At Lake Mohave, Nevada, a fisherman stumbles across a human skull. In the North West of England, a husband claims his wife has left him for another man. But where is she?

programme.title: Bar Altercation
programme.desc: A Berkeley County, S.C., officer spots a possibly disabled vehicle only to find the driver overdosing; officers in Daytona Beach, Fla., respond to fight at a bar where a woman was knocked out; Richland, S.C., officers respond a shooting.

programme.title: Give It Up
programme.desc: With an original charge of child abuse, the female fugitive is arrested after visiting her husband in Federal Custody. With this fugitive driving on an illegal license for a 5th time, the Bounty Hunters talk him into giving himself up.

programme.title: The Laser Man
programme.desc: A gunman known as "The Laser Man" shot young immigrants in Stockholm as racist tensions rose in 1991 Sweden.

programme.title: Nicole White
programme.desc: When young mother Nicole White met Jonathan Harris online, he seemed like her ideal rugged man. CCTV from their second date at Jeepers Bar showed a great start, but Harris's mood changed. They drove off in Nicole's car, but she never made it home.

programme.title: The Ghost of Baton Rouge
programme.desc: Police hunt Louisiana serial killer Derrick Todd Lee through accounts, re-enactments, and footage leading to his dramatic capture.

programme.title: Mark Martin
programme.desc: Mark Martin made no secret of his desire to be a serial killer. Martin infiltrated Nottingham's homeless community, preyed on the vulnerable and murdered three women before he was caught.

programme.title: Murder of Annie Le
programme.desc: Yale graduate student Annie Le disappeared just days before marrying her college sweetheart. As investigators uncovered evidence of a violent struggle, they realized Annie had fallen victim to a horrific murder.

programme.title: Hotel Meltdown
programme.desc: Officers respond to a 911 call from hotel staff regarding a demanding woman.

programme.title: Shoplifting Haul
programme.desc: Woman blames racism for shoplifting haul at sporting goods store.

programme.title: Mary Kay Latourneau
programme.desc: Teacher Mary Kay Letourneau shocked the world after she began a sexual relationship with her 12-year-old student in the late 90's. But even 7 years in prison wouldn't end their controversial relationship.

programme.title: Will I Be Accepted?
programme.desc: As freedom looms for some and time stretches for others, one question lingers in the minds of the inmates in Institution A4 - will I be accepted?

programme.title: Marvin Williams
programme.desc: Vivica examines the murder of Cassandra Valentin by her fiance Marvin Williams. Williams and Valentin had begun dating in 2004 but their relationship quickly became violent.

programme.title: Murdered on the Eve of Adulthood
programme.desc: A day before her 18th birthday, the body of Marie Varnerot, a 17-year-old girl, was found half-naked on her bed in Maincy, near Melun.

programme.title: Nadine Aburas

programme.title: Bluebeard

programme.title: Sunk in the Lake
programme.desc: A drought at a French lake reveals a sunken Toyota holding the body of a U.K. expat who's been missing for two years; her controlling husband becomes police's prime suspect.

programme.title: A Family Torn Apart
programme.desc: Portageville, Missouri in 1998. The bodies of Megan and Sherri Scherer are found lifeless in their sitting room. Both had been shot in the head several times.

programme.title: The Coat Hanger Killer
programme.desc: In 1981, Linda Slaten is sexually assaulted and murdered in her Florida apartment while her children sleep.

programme.title: Friend or Foe
programme.desc: In Lexington, Kentucky, a newly wed wife parties like there's no tomorrow until a body is dumped on a golf course. In Brisbane, Australia, a mannequin on the street highlights there are fears for the safety of a missing wife.

programme.title: Romance Is Dead
programme.desc: In Poughkeepsie, New York, a Police officer discovers evidence his wife is guilty of cheating on him leading to a deadly encounter, while in Orlando, Florida, a newly wed wife gets herself a boy toy - with fatal results.

programme.desc: In Alpena, Michigan, a neighborhood recluse winds up dead after developing a special bond with his much younger house cleaner who enjoys spending his money.

programme.title: Proof Cocktail Bar & Bar Déjà Vu (Calgary & Canmore)

programme.title: Dear Friend & The Ostrich Club (Halifax & Dartmouth)

programme.title: The Substitute

programme.title: The Substitute 3: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: A mercenary poses as a teacher to get close to a gang of ruthless thugs.

programme.title: The Substitute 4: Failure Is Not an Option
programme.desc: A mercenary poses as a teacher to weed out a neo-Nazi group at a military school.

programme.title: Duchess
programme.desc: A petty criminal rises as a fierce anti-heroine in the dangerous, cutthroat world of diamond smuggling.

programme.title: Born to Raise Hell
programme.desc: Steven Seagal stars as an Interpol agent in Eastern Europe caught in a gang war-and out for vengeance.

programme.title: Wild Card
programme.desc: A Las Vegas bodyguard's gambling problem with the mob leads to one final, all-or-nothing play.

programme.title: From Paris with Love
programme.desc: John Travolta plays a rogue U.S. agent partnered with a rookie operative to stop a terrorist attack in Paris.

programme.title: Cut Bank
programme.desc: Liam Hemsworth plays a man whose video of a killing exposes long-buried secrets in a small Montana town.

programme.title: Primal
programme.desc: Nicolas Cage stars as a wildlife collector hunted by a political assassin.

programme.title: Debt Collectors
programme.desc: Two debt collectors head to Las Vegas while evading a drug kingpin out for revenge.

programme.title: Venomous
programme.desc: Mutant snakes escape a government lab after a terrorist attack and begin killing residents of a small town.

programme.title: Directors in Action
programme.desc: Bola's new attitude is tested as she encounters more filming hurtles.

programme.title: Pilot
programme.desc: When bank robbers Seth and Richie Gecko make a run for the border, a pit stop turns into a deadly standoff.

programme.title: Blown Away
programme.desc: An Irish bomber targets an old foe in Boston. Tommy Lee Jones and Jeff Bridges star.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: The life story of Yip Man, the first person to teach the Chinese martial art of Wing Chun. Stars Donnie Yen.

programme.title: Ip Man 2: Legend of the Grandmaster
programme.desc: Master Ip Man (Donnie Yen) and his family move to Hong Kong, where he aspires to create a martial arts school.

programme.title: Ip Man 3
programme.desc: Martial arts master Ip Man (Donnie Yen) takes on a crooked developer and his gang of thugs.

programme.title: Ip Man 4: The Finale
programme.desc: A Kung Fu master travels to the U.S. where his student has upset the local martial arts community.

programme.title: Master Z: Ip Man Legacy
programme.desc: After losing to Ip Man, a fighter is forced back into action. Stars Michelle Yeoh and Dave Bautista.

programme.title: The Asian Connection
programme.desc: Steven Seagal stars as an expat who robs banks in Southeast Asia and angers a drug cartel.
Nicolas Cage stars as an aging cop who faces ex-mercenaries in a bank standoff.

programme.title: Lord Of War
programme.desc: An arms dealer (Nicolas Cage) confronts the morality of his work as he is being chased by an INTERPOL Agent.

programme.title: Jet Li's Contract Killer
programme.desc: A rookie hitman and a luckless veteran hunt the "King of Killers" for a big reward. Stars Jet Li.

programme.title: Nightbreed
programme.desc: Falsely blamed for murder, a young man flees to Midian, a subterranean world populated by monsters.

programme.title: Blood Runs Thick
programme.desc: Fleeing the liquor store, Richie's visions worsen as the Gecko Brothers nearly collide with the Fullers.

programme.title: Mistress
programme.desc: Richie struggles with his visions. Seth makes a plan to cross the border. The Fullers suffer an RV breakdown.

programme.title: BloodRayne: The Third Reich
programme.desc: Half-vampire Rayne battles a Nazi commander raising the dead to make Hitler immortal.

programme.title: Invasion of the Body Snatchers
programme.desc: Donald Sutherland stars in this sci-fi classic where alien pods invade San Francisco and copy its residents.

programme.title: The Asian Connection
programme.desc: Steven Seagal stars as an expat who robs banks in Southeast Asia and angers a drug cartel.
Nicolas Cage stars as an aging cop who faces ex-mercenaries in a bank standoff.

programme.title: Lord Of War
programme.desc: An arms dealer (Nicolas Cage) confronts the morality of his work as he is being chased by an INTERPOL Agent.

programme.title: Air Strike
programme.desc: Bruce Willis and Adrien Brody star in this WWII epic about China's battle against Japanese bomber strikes.

programme.title: Stealth Fighter
programme.desc: A naval officer races to stop a former pilot carrying out his plans with an arms dealer.

programme.title: Mars Villa aka Wu Tang Magic Kick
programme.desc: John Liu and Phillip Ko star. Mar Tien Liang is the master of the Magic Kick. When his home is attacked by the Fang Kang he effortlessly defeats his opponent, but his wife Mar Tien Liang is horrified to witness such violence. She implores him never to use his magic kick again, and all is well, until Fang arrives to challenge the master.

programme.title: One Armed Swordsman - Tange Sazen: Rogue Swordsman
programme.desc: The time is the reign of the 8th shogun, Tokugawa Yoshimune. Tange Sazen, a one-eyed, one-handed swordsman, happens to acquire the "Kokezaru no jar" that Yagyu Genzaburo, the younger brother of the Yagyu clan lord, has lost, and he and Genzaburo hit it off. However, this treasure of the world hides a map of the Yagyu family's hidden treasures. A great battle soon ensues as the shogunate conspires against it...

programme.title: Lethal Three - Sanbiki ga Kiru: Episode 14
programme.desc: "Tono-sama" Heishiro Yasaka (Hideki Takahashi), "Sengoku" Shinnosuke Kuji (Koji Yakusho), and "Tako" Jinnai Tsubakuro (Shunputei Koasa) all have their reasons for traveling to Edo.

programme.title: Sword of Justice
programme.desc: A formidable assassin, Shui Yi Han, sporting his trademark umbrella sword, arrives in middle China to embark on a battle of all the assassins in the martial world. One of the best swordplay films ever made, a Must see!

programme.title: Dumb Boxer: Sho Kosugi Ninja Theatre Vol. 4
programme.desc: Sick and tired of oppression and torture a mute fighter takes the law in to his own hands and single-handedly terminates all the Japanese invaders in his area.

programme.title: Kung Fu from Beyond the Grave
programme.desc: Rare Billy film! Watch him fight Lo Lieh and demons! On the 7th month of the lunar calendar, all ghosts and spirits are active and get to walk the earth for a month so that they can find a way to reincarnate. During one of these nights, a young kid named Chun Sing (Billy Chong), is visited by his dead Father. Chun Sing's father states that he was murdered by a man named Kam Tai Fu (Lo Lieh). And as you may have guessed, Chun Sing must avenge his father's death.

programme.title: 47 Ronin and the Shadow Ninja
programme.desc: In March of the 14th year of the Genroku era (1688), Asano Ueshogashira, lord of the Ako clan, was attacked by Kira Uenosuke at Edo Castle, resulting in Uchishogashira's seppuku and the Asano clan's demolition.Araki Juzaemon (Narita Mikio), the chief retainer, sends Kaizuka Shingo (Hagiwara Kenichi) undercover in Ako to investigate the true intentions of Oishi Kuranosuke (Iwai Hanshiro).

programme.title: 17 Ninja (Jyushichinin no Ninja)
programme.desc: In the 8th year of Kan'ei, the second shogun, Hidetada, was seriously ill, and the time of Iemitsu was about to arrive. However, Iemitsu's younger brother Tadanaga was at Sunpu Castle, collecting letters of rebellion from the eleven feudal lords in the western part of the country, and was making some eerie movements.

programme.title: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Wing Chun has seen explosive growth, fueled by a blockbuster movie and a legion of new followers who regard it as the most effective fighting art there is. "We have seen heat waves before and not just because of Bruce Lee" says Ip Ching, son of Grandmaster Ip Man. Experience Wing Chun in its most authentic setting as we take you on a guided tour of many of Hong Kong's top schools. Although there is only one Wing Chun it has evolved into many styles...

programme.title: Revengeful Swordswoman
programme.desc: Hsiang Ying (Chia Ling), the daughter of a slain General, is out to avenge his death by taking on his killers.

programme.title: Death Duel of Kung Fu
programme.desc: Set against a backdrop of Ching/Ming, where two great fighters conflict and end up in a duel. One (Wong Tao) is a nationalist who wants to fight for his country against Manchu oppression and restore the Ming dynasty, whilst the other (John Liu) is a wanderer with expert kicking, who is actually a secret agent for the Ming loyalists. After some double crosses the duel joins forces to fight the mighty Manchu Fighter and stop his forces from reaching the Taiwan straits.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: Lady Lallaine Reed
programme.desc: Lady Lallaine Reed's life was a tapestry woven with threads of trauma. Kidnapped as a child, her innocence shattered, she carried the scars of that violation deep within her soul. Fate, cruel and unrelenting, struck again when her own child was abducted, leaving her reeling on the precipice of despair. Yet, from the depths of this abyss, Lady Lallaine Reed rose.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: Dave Kovar
programme.desc: Dave Kovar is one of the most notable figures in martial arts history. Founder of the Kovar Business System, he is recognized as one of the pioneers of martial arts business. A tournament karate champion of the 1980s, he opened a successful string of schools across the nation. He is considered one of the first to introduce martial arts instructional videos in the 1980s. He is an author, a public speaker and an advocate for children's self-defense and anti-bullying.

programme.title: Shaolin Invincibles
programme.desc: Chia Ling is out to avenge the massacre of her family by the Emperor's assassins and is assisted by another young woman, played by Lung Chun Erh. The two girls infiltrate the Emperor's court by posing as handmaidens. Carter Wong & Flash Legs Tan play kung fu fighters sent to help Chia Ling at the monastery where she was raised.

programme.title: Mighty Four
programme.desc: During the Ming Dynasty, an honest, upright official is murdered by a greedy, jealous and powerful-hungry official, Ma. His son, Chi Liang, vows to someday get revenge and spends all his youth training in the martial arts. But in order to defeat Ma, Chi must master Magic Kicks technique with the help of the daughter of his father's best friend.

programme.title: Shanghai 13
programme.desc: A patriot finds evidence that the government is collaborating with a foreign power. He gets assistance from a local rebel leader who is in charge of a motley group of fighters called the Shanghai 13.

programme.title: Lady Vengeance and the 47 Ronin
programme.desc: Tsunataro Mumei (Atsuo Nakamura), a former official court janitor, is summoned by Senzaka Hyobu (Takeya Nakamura), a retainer of the Uesugi family. The Uesugi family is about to assassinate Oishi Kuranosuke (Tanba Tetsuro) and a group of ronin who are plotting to avenge the death of their father, Kira Uenosuke, by their lord Tsunanori. The assassination would prove to be the work of the Uesugi family, and the Uesugi family could not be saved from extinction.

programme.title: Duel of the Tough
programme.desc: A buddhist priest and a martial arts student take on the powerful Dai-Kang gang when valuable scriptures containing secret kung fu techniques are stolen. Huang must learn the deadly technique of Magic Kicks from the Shaolin master and retrieve the missing texts at any cost.

programme.title: Sung Dynasty Warriors
programme.desc: Fantastic action packed Mainland China production of the Water Margin, one of the most famous novels in the world. Legend has it that there were 108 knights who were reborn from fighters of thousands of years ago, who fought for justice, beat the wicked and powerful, but they also helped the poor and downtrodden.

programme.title: Buddhist Fist aka Yuen Woo Ping's Buddhist Fist
programme.desc: Two orphans raised by a Shaolin master reunite as adults to search for their godfather and his kidnappers. The fighting has been turned into a true performance art in this film as characters slip in and out and around each other in a way that's pretty outstanding.

programme.title: Ninja Operation 4 - Thunderbolt Angels aka Ninja Powerforce
programme.desc: Two childhood buddies, Albert and Frankie, find themselves on opposite sides of a deadly gang war and end up serving time in prison. Once released, Frankie joins with ninja master and cop extraordinaire Gordon, who is determined to track Lion down, but Lion has his own allies, in the form of the Red Ninja. Can Gordon defeat the Red Ninja and re-establish the supremacy of the Golden Ninja Empire?

programme.title: Raging Masters Tiger Crane
programme.desc: Hwang Jang Lee plays the Silver Fox in this brilliant production from Korea. Li-Siu, a young Shaolin Monk finds the opportunity to practice his kung fu teachings. During his practice he stumbles onto the murder of the Abbot at the Shaolin Temple and the kidnapping of the elder monk Do-Lim. A string of pearls found in the hands of the murdered Abbot is the only clue that leads Li-Siu to the Silver-Fox, the murderer and sinister mastermind of a deadly plot to invade China.

programme.title: Dreaming Fists with Slender Hands
programme.desc: The title characters are a group of abandoned orphans. The kids find a home of sorts when they join a group of street performers. In Dickensian fashion, they're entertainers by day, do-gooders the rest of the time. An interesting combination of styles lifts this one well above the ordinary.

programme.title: Boxers of Loyalty and Righteousness aka Shogun Saints
programme.desc: Warlord Yu Ming gain great power for himself. Anyone he suspects of disloyalty was jailed or murdered. He himself was a notorious killer having personally betrayed his friend General Yip and then slaughtered him and his family. But the General' son escaped and spent a lifetime to learn all the martial arts to take his revenge. He must lure Yu Ming away from his private army of thugs and gangster. Shogun warriors come to the ruler's defense, though a few of them have second thoughts.

programme.title: Soul Brothers of Kung Fu
programme.desc: Two illegal immigrants meet a young kid, and the three become best friends until one of them joins the Triads. Now the remaining two must fight the Triads in a battle to the death.

programme.title: Shaolin Heroes
programme.desc: During the declining years of Ming dynasty, Mongolians sent secret agents to intrude central China and tried to obtain "The Light Sword" a mighty sword, which can gather all brave wanderers. The son of Lung Chen Ying master of the Light Sword style learns of the plot and kills the leader of secret mission and temporarily stopped the Mongolian's ambition.

programme.title: Secret of Chinese Kung Fu
programme.desc: Chang Chi (Sze Ma Lung) is saved by two sisters at sea. One of the sisters, Mei Yee Yee (Hsia Ling Ling) takes to liking the young man and gets him a job at the local fish cannery. Chang Chi rises to the top at the cannery and becomes foreman. Chang Chi's promotion is short-lived as the thug, Kang Ho (Lo Lieh), strong arms the cannery ownership from old man Cheng and bounces Chang Chi back to a regular worker. So why does Kang Ho want this fish cannery?

programme.title: Black Invitation
programme.desc: Living large in the Fuhu Shan region, Qiu San (Ma Chi) and his ruthless gang extort money from the local people by sending out black invitations listing how much the gang would like to "borrow". Those who hand over the money even a little late experience the gang's violent wrath. Until one just knight makes a stand...

programme.title: Six Directions Boxing
programme.desc: David Chiang, star of many classic Shaw Brothers films, and the great Yuen Hsiao Tien (Jackie Chan's Drunken Master) star in this kung fu bonanza set in China's warlord period. When a secret team is sent by the police to break up the revolutionaries and their arms movements, it will take more than just guns to annihilate them! Six Directions of Boxing is wall-to-wall, hand-to-hand kung fu mayhem!

programme.title: The Iron Man
