programme.title: Mississippi River Styx
programme.desc: An enigmatic drifter with terminal cancer lives his dream of floating the Mississippi Rive on a ramshackle houseboat, until locals start to question his story.

programme.title: Come to Brasil
programme.desc: A look at the passionate, pop music superfans behind the most popular comment on the internet.

programme.title: Day by Day: The Rise
programme.desc: Head football coach Tom Osborne and the Nebraska Huskers chase a national championship for decades, becoming one of the most dominant, celebrated and controversial college teams ever.

programme.title: Day by Day: The Dynasty
programme.desc: The Nebraska Huskers chase a National Championship and become one of the most dominant, celebrated and controversial college football teams in history.

programme.title: Nothing But a Winner: The Alabama Football Story
Hung up on a Dream: The Zombies Documentary
programme.desc: British icons The Zombies reflect on 60 years of their musical path, from teenage friends to legends in the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame.

programme.title: The Arctic Oasis
programme.desc: A look at Canada's Arctic, now threatened as climate change alters the ice.

programme.title: Arctic Alchemy
programme.desc: Renowned adventurer and climate scientist, Roman Dial embarks on a research expedition in the Alaska Arctic.

programme.title: Finding Gulo
programme.desc: Finding Gulo follows a ski guide & field biologist who document an elusive population of wolverines.

programme.title: Understory
programme.desc: Follow three women who set sail on a 350-mile expedition through Alaska's massive Tongass National Forest. Their goal is to explore how clear-cut logging in this coastal rainforest could affect local communities and our planet's climate.

programme.title: Range Rider
programme.desc: In the Kettle River Range of Northeastern Wash., wolves are being killed to protect livestock that graze on public lands; a lone range rider, Daniel Curry, works year-round using non-lethal mitigation methods to help save wolves.

programme.title: School Of Fish
programme.desc: School of Fish offers an intimate portrait inside one family's seasonal salmon rituals and their connection to the Bristol Bay Fly-Fishing and Guide Academy, where local youth are empowered through fly-fishing to serve as guides and conservationists.

programme.title: The Last Blockbuster
programme.desc: The manager of the last Blockbuster video store struggles to keep the store open.

programme.title: Sacred Cod
programme.desc: The story of how the oldest fishery in the United States has been driven to the edge of commercial extinction; includes interviews with fishermen, scientists, advocates, and federal officials.

programme.title: Mahale Chimp Guardians
programme.desc: People and chimpanzees live side by side in one of the world's most important biodiversity hotspot.

programme.title: Jaguar Spirit
programme.desc: Jaguar Spirit uncovers how Bolivia became the global centre of the illegal jaguar trade.

programme.title: Dancing Warrior
programme.desc: On Pine Ridge Reservation, Lakota teens find hope racing horses in Indian Relay.

programme.title: Gilbert
programme.desc: Comedian Gilbert Gottfried recounts his career and talks about his new life as a family man.

programme.title: THC, Inc
programme.desc: With cannabis now mainstream, young people face rising potency, predatory marketing, and outdated policies.

programme.title: 40 Watts From Nowhere
programme.desc: Frustrated by what she was hearing on commercial radio, Sue Carpenter built a 40-watt FM station in 1995 and ran it out of her apartment in Los Angeles, exploiting a legal case that allowed hundreds of low-power illegal radio operators to proliferate throughout the country and gave birth to the legal LPFM movement.

programme.title: Charm Circle
programme.desc: The announcement of a polyamorous wedding threatens to sever what's left of a family bond.

programme.title: Now! More! Yes!
programme.desc: TW Hansen is a legally blind used car salesman, a landlord, and a film car coordinator living in Milwaukee. One of TW's tenants began following him with a camera after he drunkenly purchased an ambulance using his boss's money.

programme.title: The House From...
programme.desc: Filmmaker Tommy Avallone examines famous homes from movies and television series and interviews the people who live there in real life.

programme.title: Age of Audio
programme.desc: The resurgence of audio storytelling. From a vivid passion to an extraordinary billion-dollar industry.

programme.title: Seeding Change: The Power of Conscious Commerce
programme.desc: Consumers are empowered to purchase from "triple bottom line" businesses that consider the social, environmental and financial impacts of their companies and address some of today's most challenging issues.

programme.title: Dolphin Lover
programme.desc: Malcolm Brenner, human, and his romantic relationship with Dolly, bottlenose dolphin.

programme.title: Here's to Life: The Story of The Refreshments
programme.desc: The story of The Refreshments, from one-hit wonders to being a respected band in a new era.

programme.title: Pick It Up! Ska in the '90's
programme.desc: The rise and fall of Ska music.

programme.title: Getting LOST
programme.desc: Getting Lost is a retrospective documentary celebrating the 20th anniversary of the cultural phenomenon Lost.

programme.title: The Last Blockbuster
programme.desc: The manager of the last Blockbuster video store struggles to keep the store open.

programme.title: Built Different
programme.desc: Twelve-year-old Paige Calendine was born without legs and competes at state and national competitions against normal-bodied kids in archery and gymnastics; her inordinate determination and courage make her built different.

programme.title: State of Firsts
programme.desc: Sarah McBride's groundbreaking campaign becomes the first transgender Congressional victory amid anti-trans political tension.

programme.title: Dirty Coin: The Bitcoin Mining Documentary
programme.desc: Is Bitcoin mining an environmental threat or an energy solution? This documentary examines the debate surrounding crypto mining around the world.

programme.title: Talking Drum
programme.desc: Explore the healing power of drumming through community leaders using the universal language of rhythm.

programme.title: After Skid Row
programme.desc: For over a decade, Barbie Carter was among the thousands on individuals living on Skid Row, Los Angeles. After being approved for housing, she forges a bond with an aid worker, and together they work to keep her off the streets.

programme.title: Nostradamus: The Truth
programme.desc: An examination of the astrologer's predictions reveals myths and events that surrounded the life of the legendary figure who lived 500 years ago.

programme.title: Behind the Lines
programme.desc: Lt. Siegfried Sassoon (James Wilby), a poet and war veteran, is facing court-martial for publicly decrying British conduct in World War I. His poet friend Robert Graves (Dougray Scott) pulls strings to get Sassoon placed in a psychiatric war hospital in Scotland, where soldiers are to be swiftly rehabilitated and sent back into battle. There, Sassoon meets a sympathetic doctor (Jonathan Pryce) and also Wilfred Owen (Stuart Bunce), whom he encourages to pursue poetry as a form of wartime therapy.

programme.title: The International Space Orchestra
programme.desc: Nelly Ben Hayoun assembles the world's first orchestra made up of space scientists.

programme.title: Lunch Hour
programme.desc: Filmmaker James Costa investigates the National School Lunch Program and childhood obesity, and shows what schools, parents, authors, doctors, politicians, celebrities, and chefs are doing to combat the problem.

programme.title: Turning Point
programme.desc: A deep dive into the process of developing and testing one potential drug treatment for Alzheimer's disease.

programme.title: I Am (Not) A Monster
programme.desc: Ben Hayoun-Stépanian, founder of the University of the Underground, travels the world to meet a variety of people and organizations.

programme.title: Hung up on a Dream: The Zombies Documentary

programme.title: Pandora's Box
programme.desc: Jealousies and family tensions between the Ryan brothers suddenly come to light when an innocent question by Tess re-opens a very ugly wound.

programme.title: True Love and Consequences
programme.desc: When Bill Tilson decides to sell up and move to the city, Claire sees the precariousness of her own situation and it prompts her to work harder than ever to keep Drovers Run.

programme.title: Dirty Pool
programme.desc: Theft is on everyone's mind since there are cattle duffers working in the district and a flock of Claire's sheep has gone missing.

programme.title: If the Boot Fits...
programme.desc: When Claire attends a seminar on artificial insemination with Alex, she leaves Tess in charge of Drovers Run. In spite of a few doubts, Claire gives her a new pair of boots to honour the occasion, and it turns out that Tess will truly have to earn them.

programme.title: Playing to Win
programme.desc: The sudden death of local farmer Max Martin alarms Harry prompting fears of his own mortality, and a sudden drive to defy whatever fate may have in store by pursuing a rapid expansion of his property.

programme.title: Girls Night Out
programme.desc: After reaping good profits at the sheep sales, the girls are ready to celebrate with a night at the pub and a bit of Karaoke.

programme.title: More Than One Way...
programme.desc: Claire is finding it difficult to come to terms with Tess's new found relationship with Alex. Her dream of developing a quarter horse breeding program at Drovers Run looks as if it may be close to coming true and she's using it as an excuse to push Tess away.

programme.title: The Italian Stallion
programme.desc: When Alberto, a good-looking itinerant Italian, rescues Jodi from a rampant steer she falls hopelessly in love with him. At first, Meg isn't too worried as Alberto will be moving on.

programme.title: Lover Come Back
programme.desc: When Tess finds an old psychology textbook, she becomes obsessed with trying to figure out the real reasons for people's actions. Tess, however, is not prepared for the truths she uncovers about those around her, and also faces something she is reluctant to answer herself.

programme.title: Friends Like These
programme.desc: After a grubby day with the cattle, Tess is delighted when Simon and Briony, two old friends, show up for an unexpected visit. And they've got news, big news: they've got a lease on the café they all dreamed about and they want Tess to come back to the city with them ASAP.

programme.title: Deep Water
programme.desc: Jodi is in the final stages of arranging a charity polo match as part of her fund-raising efforts for the Miss Gungellan quest, and Brian decides it's high time to reacquaint himself with Becky.

programme.title: The Drovers Connection
programme.desc: Becky brother Sean visits and she is secretly thrilled, seeing it as her chance to stop Sean from going down the same path as their jailbird older brother. Peter arrives to check on Claire's progress training the quarter horses, and their flirtation takes a new turn.

programme.title: Through the Looking Glass
programme.desc: Peter and Claire struggle to deny their feelings for each other, but Claire worries that after the first romantic move, he's now got cold feet. Tess and Alex's relationship is put to the test when a baby is abandoned on his doorstep.

programme.title: Desperate Measures
programme.desc: Becky is thrown from her horse and injured when someone takes a shot at her. Claire and Peter's relationship is deepening and they are spending virtually twenty-four hours a day together as they seek out horses for training.

programme.title: The Bore War
programme.desc: It's a dry spell and the women are suffering shared baths, stained washing, and unflushed toilets. Claire cleans out an old bore to water her stock, but the newly-discovered water soon dries up when Nick irrigates his barley crop.

programme.title: Hello Stranger
programme.desc: When a good looking charmer arrives out of the blue at Drovers Run, no-one is more surprised than Jodi to find out he is her father, who has returned after an 18-year absence.

programme.title: A Dry Spell
programme.desc: Preparations for the Miss Gungellan ball continue, and Meg is faced with the difficult decision of whether to stay at the place she loves or to leave with the man she loves.

programme.title: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: Claire and Peter's growing relationship is leaving Tess feeling more and more isolated from her sister. Tess works hard to bring Nick and Alex back together, which causes trouble for the Ryans when she lets a divisive family secret out of the bag.

programme.title: The Bridle Waltz
programme.desc: Claire and Peter move closer to marriage when he presents her with a ruby pendant. Tess is feeling like a third wheel and makes plans for her own future, agreeing to join her friends in the city to help run their new business.

programme.title: To Have and to Hold
programme.desc: Claire's relationships are fragmented. She and Becky are barely speaking, and Tess is now living in Melbourne, unaware of recent events.

programme.title: Home is Where the Heart Is
programme.desc: Claire is taking the loss of Peter and Tess badly. She can't raise enthusiasm for anything, and things reach a crisis point when she decides to sell Drovers Run.

programme.title: Wildfire
programme.desc: Becky's troublesome older brother Mark returns, determined to drag Sean into his life of illegality. Mark assaults Nick in a remote paddock and while everyone is busy searching for him, Mark talks a reluctant Sean into helping him steal Alex's prize horse.

programme.title: Hounded
programme.desc: Frank Da Costa, the new cop in town, has it in for Terry. When Terry unwittingly sells Tess a pair of stolen alpacas, he sets up an explosive confrontation that will unearth the dark secret at the heart of Frank's animosity.

programme.title: Steer Trek
programme.desc: With the drought continuing and no money to truck in water, Claire, Tess, and Nick join forces. Meg is delighted when the Ryans send Terry along to help and she sees a chance to win him back. The attraction between Nick and Tess grows.

programme.title: Brave J
programme.desc: Tess motivates Claire into rekindling her dreams of becoming a stock horse trainer and breeder. Drovers Run needs the money, and with Peter safely out of the way, there is a slim chance of crossing paths with him again.

programme.title: You Can Leave Your Hat On
programme.desc: When Jodi's cooking gives five young men food poisoning, the women of Drovers must convince the Killarney men to put on a strip show.

programme.title: Stripped Bare
programme.desc: Drovers Run is cleared out by thieves while Jodi and Craig take advantage of everybody else's absence from the ranch to enjoy a secret rendezvous in the spa.

programme.title: Blame it on the Moonlight
programme.desc: Claire is irritated over Tess's three homestay guests: they're starting to shear today, and the last thing she needs is tourists getting in the way.

programme.title: Made to be Broken
programme.desc: Claire and Alex's potential clients are being put off by rumours circulated by Peter that, ten years ago, Alex was responsible for crippling a boy, Stefan Van Amstel when he deliberately ran his car off the road.

programme.title: Best of Enemies
programme.desc: Tess meets Sandra Kinsela at the cattle sale yards and likes her instantly, only to discover Claire dislikes her intensely. Their childhood dispute is renewed when a herd of calves is stolen from Drovers Run and Claire is convinced that Sandra is responsible.

programme.title: Wind Change
programme.desc: Tess is on the brink of committing to Nick but she is struggling with the intensity of her feelings for him. Meanwhile, Jodi and Alberto are forced to move back to Drovers Run when they are kicked out of their apartment in town after being unable to pay the rent.

programme.title: No More Mr Nice Guy
programme.desc: On the eve of the Gungellan Show, Claire is presented with repossession papers for Drovers Run. Nick and Tess become estranged after Tess walked out on him, but she tries to explain her actions of the previous night.

programme.title: Future Perfect
programme.desc: Peter offers to stop the repossession of Drovers Run if Claire marries him, but she rejects his proposal. She is injured in a fall during the Stockman's Challenge and the accident reveals her pregnancy. In order to help Claire, Alex steps forward to claim paternity.

programme.title: Fairy Tale, Ending
programme.desc: Claire returns to Drovers Run after her stay in the hospital, but she must deal with the lie she told that Alex is the father of her child when he isn't.

programme.title: Better The Devil You Know
programme.desc: Harry lends Claire his prize bull, which upsets Tess for not being consulted. Jodi returns from her holiday and Alberto proposes to her. With Becky's blessing, a date for the wedding is set, but three weeks is a bit sudden for Meg.

programme.title: The Road Home
programme.desc: Jodi is busy making plans for a huge wedding that is becoming too much for Alberto's liking and Meg's finances. When Alberto informs Jodi that her mother is intending to sell her jewels to pay for the event; Jodi decides a simple, traditional wedding may be better.

programme.title: An Affair to Forget
programme.desc: Tess believes Sally is cheating on Nick when she sees her in town with another man. Jodi's wedding plans go down the drain when Alberto learns about the affair she had while overseas, and Jake tries to help Becky cope with her feelings following Brett's death.

programme.title: Put to the Test
programme.desc: As a pre-Bucks Night prank, Craig and a couple of his mates kidnap Alberto and leave him in the middle of nowhere. When Jodi finds out, she goes ballistic and searches for Alberto with Craig.

programme.title: The Wedding
programme.desc: With last-minute wedding preparations underway, Jodi's father blows in unexpectedly, which creates tensions in the family.

programme.title: Gone to the Dogs
programme.desc: Becky senses the mystery surrounding Jake's past when he convinces her to help him save a prized racehorse from thieves. Sally accidentally leaves a gate open and a herd of sheep damages Tess and Nick's wheat crop.

programme.title: The Ghost of Things to Come
programme.desc: Claire uncovers a long-lost treasure which brings back memories of her mother and unleashes a fear that she will also die in childbirth. Tess organises a fake séance to try to ease Claire's fears and there are some surprising results.

programme.title: A House of Cards
programme.desc: The joy surrounding Harry and Liz's 30th wedding anniversary is shattered when Harry's nagging suspicions about Alex not being the father of Claire's baby explodes into a fit of rage after an innocent remark leads to Liz confessing a long-held secret.

programme.title: Three Little Words
programme.desc: Relations between Alex and his father take another turn for the worse when Alex discovers he has been cut off financially. Nick tries to play peacemaker but both sides are stubborn and his efforts go unappreciated.

programme.title: Repeat Offenders
programme.desc: Anticipation is high as Tess's journalist friend is due to arrive at Drovers Run to write a feature magazine article about life on the land. However, tensions between her and Tess begin to rise as old wounds are reopened and long-forgotten feelings are revisited.

programme.title: Sins of the Father
programme.desc: Becky feels betrayed when she learns Jake's true identity from his father at the auctions. Jodi discovers the real reason Kylie left home when she goes through Kylie's mail. A pending court date for a shoplifting charge is rapidly approaching but Kylie seems willing to ignore it.

programme.title: Jokers to the Right
programme.desc: The charade of being the father of Claire's baby is causing problems for Alex, especially when Sandra Kinsella appears on the scene.

programme.title: Chain Reaction
programme.desc: When Jodi receives a mysterious chain letter, she discards it immediately. The scattered pieces of the letter have barely hit the compost when Becky announces that the cattle are sick. Further misfortune soon strikes Drovers Run, with Terry falling ill and the discovery of a dead sheep.

programme.title: The Awful Truth
programme.desc: Nick and Alex must face the awful truth of their father's new girlfriend while they argue over Harry's proposal for a stock route through Drovers Run. Meanwhile, Tess stubbornly refuses to ask for outside help to shear her alpacas, insisting on doing the job herself.

programme.title: Seeing the Light
programme.desc: Mysterious lights are seen by Claire and Tess over Drovers Run. Tess is determined to believe they are a good omen, but Claire, restless and uneasy in the last stages of pregnancy, insists that trouble awaits.

programme.title: A Slight Interruption
programme.desc: A mob of Emus descends upon Drovers Run, wreaking havoc on everything they encounter. The chaotic situation is just one more stress for Claire who is struggling to balance the demands of motherhood with that of running the ranch.

programme.title: Old Beginnings
programme.desc: Claire is having a naming ceremony for Charlotte Prudence McLeod with her friends and family when Peter arrives. Claire has written to him after the birth, telling him he is a father. Peter is justifiably angry.

programme.title: Where There's Smoke
programme.desc: Determined to prove herself during a Fire Service training weekend, Jodi quickly realises it's going to be far more difficult than she had anticipated. Meanwhile, Meg is dedicating herself to her studies and is thoroughly immersed in 'Pride and Prejudice'.

programme.title: Perfect Match
programme.desc: Becky and Jake join in a business partnership with Claire and Tess; Claire has issues with some of Jake's clients.

programme.title: Let the Best Man Win
programme.desc: Alex and Nick come to the rescue of an attractive woman named Ellie when her car breaks down on a country road. Almost instantly they're pitched into a competition to woo her.

programme.title: Majority Rules
programme.desc: When Drovers Run is quarantined and the future of the stock placed under a cloud, true friends seem few and far between as Claire finally goes head-to-head with her old enemy Sandra Kinsella. Meg and Terry have their eye on a piece of land but are unable to come up with the deposit, until an offer of help comes from an unlikely person.

programme.title: The Ties That Bind
programme.desc: Claire's role as spokesperson for the local farmers' association requires her to visit Melbourne. Alex is insistent that he come along to look after them while also pursuing some Wilgul matters, but the real reason is that he wants to meet his biological father.

programme.title: One Step at a Time
programme.desc: Claire and Alex are still in Melbourne, blissfully in love. At Drovers, Tess and Dave are making plans for their wedding day. When Tess, in the shower, discovers a lump in her breast, she fears she will share her mother's fate and quickly goes into denial, telling no-one.

programme.title: Time Frames
programme.desc: Tess and Dave split up when they realise that he has not yet come to terms with the death of his wife. Meanwhile, prompted by Becky, Claire asks Harry if she can use King Harold in a new breeding program on Drovers.

programme.title: Body Language (aka The Bottom Line)
programme.desc: Drovers Run hosts the Regional Young Farmer of the Year Contest, and Becky is surprised to learn that Jake has entered. He tells her he's going to win her back. They compete neck and neck and slowly Becky is won over by his persistence and charm, and the old spark between them returns.

programme.title: To Catch a Thief
programme.desc: Tess's upcoming operation has thoughts of mortality creeping in, so she begins to write a letter to Charlotte so that her niece can know her, should Tess no longer be around. Meanwhile, Claire reminisces when an old friend turns up unexpectedly.

programme.title: My Noon, My Midnight
programme.desc: Heartbreak hits Drovers Run. Tess anxiously awaits the results of her breast cancer tests, convinced that her time is up, while Alex and Claire decide to move in together.

programme.title: The Long Goodbye
programme.desc: Claire's death has everyone dealing with it in their own way. Tess tries to keep her emotions in check, unable to deal with her grief and burdened by survivor's guilt. Terry, Jodi, and Meg are left with the task of running Drovers Run and dealing with funeral arrangements.

programme.title: Turbulence
programme.desc: Tess and Stevie continue to clash and all the ill-feelings come to the surface when a private investigator turns up. Tess accepts Stevie's explanations at first but gets suspicious when Stevie is caught packing her bags.

programme.title: Out of the Ashes
programme.desc: Six months after Claire's death, Tess has thrown herself into her work. She wants to assure Charlotte's future, as well as remain faithful to Claire's dream for Drovers. Bushfires sweep through the area and Tess has to face it alone until Stevie turns up to fight by her side.

programme.title: Double Dealing
programme.desc: Stevie agrees to do a seemingly simple favour for Sandra to repay her for not pressing charges for stealing her plane. To get out of Sandra's scheme, Tess takes a big gamble, confident she can defeat Sandra in a winner takes all poker game.

programme.title: Scotland Dessert
programme.desc: One chef will go home, and today the veteran judge finds himself with a difficult decision to make. Inventive chef Michael Bremner is recreating the Scottish desserts of his childhood, Adam Handling is sticking with his trademark Asian flavours and Ally McGrath is tempering chocolate for the very first time.

programme.title: Scotland Judging
programme.desc: Scotland's two highest scoring chefs are cooking for the judges for the very first time. Both chefs have decided to make changes to some of their dishes, taking on board criticisms made during the week by the veteran judge.

programme.title: South West Starter
programme.desc: Chef Josh Eggleton is back for a third time. Last year he made the national finals when his starter was shortlisted for the banquet, this year he intends to go one step further and cook at the banquet. One of his rivals last time, Jude Kereama is also back and out to do better than he did previously. The third competitor is newcomer Chris Wheeler who is originally from Swanage in Dorset.

programme.title: South West Fish
programme.desc: There are some exciting dishes on the menu as the three chefs from the South West tackle the fish course. Chef Josh Eggleton is hoping to impress with an original take on Bolognese, just one of six elements on his complex fish dish.

programme.title: South West Main
programme.desc: It is the main course and chef Chris Wheeler is out to show just how theatrical he can be, and his ideas are surprising everyone in the kitchen. No one knows quite what to expect, and the veteran chef is hoping it tastes as good as it looks.

programme.title: South West Dessert
programme.desc: It is the dessert course, and it is Josh Eggleton who has come up with the most ambitious dessert. He is creating his own self-serve ice cream made from vegetables, and making everything from scratch including toppings and syrups.

programme.title: South West Judging
programme.desc: It is the head to head and the South West region's two highest scoring chefs are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort. They are joined by guest judge, journalist and restaurant critic, Grace Dent.

programme.title: North West Starter
programme.desc: Two newcomers to the competition are challenging reigning North West champion Matt Worswick. Adam Reid is head chef at Manchester's Midland hotel and Kim Woodward, who made history when she was appointed Head Chef at the Savoy Grill.

programme.title: North West Fish
programme.desc: It is the fish course and reigning North West champion Matt Worswick has reason to be confident. However, Kim's confident she has got one up on Matt by baking her own black bread unlike Matt who's taking a shortcut.

programme.title: North West Main
programme.desc: It is the main course of the North West regional heat and the scores mean this is a crucial round. Matt Worswick may be the reigning champion, but he is not yet assured of a place cooking for the judges, and he is feeling the strain.

programme.title: North West Dessert
programme.desc: It's the dessert course and the three North West competitors are getting creative, producing some of the most original and stunning desserts. All three chefs are working in a hot kitchen, the tension is palpable, and this time one chef will go home.

programme.title: North West Judging
programme.desc: The two chefs are cooking for judges Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton, and guest judge Lady Claire MacDonald OBE. There are standout dishes from both chefs making it a difficult contest to judge.

programme.title: Wales Starter
programme.desc: Three of the finest chefs from Wales are competing to be crowned champion. Two chefs are back for a second time: Phil Carmichael, from Cowbridge, South Wales, is executive chef at Berners Tavern in London, and Adam Bannister is chef and co-owner of Slice in his home city of Swansea. Adam was crowned Welsh champion last year so this year Phil is back with something to prove. He plans to go home raising the flag for Wales. The third chef is newcomer Andrew Birch, also from Swansea.

programme.title: Wales Fish
programme.desc: It is the fish course and newcomer Andrew Birch is confident - he is passionate about seafood. He is celebrating the cockle, which is harvested near his home city of Swansea. Adam Bannister has created an alter ego, Captain Bannister, for his modern take on the old boil-in-the-bag fish dinner, and Phil has chosen to revamp the classic prawn cocktail.

programme.title: Wales Main
programme.desc: Phil Carmichael is serving up his version of an OBE, a refined take on onions, bacon and egg. Adam is planning to serve up wild boar on a spit, while Andrew turns up the heat when he combines strong Japanese flavours with a traditional roast.

programme.title: Wales Dessert
programme.desc: It is the dessert course and one chef will go home. Phil Carmichael is determined it won't be him but not everything is going to plan when he tackles his "Cup of Tea for Ma'am". One of the accompaniments to his Earl Grey panna cotta just won't work. He has to make a difficult decision.

programme.title: Wales Judging
programme.desc: It is the head to head. The two highest scoring chefs from Wales are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort who are joined by guest judge, blogger and food writer Rosie Birkett.

programme.title: Central Starter
programme.desc: Three newcomers are competing to become regional champion. Daniel Smith, a former head chef for the Roux brothers, now runs his own restaurant in his beloved home county of Norfolk. Andrew Scott's worked with the best in the business, and he's concentrating on telling powerful stories as well as delivering perfect flavours. Danny Gill is a former head chef at Daniel Clifford's two-star restaurant Midsummer House.

programme.title: Central Fish
programme.desc: It is the fish course and the chefs are using some of the UK's best seafood: lobster, salmon and Cornish crab. Danny Gill is a chef who likes to use the very latest equipment to create the most intense flavours. He's going to great lengths to maximise the taste of his cucumber consommé, and it is causing a lot of interest in the kitchen.

programme.title: Central Main
programme.desc: Two chefs are cooking venison. Danny Gill is making a venison wellington, inspired by his Dad, a former RAF chef who has served up wellington for royalty at many air force banquets, while Andrew Scott has sourced his venison from the Queen's Scottish estate, Balmoral.

programme.title: Central Dessert
programme.desc: This week three chefs from the central region are fighting to be crowned champion. One competitor will go home, only the two highest scoring chefs will make it through to the judging chamber. Danny Gill is facing his toughest day yet, choosing to make a staggering eight elements for his imaginative dessert.

programme.title: Central Judging
programme.desc: The Central region's two highest scoring chefs are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort, for the very first time. Joining them in the chamber is guest judge Enam Ali MBE, a food entrepreneur who set up The British Curry Awards.

programme.title: London & South East Starter
programme.desc: Three of the most exciting talents from London and the South East region are competing for a place in the national finals. Head chef Mark Froydenlund runs Marcus Wareing's two-star restaurant. Russell Bateman is head chef at The Grove in Hertfordshire and Ronnie Murray who heads up the Hix Restaurant group.

programme.title: London & South East Fish
programme.desc: It is the fish course and chef Russell Bateman is celebrating the diversity of his beloved home town of London - by combining lobster with jerk spices for an ambitious fish course with seven key elements. Ronnie Murray's taking a risk with an ingredient which is close to the veteran judge's heart and is planning to serve it at three different temperatures, warm, deep-fried and frozen. And two Michelin-starred Mark Froydenlund is planning a novel way to present his dish.

programme.title: London & South East Main
programme.desc: It's the all-important main course and returning contender Mark Froydenlund is banking on it being his strongest dish. Russell Bateman is creating a beef dish, and Ronnie Murray's mixing a crown of lamb with a curried filling.

programme.title: London & South East Dessert
programme.desc: It's the dessert course and the final chance for three of London and South East's most competitive and talented chefs to get through to the judging chamber, today the veteran judge will send one chef home.

programme.title: London & South East Judging
programme.desc: It is the head to head and the two highest scoring chefs from the London and South East region are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort. Joining this week as guest judge is Kevin Gould, an award-winning food writer.

programme.title: North East Starter
programme.desc: Mini Patel is back for a second attempt at the north-east regional title, but he is competing against two young newcomers, Tommy Banks and Chris Archer. In 2015 Mini went home after the dessert course, so he is hoping to keep better control of his nerves this year.

programme.title: North East Fish
programme.desc: It is the fish course and two chefs, Tommy and Mini, have very similar ingredients - both are cooking mackerel. However, Mini is trying an original beetroot sorbet while Tommy is using wild woodruff and oyster leaf from his own garden. Chris Archer has chosen the king of the sea, turbot, but there is controversy in the kitchen.

programme.title: North East Main
programme.desc: It is the main course of the north-east region and overnight there has been a dramatic development. It is a tough and emotional day for the chefs as they react to the news, but they battle on in a bid to present a perfect dish with venison and Wagyu-Angus beef - the meat of the day.

programme.title: North East Dessert
programme.desc: It is a highly emotional day for one of the chefs as he prepares a dish which is inspired by and a tribute to his own great Briton, his late grandfather. However, all does not go to plan, and the chef ends up making one key element three times in a bid to achieve perfection.

programme.title: North East Judging
programme.desc: The two chefs are cooking for judges Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton for the very first time. Joining them as guest judge is John Williams MBE, the executive head chef at The Ritz, the only hotel to hold a royal warrant for banqueting.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Starter
programme.desc: It is Chris McGowan's third time; however, he is facing tough competition from Mark Abbott, head chef at Daniel Clifford's two Michelin-star restaurant, Midsummer House, and also from Eddie Attwell who has just completed a year as head chef at Ardtara Country House in Upperlands.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Fish
programme.desc: Mark Abbott is pushing himself again plating up a complex fish course of the very finest produce. He is calling it Shellsational but at the last minute he forgets a key element. Returning chef Chris McGowan is refining cod and chips and Eddie Attwell is getting classical with the king of the sea, turbot. The repartee is relentless as the chefs jostle for top place on the leader board. Once again there is plenty of emotion as the veteran chef delivers the scores.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Main
programme.desc: It is the main course and returning Chef Chris McGowan is feeling confident, but part of his dish involves making his own venison sausages to serve with a venison rack, and getting it all done in time is straining his emotions. Eddie Attwell is also serving the meat but with a traditional Northern Irish dish called Dock pudding. Mark Abbott is pushing himself again; he is using wagyu beef and serving it with tongue and corn cooked in a variety of ways.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Dessert
programme.desc: The three chefs from Northern Ireland are cooking their desserts and one chef is on course for a historic score, he could beat his boss - a veteran of GBM - and achieve more marks than anyone has done throughout the history of the competition.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Judging
programme.desc: It is the head-to-head. The two highest scoring chefs from Northern Ireland are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort who are joined by guest judge, restaurant critic and Editor-at-Large of the Independent, Amol Rajan.

programme.title: Finals Starter
programme.desc: It is the national finals of 'Great British Menu'. Before cooking starts the eight champions are called to London's Southbank to get a sight of the prize, the chance to cook at a banquet held at the Palace of Westminster, in celebration of everyday Great Britons honoured by the Queen. It has a huge impact on every one of the chefs, each is determined to do all he can to get a dish to the banquet.

programme.title: Finals Fish
programme.desc: It's day two of the national finals, and the eight champions cook their fish courses. This year's challenge has been to produce dishes that are a lasting legacy to the New Elizabethan Age. They must showcase the transformation in British cuisine during the Queen's historic 64-year reign.

programme.title: Finals Main
programme.desc: It's main course day, the one course every chef wants to cook at the banquet. The chefs' dishes will be judged by Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton along with guest judge John Williams MBE, executive chef of The Ritz.

programme.title: Finals Dessert
programme.desc: It's the final day of the competition, and the last chance for the eight champions to get one of their dishes to the banquet for Queen Elizabeth II's Great Britons. Judges Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton will judge the dessert course and then decide on the banquet menu to be served at the Houses of Parliament. Joining them in the judging chamber is Grace Dent, restaurant critic, journalist and author.

programme.title: Banquet
programme.desc: The winning chefs arrive at the Palace of Westminster to cook for the Banquet of Great Britons. The chefs have been selected because their dishes showcase contemporary British cuisine and demonstrate the transformation in British food during the Queen's historic reign.

programme.title: London and South East Starter
programme.desc: The three chefs meet their surprise veteran judge and cook their starters. A dish celebrating childhood summer memories takes on a complicated courgette dish and a technically tricky take on the cucumber sandwich.

programme.title: London and South East Fish
programme.desc: The atmosphere in the kitchen gets even more intense as all the chefs take risks with their dishes. Mike Reid, executive chef at M Restaurants in London, shocks when he pairs his fish with some highly unusual flavours.

programme.title: London and South East Main
programme.desc: The kitchen is filled with smoke as the three chefs prepare their summer-themed mains. Selin Kiazim is in her element, preparing a feast inspired by the summer barbecues. Mike Reid uses wagyu beef. Tom Kemble uses juniper branches to smoke his meat.

programme.title: London and South East Dessert
programme.desc: All three chefs are feeling the pressure as they attempt their technical summer desserts. With only the two highest scorers going through to the regional final, who will be sent home?

programme.title: London and South East Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining London and the South East chefs must cook their entire taste of summer menus again. They're hoping to impress the formidable panel of Oliver Peyton, Matthew Fort and restaurateur Andi Oliver.

programme.title: South West Starter
programme.desc: The chefs have been challenged to create outstanding dishes that capture a 'taste of summer'. Their menus must reflect the tastes, smells and colours of everybody's favourite time of year.

programme.title: South West Fish
programme.desc: It's the fish course and, with a seafood specialist in the kitchen, the competition is stepping up a gear. Tom is hoping he'll be able to elevate the humble mackerel to the standards required for the Wimbledon banquet.

programme.title: South West Main
programme.desc: With a refined summer barbecue going up against a traditional Cornish speciality and a historic Wimbledon related recipe, who will come out on top? Andy Clatworthy is using his passion for historical cooking to reinvent a dish.

programme.title: South West Dessert
programme.desc: All three chefs are honouring Wimbledon and the British summer with their technically challenging strawberry desserts. Only the two highest scorers will go through to cook for the judges.

programme.title: South West Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining chefs compete for a place in the national finals. To get there they'll have to impress the formidable panel of judges: Oliver Peyton, Matthew Fort and restaurateur Andi Oliver.

programme.title: North West Starter
programme.desc: Tom Parker is eager to impress with a salad that includes 10 elements. Meanwhile, Paul Askew, hopes his traditional techniques will triumph over his younger competitors, and Ellis Barrie is taking a risk with a creative cucumber and oyster starter.

programme.title: North West Fish
programme.desc: It is the fish course and the atmosphere in the kitchen gets even tenser as the three newcomers begin to understand the perfection and skill the veteran chef demands. Ellis Barrie attempts to create the flavour of a summer barbecue.

programme.title: North West Main
programme.desc: It is the main course and the pressure is intense in the kitchen. In the hope of impressing the veteran judge, Paul Askew is serving an extremely personal main course based on his mother's favourite food.

programme.title: North West Dessert
programme.desc: Dessert is the last chance for the chefs to secure a place cooking for the judges and the pressure in the kitchen is intense. Paul can't afford to make any mistakes and is pushing himself with a technically challenging baked Alaska.

programme.title: North West Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining north-west chefs must cook their entire taste of summer menus again. The guest judge is Greg Rusedski, former British number one, who understands the high standards expected at Wimbledon.

programme.title: North East Starter
programme.desc: Returning banquet champion Tommy Banks takes on two ambitious newcomers, Danny Parker and Josh Overington. They start by finding out who is the surprise veteran judge and who will be marking their dishes.

programme.title: North East Fish
programme.desc: The atmosphere in the kitchen gets even more heated, the three chefs are cooking their fish courses. Josh Overington creates a decadent dish inspired by the prestige of the Wimbledon Championships.

programme.title: North East Main
programme.desc: The chefs are cooking their main courses and are all taking risks to try and win a place at the banquet. Danny Parker is trying to recreate the flavours of an American barbecue, but the veteran chef is dubious about one of his ingredients.

programme.title: North East Dessert
programme.desc: Dessert is the last chance for the chefs to secure a place cooking for the judges and the pressure in the kitchen is intense. All the chefs are using unusual ingredients in their desserts.

programme.title: North East Judging
programme.desc: The two remaining chefs from the north-east must cook their entire taste of summer menus again. They're hoping to impress the formidable panel of judges Oliver Peyton, Matthew Fort, Andi Oliver, and guest Judy Murray.

programme.title: Scotland Starter
programme.desc: It is the Scottish regional heats and returning chefs to the competition Michael Bremner and Ally McGrath battle ambitious newcomer Angela Malik for a place in the national finals. This time they are cooking their starters.

programme.title: Scotland Fish
programme.desc: The atmosphere in the kitchen gets even more heated and the veteran chef is expecting perfection from the fish course. Ally McGrath creates an inventive dish based on his summer memories of rock pooling in the River Tweed.

programme.title: Scotland Main
programme.desc: Angela Malik is in her element cooking a tiffin box based on memories of summer picnics. Michael Bremner is taking a huge risk, and Ally is creating an inventive dish based on a summer barbecue.

programme.title: Scotland Dessert
programme.desc: Dessert is the last chance for the chefs to secure a place cooking for the judges and the pressure in the kitchen is intense. Angela Malik is cooking a technically challenging dessert.

programme.title: Scotland Judging
programme.desc: The two Scottish chefs must cook their entire taste of summer menus again. They're hoping to impress the formidable panel of judges Oliver Peyton, Matthew Fort and Andi Oliver. They are joined by guest judge Gary Parsons.

programme.title: Wales Starter
programme.desc: Determined newcomers Paul Croasdale and Nick Brodie take on returning chef Phil Carmichael for a place in the national finals. It's Phil's third time in the competition and this year he's determined to make it to the banquet.

programme.title: Wales Fish
programme.desc: The pressure in the kitchen is high as the chefs prepare their fish courses. Paul Croasdale is trying to recreate the elegance of Wimbledon with luxury ingredients such as king crab and scallops.

programme.title: Wales Main
programme.desc: For the main course, all three chefs are cooking Welsh lamb in the hope of impressing the judge. Phil is taking a risk with barbecued lamb and in an attempt to elevate a humble barbecue to banquet level, he's serving it with many accompaniments.

programme.title: Wales Dessert
programme.desc: It's the dessert course and the last chance for the chefs to secure a place cooking for the judges, so all three chefs are feeling the pressure. Phil Carmichael creates a tennis ball dessert that combines two British classics, Eton mess and trifle.

programme.title: Wales Judging
programme.desc: The two winning chefs from the Wales region must cook their entire taste of summer menus again. They're hoping to impress the formidable panel of judges and guest judge Dan Bloxham, Wimbledon's Master of Ceremonies.

programme.title: Central Starter
programme.desc: Pip Lacey's starter is a humorous take on the unpredictable British weather and features an unusual presentation. Ryan Simpson's dish represents an allotment complete with soil, while Nick Deverell-Smith's creation is a tribute to the precision cutting of Wimbledon's grass.

programme.title: Central Fish
programme.desc: With the chefs hoping to impress, they each take risks. Pip Lacey combines lobster with strawberry in a tribute to strawberries and cream. Ryan Simpson's also using lobster in his recreation of a BBQ and has invented a technique to create his chips.

programme.title: Central Main
programme.desc: Ryan Simpson hopes to elevate a ploughman's lunch into a gourmet affair, Pip Lacey pays tribute to an unusual Wimbledon icon, while Nick Deverell-Smith looks to celebrate a meat which he thinks is underused, venison.

programme.title: Central Dessert
programme.desc: Dessert is the last chance for the chefs to secure a place cooking for the judges. Pip Lacey's pineapple dessert uses coriander. Nick Deverell-Smith also pays tribute to the pineapple, creating a dessert featuring a rice pudding made with couscous.

programme.title: Central Judging
programme.desc: The two chefs who've made it through cook their four courses again. They must impress the formidable panel of judges Oliver Peyton, Matthew Fort, Andi Oliver and guest judge Jordanne Whiley, one of Britain's most successful wheelchair tennis players.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Starter
programme.desc: The chefs meet their surprise veteran judge and cook their starters. Eddie is hoping to do better than last year, Joery is hoping to impress with a tribute to Richard Krajicek, and Tommy is creating a warm salad.

programme.title: Northern Ireland Fish
programme.desc: Joery Castel is combining mackerel and cucumber, and Tommy Heaney hopes his Murray Mound is a fitting tribute to Andy Murray's love of sushi. Eddie Attwell is creating five different strawberry elements to accompany the scallops in his dish.

programme.title: Shep-Istotle

programme.title: In the Cups
programme.desc: As Shep plans his birthday party, Cameran decides it may be time to get a dog so she can put off having a baby; Thomas and Kathryn move downtown as the campaign heats up; the gang gets together to celebrate at Shep's birthday party.

programme.title: Better Late Than Never
programme.desc: Patricia hosts an all-male dinner party to avoid drama, but Whitney and Thomas wind up fighting; Craig invites Shep and Whitney to his parents' house; the gang gets dressed in formal attire to attend a ball; Kathryn ends up home alone.

programme.title: Unaware in Delaware
programme.desc: After the Founders Ball, Craig encounters his boss and learns the consequences of his partying ways; Kathryn resolves to become a different person; when Shep and Whitney head to Delaware, secrets are revealed and friendships tested.

programme.title: Jekyll and Snide
programme.desc: Landon invites the gang to her hometown for a weekend getaway; Kathryn upbraids Whitney; after Craig and Kathryn spend a night on the beach alone, an explosive accusation threatens to upend Thomas' political aspirations.

programme.title: Election Day
programme.desc: Thomas deals with the aftermath of the accusations as election day approaches; Kathryn makes a far-reaching decision; Whitney suspects Kathryn is behind the allegations; the gang gathers at a restaurant to hear the election results.

programme.title: Dysfunction Junction
programme.desc: As Thomas adjusts to his new post-election life, Kathryn cannot seem to let go of the past; Patricia organizes a charity event to benefit Wounded Warriors; Shep and Craig agree to participate in a date auction; relationships are pushed to the brink.

programme.title: Hashtagnewcraig
programme.desc: Craig throws himself a welcome back party and invites the gang to get back together again; Thomas and Kathryn have officially called it quits, and their tumultuous relationship continues to create a wedge between them and their friends.

programme.title: Miss Domesticated
programme.desc: Thomas realizes he must co-parent with Kathryn in a harmonious way; Cameran decides to show off her domestic skills by throwing a dinner party; Craig comes to Kathryn's defense; Shep plays the field; Landon feels pinched economically.

programme.title: Hold Your Horses
programme.desc: As Craig settles into his new job, Cameran recruits Shep to be her real estate partner; Landon hits her father up for money; Kathryn begs Thomas to cosign the lease on her new house; a family day spent watching Thomas play polo turns into a showdown.

programme.title: Birds of a Feather...
programme.desc: Kathryn experiences complications related to her pregnancy, motivating Thomas to cosign her lease; Cameran considers seeing a therapist about her reluctance regarding motherhood; Craig challenges Thomas' commitment to Kathryn.

programme.title: Invite-gate
programme.desc: Craig continues to question why Kathryn is on the outs and Shep considers settling down; Kathryn comes to terms with her volatile past and tries to make her way back into the group; Landon prepares for a Shep's birthday party.

programme.title: Beast of Bourbon
programme.desc: Kathryn reaches out to an old friend to make amends; Landon heads to New York for an opportunity; Thomas grows fearful about the health of his unborn child; Craig receives a crushing blow at work, while taking a big step forward with Naomie.

programme.title: Blue Ridge Mountain Blues
programme.desc: Craig digs into the past to find the source of the animosity aimed at Kathryn; Cameran reveals more than expected at her therapy session; the gang enjoys the serenity of the Blue Ridge Mountains until secrets are revealed and friendships tested.

programme.title: Whit's End
programme.desc: The trip puts a strain on group dynamics; Craig attempts to salvage his friendships with Cameran and Whitney; Kathryn breaks the news that the baby is coming ahead of schedule, thwarting Thomas' plans to go away to Los Angeles with the guys.

programme.title: Saint and Sinners
programme.desc: As Thomas and Kathryn prepare to welcome their son into the world, JD questions whether Thomas is actually the father; Craig heads to Los Angeles for a guys' weekend; Landon reveals to Cameran the feelings she harbors for her best friend.

programme.title: From Here to Paternity
programme.desc: After the birth of their son, Thomas and Kathryn take baby steps towards a reconciliation; Landon makes a surprising declaration; Thomas has few reasons to rejoice after shocking revelations and fiery accusations are made during a celebratory dinner.

programme.title: Words of Wisdom
programme.desc: Thomas wants to prove that Kathryn and the children should not be overlooked; Patricia takes Landon under her wing and shows her how to make Shep swoon; Thomas hosts a dinner party during which a toast drives the gang apart.

programme.title: Founder's Brawl
programme.desc: Kathryn appreciates that Thomas finally had her back; JD and Whitney stage an intervention to air their concerns over Thomas' erratic behavior; the gang gets together at the second annual Founder's Ball, where simmering tensions come to a boil.

programme.title: While the Kat's Away...
programme.desc: Thomas rises to the challenge of being a single father; Shep continues to be Charleston's perennial bachelor and has a new wingman, Austen; Cameran is convinced she knows the woman who can reel Shep in; Landon is back with a new boyfriend.

programme.title: Roamin' Holiday
programme.desc: Cameran gets a sneak peek at motherhood; Kathryn's trip to Malibu, Calif., proves to be more than just sunbathing and surfing; Shep confronts Craig about the nature of his legal career; Thomas realizes he needs a stepmother for his children.

programme.title: Step and Release
programme.desc: Craig helps Naomie throw a fundraiser, but the differences in their planning styles threaten to expose the cracks in their relationship; Thomas decides to rekindle his friendship with Landon; Shep and Chelsea share a romantic evening.

programme.title: Shepwrecked
programme.desc: Kathryn struggles to cope with supervised visitation; Craig's life with Naomie starts to fall apart; Whitney confronts Landon about her true feelings for Thomas; Cameran tries to convince Shep it's not too late to win Chelsea back.

programme.title: Craig of All Trades, Master of None
programme.desc: Cameran turns to the supernatural in hopes of finding her life's purpose; Thomas asks Landon out on a date; Shep confronts Austen about his "bro-code" violation; Naomie reaches her boiling point when she learns of Craig's latest endeavor.

programme.title: To Liver and Die in Charleston
programme.desc: Shep receives shocking news about his health; Austen and Chelsea deepen their romantic bond; Thomas and Landon's connection is tested; Jennifer hosts a Sip and See to celebrate her new baby; Craig finally seals the deal on an investment property.

programme.title: Fowl Play
programme.desc: As Kathryn contemplates a reunion with the father of her children, Patricia pushes Landon and Thomas closer together; Craig and Naomie attempt to reconcile; Shep plans a hunting getaway for the group; Chelsea falls for Austen's hunting prowess.

programme.title: Sari, Not Sari...
programme.desc: Craig and Naomie visit a therapist; Austen and Chelsea continue to grow closer; Shep runs into Austen and Landon at a bar; Kathryn writes Thomas a letter; Patricia hosts an Indian-themed dinner and invites an Indian healer who reveals the future.

programme.title: Guess Who's Coming to Lunch
programme.desc: After the chaos of Patricia's dinner, some fortunes begin to come true; Cameran agrees to see if Kathryn has really changed; Austen and Craig discuss whether Shep still has his heart set on Chelsea; Landon prepares to quash a potential relationship.

programme.title: The Hangover
programme.desc: Thomas and Kathryn end their standoff to celebrate their son's birthday; Cameran begins to rethink motherhood; Craig proves he's finally all grown up when he gets the keys to his new house; Shep decides he needs to move out of downtown.

programme.title: Boys Gone Wild
programme.desc: Thomas agrees to let Kathryn do a photo shoot with Kensie; Craig and Naomie question whether they should continue to be a couple; when Chelsea tells Austen about a late-night encounter with Shep, friendships are pushed to the brink.

programme.title: A Tribe Called Key West
programme.desc: The gang heads to Key West for Cam's birthday trip; Austen questions Chelsea's commitment to their relationship; Craig finds himself on thin ice with Naomie; Kathryn reveals shocking new information about Thomas and Landon's relationship.

programme.title: Ain't No Thang Like a Chicken Wing
programme.desc: Landon and Kathryn's Key West apology sends shock waves through the South; Chelsea and Austen strive to define their relationship; Craig and Naomie decide the fate of their relationship; old tensions reemerge at JD's party.

programme.title: The Break-Up Bunch Part 1
programme.desc: Cameran prepares for the birth of her baby; Shep confesses to the downfall of his relationship following his quest to find love; Kathryn celebrates her second year of sobriety; Thomas has a new love interest.

programme.title: The Break-Up Bunch Part 2
programme.desc: Shep hosts his first adult dinner party, where Craig's anxieties over seeing Naomie mount and Austen remains hopeful that he can win Chelsea back; Kathryn finally meets Ashley, the woman determined to be the next Mrs. Ravenel.

programme.title: Groovy Baby
programme.desc: Patricia surprises Cameran by planning a glamorous retro baby shower, where Craig and Naomie fall back into old habits and an unexpected guest turns the event on its head; Thomas considers his future with Ashley.

programme.title: All Talk No Action
programme.desc: Kathryn takes the high road by inviting Thomas' new girlfriend, Ashley, to lunch; as Cameran's due date approaches, her anxieties over becoming a mom subside; Chelsea begins to fear motherhood may never be in her future.

programme.title: Pulp Friction
programme.desc: Patricia encourages Thomas to propose; Austen's parents push him to make some strides professionally; Craig hires a coach to help him get his life on track; Naomie comes face to face with Craig's new crush.

programme.title: Exes on the Half Shell
programme.desc: Naomie prepares to open her family's new restaurant, and finally comes to terms with the fact that she isn't over Craig; Patricia and Craig have a heart-to-heart; Cameran tries an old-fashioned trick to get baby Palmer to make an appearance.

programme.title: Kat's Got Your Tongue
programme.desc: Cameran suspects that she may be experiencing labor pains; Kathryn prepares for her first day of work; Craig helps Austen realize things are over with Chelsea; Patricia tries to make Ashley into the perfect Southern Belle and hosts a dinner party.

programme.title: What da Fuskie
programme.desc: Cameran plays the pregnancy waiting game; the gang prepares for a trip to Shep and Chelsea's hometown; feuding exes, Craig and Naomie, attempt to act civil; Austen decides to rekindle his romance with Victoria, but fears Chelsea's reaction.

programme.title: Hilton Head-ache
programme.desc: Emotions run high during the gang's first night in Hilton Head, S.C., when Ashley confronts Kathryn; after the group is forced to pick sides, everyone walks on eggshells for the rest of the weekend.

programme.title: Family Ties
programme.desc: As the Hilton Head trip comes to an end, Shep visits his mom and finally admits some truths about himself; Chelsea takes a trip down memory lane and opens up about her past.

programme.title: Beer and Trembling
programme.desc: Austen prepares to debut his beer to his family and friends; Craig makes progress on his pillows for Patricia; Cameran tries to adjust to her new life with baby Palmer.

programme.title: Gone Girl
programme.desc: After basking in the glory of his successful beer event, Austen is hit with romantic reality; Craig faces some harsh truths; Thomas and Ashley struggle to resolve their issues.

programme.title: Game Changer

programme.title: Ho, Ho, Ho

programme.title: RSVPeeved
programme.desc: As Charleston reels over Thomas' arrest, Kathryn deals with conflicting emotions; Cameran struggles to balance motherhood and her career; the friends gather at Patricia's dinner party, during which they are shocked by the revelation of a secret romp.

programme.title: Kat's Out of the Bag

programme.title: Slide Into Your DMs Like...

programme.title: Barking Up the Wrong Tree House
programme.desc: Austen has second thoughts about breaking up with Madison; Chelsea learns Austen has been badmouthing her around town; a shocking experience gives Eliza a new lease on life; Kathryn pulls another one of her stunts before the girls' trip.

programme.title: Drugs in Body
programme.desc: Las Vegas officers rush to a house for a weapons call; Berkeley County, S.C., officers investigate after a suspect fled on foot; Daytona Beach, Fla., officers find drugs hidden in a suspect's body; officers in Richland, S.C., apprehend a suspect.

programme.title: Pit Maneuver Pursuit
programme.desc: Clayton County, Ga., officers stop a vehicle after multiple PIT attempts; officers in Monroe, La., respond to reports of shots fired; Daytona Beach, Fla., officers find drugs during a traffic stop; officers in Richland County, S.C., pursue a vehicle.

programme.title: Home Burglary
programme.desc: Las Vegas officers apprehend a man during a home burglary; officers in Clayton County, Ga., discover a man's real identity; Lee County, Fla., officers are called to a neighbor dispute; officers in Knox County, Tenn., serve a felony warrant.

programme.desc: Baton Rouge, La. officers pursue a wanted vehicle while officers in Knox County, Tenn. search a suspect during a traffic stop; Richland County, S.C. officers use drones to look for a suspect who fled and officers in Lee County, Fla. find drugs.

programme.title: Stan Lee: Life, Death & Money
programme.desc: At 95-years-old, Stan Lee is a comic book legend; despite being touted as a creative genius whose original characters launched the multi-billion-dollar Marvel movie franchise, Lee is no mastermind when it comes to handling his money.

programme.title: Leona Helmsley: Life, Death & Money
programme.desc: On Aug. 20, 2007, Leona Helmsley, one of the most infamous celebrity billionaires of late 20th-century New York, dies at the age of 87.

programme.title: Lucille Ball: Life, Death & Money
programme.desc: Lucille Ball is known as one of the greatest female comedians of all time; on the air for six seasons, she cemented her iconic status in "I Love Lucy," where she and her first husband, Desi Arnaz, pulled in ratings that were unheard of.

programme.title: Gloria Estefan
programme.desc: On March 20, 1990, a tour bus carrying Gloria Estefan, her husband, son and two of her crew is traveling through Pennsylvania when an 18-wheel truck slams into them from behind as her driver stops in the road.

programme.title: John Denver
programme.desc: The mystery surrounding beloved singer and songwriter John Denver's plane crash into the Pacific Ocean in 1997.

programme.title: Dale Earnhardt Sr.
programme.desc: In 2001, NASCAR superstar Dale Earnhardt Sr. was killed in a crash on the Daytona 500 racing track; questions surrounded the accident including how this fearless driver, driving a car he knew, on a track he knew, could die in an accident.

programme.title: John F. Kennedy Jr.
programme.desc: A look at the factors involved in the 1999 fatal airplane crash that took the lives of John F. Kennedy Jr., his wife Carolyn Bessette, and her sister Lauren.

programme.title: Killing JFK: 60 Questions Answered
programme.desc: Facts, expert commentary, footage, rare images, and new information might finally put the mystery of JFK's assassination to rest.

programme.title: Jacqueline Kennedy Onassis
programme.desc: On May 19, 1994, American icon Jackie Kennedy Onassis dies at the age of 64.

programme.title: John F. Kennedy Jr.
programme.desc: On Jul. 16, 1999, John Kennedy Jr. crashed his Piper Saratoga aircraft into the ocean off Martha's Vineyard.

programme.title: Diana: The Ultimate Truth
programme.desc: Featuring exclusive never-before-heard interviews, former detective and award-winning investigative journalist Mark Williams-Thomas examines some of the theories that have emerged since Princess Diana's death and sets out to answer key questions.

programme.title: Body Cavity Search
programme.desc: Baton Rouge, La. officers pursue a wanted vehicle while officers in Knox County, Tenn. search a suspect during a traffic stop; Richland County, S.C. officers use drones to look for a suspect who fled and officers in Lee County, Fla. find drugs.

programme.title: Stolen Ambulance Crash
programme.desc: Clayton County officers respond to an accident involving a stolen ambulance while officers in Richland County, S.C. are called to a fight in progress; Knox County officers pursue a vehicle; officers in Daytona Beach, Fla. search for a suspect.

programme.title: John Wayne Gacy
programme.desc: A look at the case of serial killer John Wayne Gacy, which is one of sexual depravity that includes the rape and murder of at least 33 young men and boys.

programme.title: Ted Bundy
programme.desc: Examining the case of Ted Bundy, one of the world's most notorious serial killers, who was accused of murdering at least thirty young women and girls, but in court, he maintained his innocence; three experienced sleuths analyze his behavior.

programme.title: Chris Watts
programme.desc: To the outside world, Chris Watts played the part of a loving family man to perfection; when his family suddenly vanished, he wasted no time appearing on local news to appeal for their safe return, but, he was hiding a dark secret.

programme.title: Mary Kay Letourneau: 'Til Death
programme.desc: Mary Kay Letourneau was an elementary schoolteacher who pled guilty in 1997 to the rape of a child, 12-year-old Vili Fualaau, who'd been her sixth grade student; Mary Kay was ultimately imprisoned from 1998 to 2004.

programme.title: Susan Smith: Sex Behind Bars
programme.desc: In 1994, Susan Smith was sentenced to life in prison for murdering her two sons, 3-year-old Michael and 14-month-old Alexander; prosecutors believed the reason she killed her sons was because she was in love with a man who didn't want children.

programme.title: Amy Fisher: Kill for Me
programme.desc: Amy Fisher was arrested for shooting Mary Jo Buttafuoco and told authorities that the shooting was an accident.

programme.title: Chris Watts
programme.desc: To the outside world, Chris Watts played the part of a loving family man to perfection; when his family suddenly vanished, he wasted no time appearing on local news to appeal for their safe return, but, he was hiding a dark secret.

programme.title: Dylan McDermott
programme.desc: Actor Dylan McDermott seeks the truth 40 years after the in the 1967 death of his 20-year-old mother, Diane.

programme.title: Kelsey Grammer
programme.desc: Actor Kelsey Grammer was only 14 when his estranged father was murdered, but years later he would face a far greater tragedy from the wrath of serial killers.

programme.title: Woody Harrelson
programme.desc: Academy Award nominated actor Woody Harrelson has enamored audiences with his charm, but it is his portrayal of a fictional serial killer in the 1994 film "Natural Born Killers," where he channels his hitman-for-hire father, Charles Harrelson.

programme.title: Young Boys Incorporated
programme.desc: Young Boys Incorporated was a drug-trafficking gang founded in Detroit in the late '70s, and Milton Butch Jones, Raymond Peoples, and Dwayne Davis rose up the ranks and ran the organization; it was considered innovative because it employed teenagers.

programme.title: "Little" Nicky Scarfo
programme.desc: Scarfo rose to power during one of the bloodiest periods in Philadelphia organized crime history; more than two dozen mob members or associates were murdered between 1980 and 1985 as Scarfo took control of the Philadelphia mob.

programme.title: Sam Giancana
programme.desc: Sam Giancana was a top mob boss; he started out as a driver for Al Capone, and by the Great Depression, Giancana was building his own reputation; Giancana is connected to conspiracy theories involving both the Kennedy family and Fidel Castro.

programme.title: Most Shocking

programme.title: Public Disturbance
programme.desc: Meet Gerald and Helen Goode, a couple who live by the motto WWAGD ("What Would Al Gore Do?"). They're zealous vegans, they drive a hybrid, and they recycle everything possible. Even the family dog, Che, is vegan. Gerald wants a Public Broadcast Radio affiliate in Greenville so bad that he and Helen host a pledge drive and Gerald surprisingly raises all $100,000 needed, from an old woman named Ruth.

programme.title: A Good Game of Chicken
programme.desc: Meet Gerald and Helen Goode, a couple who live by the motto WWAGD ("What Would Al Gore Do?"). They're zealous vegans, they drive a hybrid, and they recycle everything possible. Even the family dog, Che, is vegan. Gerald's outraged when he discovers Cranky, a local BBQ restaurant owner, is selling "meatless chili with chicken" and soon takes a stand, protesting and trying to convince Cranky to remove the chicken.

programme.title: Trouble In Store
programme.desc: Meet Gerald and Helen Goode, a couple who live by the motto WWAGD ("What Would Al Gore Do?"). They're zealous vegans, they drive a hybrid, and they recycle everything possible. Even the family dog, Che, is vegan. Helen is accused of shoplifting and banned from One Earth, her favorite store.

programme.title: After School Special
programme.desc: Meet Gerald and Helen Goode, a couple who live by the motto WWAGD ("What Would Al Gore Do?"). They're zealous vegans, they drive a hybrid, and they recycle everything possible. Even the family dog, Che, is vegan. Helen and Gerald tutor at-risk kids; Ubuntu unknowingly joins an eco-terrorist group; Bliss starts her own business.

programme.title: A Rose and a Pistol
programme.desc: Linda, a beautiful dancer, has stolen Jigen's heart and a vengeful Meyer has taken Fujiko hostage. Unaware that Linda and Meyer are working together, Lupin and Jigen are set up to kill each other...

programme.title: Where Did the Cinderella Stamp Go?
programme.desc: According to legend, a stamp named the Cinderella Shadow is said to make its owner a princess. Lupin and his gang pull off the heist, but a girl named Alice who also wants the stamp tags along.

programme.title: Female Detective Melon
programme.desc: Lupin has sent a notice declaring he will steal all the cash from every bank in Paris. Detective Melon, the granddaughter of Inspector Garimard, is chosen to catch Lupin alongside Inspector Zenigata.

programme.title: Electric Pigeon Tactics
programme.desc: Lupin has many secret techniques, and one of them is levitation. In order to get their hands on this technique, a crime syndicate plots a dirty trick.

programme.title: The Diplomat Murder Case (Part 2)
programme.desc: As Heiji reveals the culprit, Shinichi shows up to the scene claiming Heiji's deduction is incorrect and solves the case.

programme.title: The Library Murder Case
programme.desc: Conan and the Detective Boys suspect a librarian is hiding more than just books in shelves.

programme.title: The Golf Range Murder Case
programme.desc: A relaxing day of golf leads Conan, Kogoro and Ran to their next explosive case with Eisuke Tachibana, the president of a company.

programme.title: The Case of the Mysterious Murder Weapon
programme.desc: Conan, Ran and Kogoro find a wounded bird and then hear a scream from a nearby building; they find Ryusuke Imoto on his balcony supposedly murdered by a potted plant.

programme.title: Project Freelancer: Chapter 8
programme.desc: Project Freelancer plans for a little payback, while the Reds and Blues hit the road again. The Freelancers brawl fire with fire. Project Freelancer sends in the big guns.

programme.title: Project Freelancer: Chapter 9

programme.title: Project Freelancer: Chapter 10
programme.desc: Tex and Carolina face off, while Sarge and Simmons meet old friends. In order to create his latest A.I. program, the Director experiments on the Alpha.

programme.title: Project Freelancer: Chapter 11
programme.desc: Epsilon tries to get some answers from Carolina, while Tex finds out some interesting information. Carolina and Epsilon bicker with the Reds and Blues over their plans to neutralize the Director. Project Freelancer is attacked by Agent Texas.

programme.title: The Chorus Trilogy: Chapter 1
programme.desc: After a ship crash-lands, the Blues and Reds get accommodated in at their new home. The Reds discuss a predicament they face about their base. Sarge lays down a few guidelines with respect to his personal space.

programme.title: The Chorus Trilogy: Chapter 2
programme.desc: The Reds and Blues work together to repair the communications tower and Caboose gets a new pet. Grif and Simmons are ordered to surveil the Blue Team. Sarge gets alarmed over Simmons leaving while Washington and Tucker quarrel.

programme.title: The Robber Hospitalization Case

programme.desc: With Halloween approaching, Monty takes stock of his pumpkins and squashes, plants up alpines and shows how to divide a large fern to create new plants. Meanwhile, Adam Frost and Advolly Richmond visit Hever Castle in Kent.

programme.desc: Monty Don tackles some seasonal gardening jobs at Longmeadow and guest presenter Matthew Wilson has some ideas to brighten up a dark, north-facing wall.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: Monty Don meets two sets of gardeners who are desperate for his help and advice to turn their outside spaces into dream gardens.
